title: Joii Should do Stand Up, they are Comedians
review: I am a customer of Animal Friends, and as such have access to Joii veterinary services.I discovered a small red bump near my dogs whiskers and decided before taking him to the vet I would consult Joii. After attempting to do so I am not sure if their services actually exist, and if they do they are next to useless.So after downloading the app, registering my details, photographing my dog I eventually got through to the "consultation" page. I was greeted with the prompt, Dr. Ann Draper will ring you in 29 minutes. Okay I thought that is quicker than a vet trip. Ten minutes later I was told the vet would speak to me in 13 minutes, then badda bing I was next in line. Twenty five minutes later I was still next in line. As I contemplated my life passing me by waiting for Dr. Ann Draper to  ring me, I decided to cancel the call. I was told I could not cancel the call as the consultation had not been completed. So I just uninstalled the app and decided that is 45 minutes of my life I will never get back.So I am not sure if they have some sort of scam going on whereby they keep clients forever waiting the bill the insurance companies. Whatever their game I would not go near them, and I would advise you to do the same. God knows how they have so many 5 star reviews.

title: Terrible experience with the cargo company at destination
review: (Update)-------------------------------------------------------------Quickly after raising my concerns, Airpets contacted me. As the reply to that review, they do not have control over which cargo company handle the pets once at destination, the airline companies do. So, British Airways was the airline company my pets flew with, and they use Mercury Cargo.For information, the Mercury Cargo warehouse is also IAG Cargo so if the airline company you use work with them, your pets will be handle like freight shipments not live animals. -------------------------------------------------------------(Previous review below)I shipped my pets with Airpets from London to Los Angeles. While they are very nice and professional people (friendly when I dropped my cats, offered me to send me updates through WhatsApp), nobody mentioned how pets are handled at Mercury Cargo (company they work with at destination, LAX).  Prior to the travel, I was told by email by a Mercury representative to come get the paperwork at 1930 the day of the flight, go get a stamp from the U.S. Customs and come back to pick up my cats. So, I did come at 1930 to get my paperwork, and they told me to come back at 2100 as it was not ready. Additionally, no one explained to me that I had to sign up to "get in line". The pets are NOT kept in a climate controlled room and they are left on wooden palettes in the middle of forklift machine moving freight around, in a freight warehouse not an live animal allocated room.The great reputation Airpets has might be because they often take care of the entire trip, which means pets owners get their pets at their door and so they don't see this. My cats peed themselves (which did not happened on longer trip in the past) and were in shock to have been handled the way they were handled, plus they were waiting next to crates with barking dogs (I understand that the dogs barked, I love dogs. They were crying as they saw their owners waiting). Why would Airpets people be so amazing and do such a great job at departure to then allow such situation at destination? I do not understand.

title: Repatriating Guinea pigs UK to Canada
review: I am repatriating to Canada at the end of August and I had to get my three guinea pigs home. Trying to sort this whole process in the middle of a pandemic was an absolute nightmare as most of the airlines that usually fly guinea pigs as animal cargo weren’t taking any animal bookings, but airpets made the process quite easy and a lot less stressful. I dealt with Jake and he was an excellent agent and very helpful. I will admit I was quite demanding and definitely not the easiest customer to be dealing with due to the stress of trying to plan a move and the repatriation of my pigs during a pandemic, so I was a bit of a nightmare myself, but Jake was very understanding of the circumstances and was always as polite and helpful as possible. The process was actually very simple once we got the airline to agree to fly the pigs (that was the hardest part), and it was very straightforward. Thankfully my province didn’t require any kind of special import permits for rodents so I just had to deal with the documentation airpets sent and then the vet certification, all of which was easy to do/obtain. Make sure to check with the Canadian Food Inspection Agency about whether or not you need permits for your animals based on their final destination. There were some issues with the airline/Vancouver airport facilities which made it more stressful than necessary, but those were mostly due to COVID complications and were not the fault of Jake or airpets. However, DO take into consideration that most airlines are not flying regular schedules or taking advanced bookings at the moment because of potential schedule changes. I was only able to officially book their travel 14 days before the travel date for these reasons, but as I had been in contact with Jake since June it was very straightforward once we were allowed to book as I had already completed all the necessary documents. But do be aware that there are delays and changes with the airlines themselves. Also, there may be extra fees from the airline/airport facilities that will be added to the already hefty sum of animal cargo. Flying any animal(s), no matter how small, is very expensive. It’s the safest bet to add a bit more money to your budget in case of extra fees. I wasn’t aware of some of the fees until booking as they came from the airport facilities and were affected by the route the pigs were flying. When I arrived at their offices on the morning of their flight I was given as much time as I needed to personally set up their kennel how I wanted it and say goodbye, and was not rushed by any of the employees who all seemed genuinely interested in the pigs and wanted to know about them. I’m very thankful I wasn’t rushed because I was very anxious about them travelling, especially as they were going on a few days ahead of me and being picked up by family upon arrival. The environment was calming and I didn’t feel any pressure to speed up, even though they obviously had a schedule to keep to. They were very good about this and I appreciate it greatly. I was informed via email when their flight took off from LHR and then was sent photos the following morning (due to time difference) of them in their stayover cage at the Vancouver airport facilities (their domestic connection was the next day), which was very reassuring. The only reason I haven’t given 5/5 stars is because there was no information given to me about collection and I had to ask when and where they were supposed to be collected right before they arrived, but otherwise everything went smoothly and better than I imagined. I gave Jake an update (per request) once they were collected and he seemed very happy that they had arrived safely. The pigs arrived safely and seemed only mildly peeved about the long travel (two flights ~13h total plus a stayover) and are happy and healthy and were eating their food and exploring their temporary set up as soon as they got home. A bonus is that the Canada customs charge for my province was a lot lower than expected. They are apparently acting like their normal selves and seem to be otherwise unaffected. I couldn’t find any reviews about Guinea pigs/small animals flying with airpets so I thought this might be helpful to anyone else who may have to travel with their small animals. I was very weary about them travelling despite having read other peoples’ stories about travelling with their pigs and them being fine, but as I couldn’t find a review for airpets about guinea pigs I was very anxious. I hope this might ease someone else’s anxiety in the future. Overall I would highly recommend airpets to anyone needing to move their pets out of the UK as they tried to make the process as stress free as possible for me despite the whole situation being an absolute nightmare. Thank you so much airpets and Jake!

title: We chose Airpets for the relocation of our French Bulldog from the UK to the USA
review: We chose Airpets for the relocation of our French Bulldog.  We moved from the UK to Pennsylvania in the US.  We felt that after reading the reviews, seeing the Instagram page and after talking to ..., that they would be perfect.  Some issues were out of their hands such as the heatwave that hit all 3 airports our pup would have to go through - LDN Heathrow; Turkey and IAD Washington.  The communication from ... at Airpets was not consistent and we would have to initiate all contact.  We saw that this had been picked up on in some previous reviews.  Once dates had been set, Airpets were good enough to collect our pup from a new location as we had already moved to the US.  He was collected on time and the vet check was done quickly with emails sent to confirm this.  The A-Z Broker kept us informed.  We were disappointed with the photos we received.  Reviews all comment on the great photos and videos.    All we got were some photos of him looking unhappy and eating from a food bowl that had been left in his wee patch.  We understand that he was flying with the Turkish Air handlers, but Airpets states strongly about their good rapport with all airlines handling the transport.  This did not feel like that at all.  Almost as though once he left Heathrow Airpets were not bothered.  Choice Aviation handled the last stage and we were appalled at how we were re-united with our pup.  He was left in his crate with a view of us, he was crying and howling.  Despite being an hour early to pick him up and the flight running 58 minutes late, Choice Aviation were unhelpful and did not appear to know what they were doing.  We were made to wait and fill out paperwork that could have been done earlier, the staff dealing with us had no idea how to use the system, in the meantime our pup was getting distressed and we were not allowed in to see him.  A lovely member of staff came to our rescue and went to comfort our pup, then took over to complete the release quickly.  Thank goodness he knew what he was doing.  We were then given another issue and that was getting him out of the crate.  He had been cable tied in, understandable, but we were told that they could not cut the ties or give us anything to open it.  My husband ended up ripping them off with brute force.  To end it all we then had to rush our pup into a public toilet and wash him in the sink.  Where he had got so distressed he ended up covered in his own feces.  We expected after a 10 hour flight he would need a clean up, but not to this extend.  Overall we are disappointed with the image that Airpets paints for itself as we feel we saw none of this.  Jake stepped in at the last minute as ... was ill, his communication was better but did not make up for the whole experience.  My husband is currently putting a complaint together direct to Airpets.

title: Transiting through LHR
review: This was the 4th pet agent quote I got and it seemed reasonable plus good reviews online. I was travelling from Iceland and just forced to transit  through London to Ireland because of covid.If I was reviewing on just exports I would give 10stars and full credit to Lee Fisher as he did a great job prompt clear and detailed quote, fast reponse emails, last minute change to crate dimensions and he delt with it professionally without a problem for me, even taking after hour call to confirm payment etc for travel the following day. Imports email agent replies were slower and caused me a lot of unnecessary stress on the actual day of travel. Because of covid I had a logistical nightmare of balancing days and the pet agents didn't believe me when I tried to explain it so here it is. New covid rules since June 8th meant I had to be in and out of the UK again within 24hrs so dog and I were booked to fly the next morning because there wasn't enough time to clear him between same day flights . Iceland doesn't issue eu passports because they are not in the EU only health certs, you can't collect that until the dog has had the worm dose within 5days of travel needing to factor in the 24hrs extra to get to Ireland for the health cert to be valid til final destination. And only two flights per week out of Iceland plus the vet is closed except emergency and the dept of agriculture also closed over the weekend.  I had prechecked myself with the dept of agriculture in Iceland, the UK and Ireland and all said health cert was valid even for transiting through the uk. I should have checked with the animal reception center at Heathrow because officials there claimed it was an outdated annex/health cert and not suitable insisting on getting  the UK pet passport issued but this was not made clear to me until I called the animal reception center myself. The Airpets agent emailed at lunch to say dog has arrived and is a bit thirsty but all OK. 30mins later she messaged me to say they can't find all of the dogs paperwork (which icelandair cargo had taped to the crate) I didn't get a reply so 30mins passed and I sent another email and got a reply from a guy called Jake to say the authorities at larc were not happy with the paperwork(oked by the vet in Iceland and I had to go to the department of agriculture in Iceland for the final document all oked by them) and needed confirmation from the vet on iceland. -This new agent did his best with the mess he was handed. He was my only point of contact in the company on the day and unable to tell me exactly what was needed but he did give me contact phone numbers which enabled me to get it all sorted eventually. This became a time sensitive issue it was now 4pm and at 5:30pm the out of hours vet charges kicked in. The vet secretary in Iceland could not find the rabies vaccine number,I resent the copy to her I had given to Airpets already. The arc wanted a new document signed by the vet who was out on an emergency call. I spent from 3:30-8pm between phonecalls and emails to the vet in Iceland to the animal reception center and to Airpets. The pet agents clock off at 5:30 also and the manager Lee has the out of hours phone and he had a day off. He wanted to change the flight to another day later and do it all in office hours. Not listening to me when I said it could have been done within office hours today and I am supposed to go into 2week quarantine and I live 5 hours from Dublin Airport so the next day travel was not an option for me. He didn't like my tone, he had his first day off in three weeks, and nobody at the pet agents was responsible for this avoidable mess or willing to do what I had hired them to do -Get my dog from the Icelandair plane to the aerlingus plane on the date planned and as requested. Between 3pm and 8pm I had to call and call to get the information needed so my dog would travel with me as planned. Around 7pm after 4hours of asking, demanding,a little shouting and begging I just broke down crying on the phone to Lee F who had wasted his evening trying to persuade me otherwise. He went into the office on his day off and sorted the whole thing within 20mins. Again, full points for his work but the evening was unnecessary and a total waste for all involved. If I knew at 2pm exactly what was needed I could have helped the vet in Iceland. It worked out really expensive for me 720pounds for something that should have cost a lot less. I am sure they are a good company just there were delays and changes on my side plus this outdated annex nonesence and not enough active staff in airpets on the day I needed them. They need a seperate out of hours duty manager to ensure continuity and so the manager can take a day off. And in all the pet agencies they have seperate import and export agents rather than one case worker taking responsibility. In the end my dog travelled as planned and I aged considerably.

review: We had hoped to write a glowing review of Airpets, they had impressed us in the early stages of the process, but unfortunately our dog's journey to Canada was not what we had expected and their subsequent handling of the concerns we raised did not feel appropriate.  We were not given any information or paperwork to enable us to collect our dog on arrival at Calgary.  This meant there were delays and a lot of running around once we landed before we could collect our boy.  This was incredibly stressful, after an eight hour flight, for both us and our dog, and could have been avoided.  When we raised this matter with Airpets they said they had recommended using a Canadian agent in their early paperwork, that we had received some months before.  We should also have been provided with an emergency contact number, that we didn't have and there appears to have been a little bit of slight of hand with the truth regarding the sending of customs documents (Airpets said they sent them, we didn't receive).  When we raised our concerns with Airpets they were slow to respond and only gave us a full answer after being chased.  This was disappointing as it suggested a lax approach to after-care. I have read the glowing reviews of Airpets and this is one of the reasons we are so disappointed with the service we received.  It appears they can do an exceptional job when the right people are working on your case, but when the wrong people are involved, there is a general lack of responsibility and communication.  This is the first time we have taken a pet on a plane with us, and we made this abundantly clear to our agent at Airpets, the assumption however was that we would manage a lot of the arrival matters ourselves and would somehow know how to navigate the customs process.

title: Some good aspects but overall service very poor
review: We booked AirPets to help fly our dog from England to Colombia a couple of months ago. They were one of the more reasonably priced options that we found and we were immediately assigned an agent to support us with the process. Communication wasn't fantastic with this agent, while they always responded promptly, I had to do a lot of chasing to find out what was happening and I felt I was only supplied information when I asked for it whereas I would have liked the agent to be more pro active. When it came to our dog actually flying Airpets were great in their communication around both collecting her and how she was doing at Heathrow airport. However, communication was non existent during her journey (she had a night over in Spain before flying on to Colombia) and when she arrived in Bogota she was left in her travel crate over night without being allowed out to go to the toilet and from what we could see when we collected her, with no food or water. It then took us 5 hours to get her out of the airport the next day due to a very inefficient Colombian process, during which time our dog remained in her travel crate and became very distressed. It was my understanding that the service we were paying for would cover the moment she was collected from me until the moment my husband collected her at the other end. Be warned that this is not the case. Once your pet leaves England, you will not hear from Airpets at all and it appears they do not maintain responsibility for them. When I looked back through all the communication we had received from airpets, in the first email they sent my husband with a quote, they recommended arranging a Colombian agent to help speed along the process at the airport here but this was never mentioned again once we had engaged their services and I would have expected our travel agent to offer to help with this, especially if it was important to guaranteeing our dogs well being during the journey. Overall we were very disappointed with the service received and would not recommend them.

title: Airpets….
review: Airpets….This is my honest review of airpets.At the end of the day they did get my 17kg dog from England to Australia but that is about the only positive really. This has been the most stressful time for myself, trying to get my dog to Australia & I thought by going with a well known company I would avoid any unnecessary stress. I thought wrong. They were pushy for my £3600 & when they received the money I struggled to get a receipt making me feel very uneasy as that’s a lot of money to part with at one time.It felt like I was always chasing them for a reply, They promised me that anytime I needed help with anything just to call, every time I called I didn’t get an answer from anyone at airpets. It was extremely stressful towards the end with the many vet visits & quite a few things went wrong at the vets where I needed guidance, it takes 5 minutes to send me a quick email the day before my vet visit (they knew my vet visit days as they told me to book them) just re-explaining what needed doing to make my life as easy as possible, But the Lee Fisher who was helping me failed to tell me he was on holiday which felt like 80% of the time. It takes 5 minutes to send an email to say your on holiday and give me someone else’s contact.Whenever I did manage to get hold of Lee Fisher, I felt like he didn’t care about my worries & that he really couldn’t be bothered.When all the vet visits were done, and pick up day arrived a man in a black van showed up at my house, I had no idea who he was & all he was wearing was a grey tracksuit. ( he turned out to be more friendly then airpets & answered all the questions he could) but I was expecting a big white van with airpets written on the side of it, cost me £155 for this service, honestly wish I took her myself now, would have saved £105. As soon as my dog was put on the plane I think I’ve had one email but that was just saying that someone else is in charge of her now, Which is obviously very reassuring for me and my family.Haven't heard from them since, they haven’t asked if she’s okay or how she’s doing in Australia.Honestly, I would like some kind of refund, they had £250 off me for doing all this & whatever else was left over from my £3600 & I felt so unwelcome & ignored the whole year of so I’ve been dealing with them.I would never use them again & would never tell anyone to use them.

title: Only ‘ok’ barely.
review: Only ‘ok’ barely.The positives:- cat arrived safely in Dubai, so technically speaking they did what they said- the price was reasonable, not the cheapest but not the most expensive either- Airpets arranged the vet checks and forms needed without any issuesThe negatives:- complete lack of communication. Our cat had to isolate for 2 weeks due to regulations from the destination country. During the 2 weeks we received zero updates voluntarily from Airpets, and after chasing from our side 2 or 3 times we received 2 or 3 poor quality photos of our cat looking terrified hiding in a box, and that’s all we got during the whole 2 weeks she was there. As pet owners can imagine, it was quite a tense time and it does not take more than 30 seconds to snap a photo of her every 2 or 3 days without having to be constantly chased, to put owners minds at ease.- also no notice to let us know she had arrived safely (she was collected by airpets driver). No notice to say she had settled. Or that she was eating or using her litter tray. Or that she was playing or getting some exercise now and again. Nothing. Total silence except for those few photos when we chased a lot.- poor communication again. I could not get through to our contact at Airpets for the majority of the day despite attempting to call multiple times and sending multiple emails. I was simply told everyone involved is busy every time I called (but I was still receiving email responses in between from the same people who were too busy to take a call). This was when we had been told suddenly there is no direct flight and I was desperate to speak to someone to work out what alternatives we have for further boarding / different airlines etc (see next point).- poor planning and organization.We were specifically informed in writing there were direct flights available to our destination. I had heard this might not be the case due to covid and asked Airpets to reconfirm, and was told again in certain terms in writing that there are direct flights. 6 days before the scheduled departure and halfway through the quarantine isolation at AirPets facility we were told ‘there are no direct flights due to the type of aircraft BA is using on this route during covid, you can pay 2100 pounds for a pallet, or wait and hope BA change their aircraft type (despite covid) or take an indirect flight’. This was extremely disappointing and upsetting. It was too late for us to take our cat back, and we cannot pay 2100 for a pallet. Based on the confirmations we had received prior to booking with Airpets we had proceeded with all our planning. Our cat is an exotic breed snub nose and every flight is risky we definitely did not want 2 flights for her. In the end we had no realistic option but to go for the indirect flights (thankfully she was ok and luckily the weather in the Middle East was unseasonably cool during those few days).So in conclusion ok price, ok delivery for the basic requirements, but definitely don’t expect any communication or regular updates at all, and if you are making any critical arrangements based on information you’re getting from Airpets, make sure to directly call the airlines or other people involved to confirm the AirPets comments are correct before you rely on them or plan around them. We got quite fortunate with the alternative flight availability and luckily our cat got through 2 flights ok but it was quite a stressful few days. On a final note, not a single apology from Airpets when their mistake was discovered (a very ‘couldn’t give a damn’ attitude throughout) and not a single follow up or comment to advise our cat had been loaded or received at the airport. By comparison several of the other relocation companies in the Uk were super communicative and friendly but we couldn’t use them due to their lack of availability for our dates (understandably, they were booked up first). I would try one of the others first before settling on Airpets.

They couldn't accept electronic signatures for our dog to be released and he would have to stay at Toronto in kennels at our cost etc until further notice!I drove to a random house and asked to use their printer as I have just moved to NS and have only mobile phone. Paperwork printed signed, scanned and sent back to Airpets subcontractor in Canada.Then the problems start. We were next informed our dog wasnt booked onto an onward flight to Halifax despite the Airpets  itinerary sent to us previously confirming that he was. We finally got dog ourselves onto second flight with no help from AirpetsFormal complaint to Airpets met with a we’re sorry response but no explanation as to why any of this occurred.Essentially they shoved our dog onto a flight to Toronto with no paperwork and at no stage did they inform us that there was no onward flight booked for him.As I type, I am hoping desperately that he arrives tomorrow - now today. Airpets really couldnt / didn’t care less and essentially organised for our dog to be flown to Toronto where he would have to stay indefinitely until paperwork could be completed, no flight organised and no communication. The Canadian subcontractor apologised for this being an ‘unexpected’ flight. I can only assume they were unaware it was happening as nothing had been booked on the Canadian side including I think overnight / same day kennelling. We've asked to meet Airpets face to face to discuss at Heathrow when my wife travels on Saturday but no response.I am typing this in the vain hope it will embarass them enough to respond. I will update this when / if my dog arrives.I have NO faith that they have cared for our dog appropriately. If I knew who to report them to for what we feel is  negligence of an animaI, we would.Airpets - you are fully aware of this case and have not offered any explanation. title: A REALLY Negative Experience
review: I started my journey importing my dog to Australia in July 2022 when someone suggested using Sophie from AirPets to carry out the necessary steps for me.This, unfortunately, has not been my experience with AirPets. My dog is my world, like most, so for me importing him safely, happily and with a competent company was of the utmost importance. I trusted Sophie with the process and it has honestly caused me more stress, tears and anxiety than I can express. From the start, Sophie’s communication was lacking (she even commented on this herself, admitting that communication had been lacking) and there were several times where I was concerned about her management of my import request. The first issue was after our initial discussions when I had sent payment for the import permit with confirmation that the permit was being applied for, to receive an email the next day stating that she would need a copy of the RNATT test results to start the import application. I was pretty concerned at this point, but as Sophie had come recommended I decided to carry on.  (NB: the person that recommend AirPets initially is now no longer recommending AirPets and is instead using a different Agent). At every step of the process, I had to chase Sophie to get answers/results. Not once did she send over documentation without me chasing her for it, and this was always some time after she had received it! Even the Veterinary Schedule that you’re supposed to receive alongside your initial payment for the permit, I had to chase - explaining to Sophie that the lack of information was causing me some stress meant she sent over a tentative schedule with a single date on! It was just a constant hassle to get anything out of Sophie - the worst being the PEQ Booking & updated Import Permit - the PEQ Booking Number (PRN) was actually never sent to me (until the very end of our communication after multiple times asking for it), nor was the booking confirmed until I chased Sophie about the dates as I had been told that the date we requested was fully booked & the updated Import Permit, which I was told about on Oct 21st, was completed on November 1st and I didn’t get it until I emailed Sophie letting her know I was no longer going to be working with her on Nov 18th.I honestly thought the whole thing couldn’t get much worse, until I let Sophie know that I had lost faith in her ability to complete the import of my dog, to which her response was “thanks for the feedback, I’ll go ahead and cancel your quarantine spot”. To say that I was shocked at the response would be an understatement. It seemed like a very petty way to respond to someone, given how poor communication had been throughout. This then ensued a back and fourth of emailing for near 24hrs of me asking Sophie to provide the PRN Number for the booking (at this point, I honestly didn’t trust that the booking had been made, so at the very least I wanted the PRN as confirmation for the booking) with Sophie, as per usual, ignoring my requests and instead pressuring for payment (of £42 for the booking fee, which is a nice upcharge of over double given that the current cost for the PEQ fee is just over £15 - £27AUD).To say my experience with AirPets has been underwhelming would be an understatement and I would not recommend them to anyone. I would in fact, tell them to run the other way and avoid them. For a process that is beyond important for most pet owners, the way that Sophie handled things was just abysmal.

title: I ordered 2 grams of Bubba Kush (Indoor…
review: I ordered 2 grams of Bubba Kush (Indoor Variety) and received 2.75 grams of Bubba Kush (Greenhouse variety). Plus a gram or so of gelato flower.I am extremely impressed that they gave me the extra .75 grams and the bonus gelato flower, but would have preferred to have received the Indoor Bubba Kush.I ordered the Bubba Kush specifically for it's high CBD content to help with insomnia, so was disappointed to receive the lower % strain. I use a dry herb vaporiser and didn't quite get the milage out of the flower I was hoping for.The quality was still very high though, plus they gave me a nifty little tin to keep it in.Delivery time was excellent.Overall, a good experience and would buy again. I'd advise to be extra careful when ordering, so you now if it's the indoor or greenhouse you want though.

However, I feel the subscription service could be improved. I subscribed for monthly renewal and it is only delivered the day before the new month is needed. What if I had missed the delivery I would have been a day without. It's an automatic renewal I can't understand why it can't be sent out a week before it is due so customers have it ready to go and don't have to worry about missing a day.

description: Payntr are an independent UK cricket brand specialising in professional and innovative game changing cricket products.
title: Shoes split, poor customer service
review: Bought a pair of Payntr shoes for my (slight) 13 year old last summer. He wore them for about 15 matches and the side of one of the shoes split across half the length as he was bowling (sufficiently that he had to go off in the middle of a match). I emailed Payntr as I didn’t feel the shoes were of sufficient quality given how little he’d worn them.They were totally unhelpful and said that, as I’d bought batting shoes not bowling shoes, it was my fault for not having separate pairs. My sons play club, school and county cricket and I’ve never seen a child have a separate pair of batting and bowling shoes (including the ones that play for Middlesex). I’d have understood their position if it was a six foot Jimmy Anderson pounding down the wicket, but not a child for 15 matches on grass wickets. They were adamant that batting shoes could not be worn by players for bowling.Only when I emailed back to say that was a shame as my son had wanted me to upgrade to their top of the range bowling shoes, did they then offer 20% off. On principle, I won’t buy Payntr shoes again as I felt their response was unhelpful and unreasonable. By comparison, my older son’s Adidas spikes are 3 years old, he’s probably played 200 matches in them and they’re still going strong.

review: Bought a size 9 Payntr 225 bowling shoe. They didn't fit so I requested a swap to a bigger size. Was advised that there was no stock of 9.5 / 10 as these were in a discontinued range.Following the process of the return, I was advised that I would not be given a refund because there were scuff marks on the shoes. They have never been worn / spikes still in original packet, and shoes were returned in original packaging. The scuff on the heel was present when I opened the shoes, suggesting that they were either damaged in transit getting to me or resent out from a previous return. I assumed this was a factor of them being in the sale and stock that had been around for a long time, therefore the sale price reflected the imperfections. However as this does not affect the performance, and that they were not the right size for me to wear, I returned expecting a full refund.After explaining this to Payntr, no alternative was offered, and I am now left with a spike that I have paid £90 for but cannot wear.Beware ordering if you're not sure on your size.

On contacting customer service I was instructed on how to tie shoe laces, something I thought I have mastered 30 years ago? So arrogant.I was then told to just use the next lace hole down.  Never mind the actual faulty product.  Well, I did this and the next hole down is already ripping through, only a millimetre or so before it'll be broken as well. On doing some more digging it is clear that this is a known issue and a design flaw and they admitted as much saying they were aware of some shoes breaking.The shoes look awesome.  Just a shame they are clearly made using the cheapest available material. So overall for what you pay, definitely not worth the price.

review: **look at any 1 star review this guys got and look at his respose to them all. The guy is an d*** to people and is never wrong.** Some reviews seem to get added to the site right after a bad review as well....paid reviews maybe? After 1 star review he had 6 5 star reviews all on the next day. With only 84 review all in all that's a lot of good ones in a very short amount of time after a bad review.... Scott has now responded. He says I can't have it both ways however the refund I asked for was the delivery charge I had to pay to return the product.£6 did not cover the return cost and I provided the invoice for him to review. He refused to refund my delivery charge so yes I was out of pocket. I do not understand how because I kept half the order I should still have to pay double the deliver fee to return the faulty product.The logic makes no sense?It's there fault I needed to post this product back as it was poor poor quality and not what was paid for but yet I'm still out of pocket as I needed to pay to return it, this was not refunded by Scott. So for their error I am the one who lost money and was out of pocket.The guys a joke.Review edited and changed to 1 star as they have now refused to refund my postage. So I am now out of pocket for their company's error.I was also told that he (Scott the owner) could have just ignored my emails all together if he wanted to. As if I should be honoured he even replied to begin with. Scott doesn't care about his customers and is happy to mislead buyers online. Be warned.I ordered AD333 Pearl / A grade - very poor scratches all over them, gouges in the coating looked like practice balls not as advertised at all. I also got Taylor Made super soft - these were only meant to be grade A - there were about 8 balls with bad marks and two with gouges in but the rest were okay. Again I sent images to evidence this. I emailed them as I thought it might just be a mistake and I was sent the wrong batch. Turned out it was correct. I was asked to send images to prove the state of the balls. I sent images and Scott agreed they were not of the grade promised. I offered to keep the Taylor Mades if Scott would reimburse my original postage cost and my return postage cost to return the Srixons. This totalled £10. Scott would not agree to this so I asked for the return address so I may send them all back for a full refund postage and all.My concern is these will simply be resold to another buyer as Scott did not really seem bothered to say the least.

title: Mixed feelings...
review: I don't normally write reviews but wanted to shared my experience with Releaf as feel it is important. They have lots of overwhelmingly positive reviews so wonder if my experience is a blip or others feel similarly but are not sharing.I came to Releaf from another clinic which kept changing its prices. Releaf has strong branding and marketing which persuaded me to give it a go - I also like that they have a provider in the UK. I signed up for the subscription and the initial kit you get is great and very slick.However, I have two main concerns with Releaf - the first has been my experience of appointments. The doctor I saw in my previous clinic was amazing - he clearly had great knowledge of medical marijuana and I felt listened to in a way I never had in a medical setting (chronic conditions - urgh). My first appointment at Releaf could not have felt more different. A bit of googling tells me that the doctor I saw used to be an NHS surgeon and he did not have anything resembling an empathetic approach. I came away not only with many questions unanswered but feeling that he would have prescribed me the same thing regardless of the issues presented. I did not feel heard at all which is disappointing as I know how important this is to many of us who have felt ignored or misunderstood over many years. My second appointment was much much better - the person I saw was personable, knowledgeable and understanding. However, it was with a non-clinical prescriber - while I was paying the subscription which makes the appointments "free", I feel that it should be made clear by Releaf, or a lower price offered, when the appointment is not with a doctor. I think it is problematic that you cannot choose which professional you want to see when booking an appointment on the website, especially as their website lists doctors who are specialists in different areas. Secondly, I have concerns about the prices. While the price for the flower is reasonable (especially happy to pay it for UK grown), I feel the oil is hugely over-expensive. In my last appointment I asked for a T10:C10 which I had had previously used. I felt at the time that £150 for 30ml was expensive but paid the prescription as I was keen to get it. However, I then did a bit of research and found that this oil retails for £80 (which is what I had paid in the previous clinic). Given that the Releaf subscription promises favourable "members only" prices I am not sure how they justify this.Looking into cancelling my subscription and moving to a clinic which offers more favourable prices with a different booking system - my previous doctor has also moved there which is a good sign.

I was excited to receive my first prescription, which was both oil & flower. However, despite some of the adverts I'd seen saying you got a free vape kit when you subscribed, I didn't get this so had to purchase one. My total initial costs including the initial consultation, oil, flower and kit fell just short of £500.Unfortunately, due to the very negative side effects even at the lowest dose (nausea, vomiting, unable to function the next day due to having a "fuzzy" brain and overwhelming continued tiredness), I had to stop taking it after just a week. Even just the smell made me nauseous & vomit.I there decided that this wasn't for me as it was affecting my ability to work, and I was certainly in no fit state to drive, so I cancelled my subscription and emailed support asking them to remove my details.They did eventually confirm they had done this, yet just a week or so later I received a text offering me a free month's subscription. I again emailed support and received confirmation that my details had allegedly previously been removed but they forgot about the texts & they will contact marketing to make sure I don't receive any more. Yet, at the same time I received another email from them marked "URGENT ACTION REQIRED" asking me to log into my account to update my details ready for my next prescription.  I have emailed them again and hope that now this will all stop. I'm completely unimpressed at the pressure that they seem to try and put on people who this isn't suitable for and I definitely wouldn't recommend them. Addendum - 05/11/24 9:18am - I have just received a telephone call from "Leah" at Releaf calling to check how I was getting on, so my details still have not been removed. I will now be reporting the Company for harassment.

title: Refused to prescribe.
review: I wanted a prescription for cannabis for my restless legs syndrome, a life-ruining condition when not well controlled, for which cannabis can be helpful. Releaf refused. Their doctor claimed a historic issue on my medical record had been caused by cannabis. I queried this (I've looked at the data): he told me to 'google it'.I of course had already done so. Here's what a google search shows: three studies, none of them relevant to me (I'm neither psychotic, adolescent nor bipolar), and one stressing that the conclusions drawn are 'tentative' and that further research is necessary to properly establish the link they seek to show.  The medication I've been prescribed for RLS by my GP, on the other hand, is well known to cause this issue or one easily confused with it. It's listed on the leaflet as a 'common' side effect. A recent news report told of a man receiving a 5-figure compensation payout from his GP for precisely this reason, same drug, same condition as mine.Releaf have been made aware that: a) their refusal to prescribe cannabis for me is based on clinical data which are not relevant to me or my case; which are, in any case, barely present; and which are described by their own authors as 'tentative', and b) a drug prescribed for me by my GP is well known to cause this condition or one easily confused with it, and that this condition is listed as a 'common' side effect of this drug.They refuse to budge. They refuse to re-evaluate my case or their doctor's decision. They stubbornly refuse to acknowledge that they have simply made a mistake in their evaluation process.I was prepared to give them the benefit of the doubt: no longer. They are effectively discriminating against people who have had certain medical conditions, and they refuse to treat them based on medical evidence which barely exists and is not relevant, ignoring an alternative explanation of an iatrogenic cause which is fully backed by uncontested, high-quality clinical data, which I have shown them. title: PLEASE READ
review: PLEASE READStarted off so well with a very productive and informative consultation with one of the doctors who by chance knows some of my current rheumatology consultants. Everything was fine and I ordered my oil which was quite expensive but acceptable if it was going to help me. However once I received the oil there was an issue that I thought would be sorted quite easily to be honest. I had been prescribed a 30ml bottle of oil and a MAX dose of 0.5ml every day by the prescribing doctor (the qualified professional) therefore a 60 day prescription, absolutely fine.When I receive the oil it says very clearly on the bottle that the oil will expire in 40 days time so I am then left with 10ml of wasted product which I have paid roughly £140 for the oil + £99 consultation fee + £35 monthly subscription.I then thought I’ll just drop customer services a chat / email and explain the situation, they’ll either reimburse me for the wasted product or send me a new product with a better shelf life so that I can take my oil without the risk of consuming an out of date medicine. Absolutely not, although customer services were polite enough I was told that they can only prescribe 30 days worth (fair enough) I then replied why didn’t you prescribe me the correct total amount of oil for my prescription…..answer - we don’t do smaller than a 30 ml bottle. So why do I have to pay for full bottle of oil that I can only use 2/3 of?! After some toing and froing with Yasemin I’m hitting my head against a brick wall and just met with the same answers over and over with no resolution being given by customer services.Therefore after all this I will be cancelling my subscription & prescription, however I have paid £275 for a nice chat with a consultant and gotten 20ml of cannabis oil…bargain I hear you say! All of this could have been resolved with a £50 refund and I’d of been a very loyal customer for the foreseeable.Please people if you are wanting a reputable firm that will not rip you off and will resolve your queries and issues efficiently and effectively…RELEAF is not for you!

title: I am writing to express my profound…
review: I am writing to express my profound dissatisfaction with the services provided by Releaf. My experience has been nothing short of frustrating and disappointing, and I feel compelled to share the details of my case.I was already a medical cannabis patient with another company and am well-versed in the procedures involved. When I decided to switch to Releaf, I paid the consultation fee and had a consultation with Dr. Sue. During this consultation, I informed her that I was already with another medical cannabis company and had been taking medical cannabis for some time. I answered all her questions and was subsequently told that I needed to send in my MRI report and a copy of my discharge letter. Dr. Sue assured me that once these documents were received, I could start placing my order.I promptly sent the requested documents. Additionally, I communicated with Jacob and Yasmin via the Releaf chat service, and both confirmed that everything was in order and that I could start making my orders immediately.However, I later received an email stating that I needed to complete at least five sessions of physiotherapy. This contradicted what I had been previously told. I have already undergone all the physiotherapy and other treatments I could afford, including acupuncture. Medical cannabis was my last resort.Had I been informed from the beginning that physiotherapy was a prerequisite, I would not have canceled my previous arrangements with the other company, which allowed me to continue making my orders. Now, I am left without any company and without access to medical cannabis, which has exacerbated my pain and anxiety.Despite my efforts to explain my situation and the mistakes made by Releaf, including providing evidence and recordings of the assurances given to me, I have received no satisfactory resolution. The representative I spoke to merely apologized and read notes indicating that I could place an order once my discharge letter was received.Releaf's mishandling of my case has caused me significant distress and physical suffering. Your company's actions have directly impacted my health and well-being, and this level of service is absolutely unacceptable.

title: TruCheck Screening subpar service
review: TruCheck screening blood test was drawn at Hammersmith Clinic London W6. The entire experience was absolutely horrible: the phlebotomist was more than 30 min late to a 10am slot, quite rude and dismissive, and worst of all she did not seem to know how to handle the sampling. It was evidently her first time drawing bloods for this type of test, so she had to call the lab for instructions several times repeatedly for each step. In the end she could not activate the liquid nitrogen, so the sample shipment had to be rearranged last minute for a pickup, instead of being taken to the post. She promised to phone us to confirm once courier collection would happen, which she never did. Therefore and to this date, we have no knowledge of storage and transport conditions, no tracking reference etc., to be confident that it arrived safely and was transported under acceptable condition. We did receive negative results however due to all chaos have zero confidence in the validity and accuracy, given that the entire process was shambolic. If there were zero stars to award, I would rate this as zero, since even one star is too generous. For a hefty 4-digit price that this test costs, it fails to meet very basic criteria starting from communication, sample handling (no bar codes, manual entries/tube labeling), inadequate handling by untrained personnel, and questionable shipment. Look for a reputable provider that meets basic standards next time.

title: I am rather disappointed with the…
review: I am rather disappointed with the service offered at Goodbody Clinic. I contacted them asking about getting an Episwitch Prostate Cancer test. There were several phone calls with 2 or 3 members of their team during which no advice was given as to the suitability of the product I would buying, no questions were asked of me, no discussion was entered into about the different products they offered. I eventually ended up having to visit their HQ to pick up a testing kit which Royal Mail had lost and meeting 2 of their staff in person. Even then, the only discussion offered was an attempt at reassurance that "this is a really good test!" Before I even had the results back I realised that I had just wasted £900 (and I don't have £900 to waste!) as the test results would include all indolent cancers and I already knew that the chances of having a prostate cancer including indolent ones would be well over 50% for a man of my age. What I really needed was a test that tested for "clinically significant prostate cancers" if such a thing existed....?  Further research revealed that such a test did actually exist. What a surprise then, when I discovered the very test to be available on the GOODBODY website at almost 1/3 of the price of the one I had just bought. I think what I was missing here could be called "customer service". Even a cursory discussion could have saved me a lot of time and money but they seem to be running a box shifting operation here with very little interest in actually helping people!  I wrote to them to advise them of my feelings about this and have had no response, which only goes to support my findings

title: Highly recommend Longevita!
review: I have used Longevita twice now for a breast augmentation and liposuction 2.5 years apart. The service I received both times has been amazing. I felt very comfortable and safe with the care team that supported me. I requested the same surgeon both times - Prof Dr Fuat Yuksel. I felt so at ease, he seemed to understand exactly what I wanted and has done amazing work both times.My breast augmentation has given me such a huge confidence boost, I couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. I was very flat chested prior to this surgery and was extremely self-conscious. I would often get upset with my appearance before going out or not be able to wear what I wanted due to not being able to fill a dress or top. Now, I feel so confident wearing outfits that show cleavage. It really has changed my life. My liposuction hasn’t healed yet as I had the procedure less than 2 weeks ago. However, I have been able to send photos and double check the healing process with my surgeon who has promptly answered all of my questions. The patient co-ordinators have been amazing too! They make each appointment less nerve wracking and make sure everything is explained in a way that you understand. For my most recent surgery, I had Gizem supporting me. Gizem has been supportive, responsive and accommodating throughout my journey. I have never been made to feel stupid for asking questions and have been reassured by the team supporting me. I couldn’t ask for a better experience. Getting surgery abroad can get a bad reputation but honestly, I couldn’t recommend Longevita enough. Following my recommendation, my friend also had a breast augmentation and lift with Longevita and is also extremely happy with her results. Thank you to the whole Longevita team and my surgeon for providing amazing service and giving me confidence in myself.

title: Breast augmentation and uplift
review: The staff at the hospital were the biggest let down for me. They need training on being more friendly and helpful. Shoving your food half way across the room when you've just woken up from a painful operation and can barely move is not nice. The food was absolutely shocking, if I wasn't given the heads up to harm myself with fruit and snacks, I would have starved. Whilst the hospital itself is clean and modern the food and staff let Longevita down. I felt as though I was more of a pain to the hospital staff than a paying patient and at times felt like they didn't even want to touch me.The bandages, anticeptic solution does not last long enough for the amount of time patients have to use it.  Considering the amount of money paid it would help to have enough for four weeks as its not easy to understand what to look for on returning home.I held off on writing this review as I'm aware that once certain companies get your money they stop answering you when you need them. Whilst I haven't been ignored I'm concerned that both me and the girl I met whilst there both have infections in exactly the same spot. Advice given by the surgeon at Longevita totally contradicts info given in the UK. Longevita advising to shower clean, dry and clean and Nurses here saying to keep the area totally dry. It has been said that the surgeon stiched the area too tight. Scary that this happened to two people on the same day. Overall I do believe Longevita are professional I love the way you can contact them via a scheduled appointment. The drivers who collected me for my transfers were lovely and my rep was also polite. I would recommend as I'm already loving my breast despite still having some swelling (which is natural) my  issue is the fact I now have an infection and a hole under my breast, which I'm having to take regular visits to my gp to have it packed and dressed ) Im aware that this will heal eventually) not helpful as I'm back at work and the regular gp visits is a bit of a nightmare. I know parts of my review sounds negative but I would still recommend. Just make sure someone travels with you to avoid relying on the hospital staff too much and hope you don't get an infection.

title: Neutral review stating facts based on my experiences.
review: This review will only state the facts, I will not give my opinions, positive or negative, just share my experience neutrally to help others make an informed choice.First time going there, had hotel and transfers included. Airport transfer is luxury, others are not. Traffic and Turkish timing is a bit chaotic. Hotel was good quality, but distance meant getting caught in traffic A LOT.Noone directly asked about me having COVID before coming over, waited until the pre-op assessment. I have been informed it was within something I signed, but I don't personally remember seeing this. At least, it was not obvious to me. I had COVID about a month before surgery but was not poorly with it. I was told I could not have my surgery. Went with partner who was having teeth done so couldn't just come back home. I was also just have a single crown done which at the time was one third of the UK cost, so had those appointments and tried to enjoy it as a holiday.Enjoyed Istanbul, particularly Kadikoy, Asian side.Had to rebook surgery. This time I booked my own hotel and used Uber as was much cheaper. Went alone as partner had to do childcare this time. Had surgery. Was very nervous. Booked extra night in hospital as was on my own. This meant I was last into the theatre. I was doctor's 4th patient of the day. Considering he then does consultations all evening, the surgeon works a lot and gets little rest. Straight away I noticed one breast was very different to the other. One was higher. Was told it would settle and not to worry. Was in a lot of pain so got my partner to fly out to be with me on day 3. I struggled to go to the toilet and do basic things as I recover slower than most from surgery and have an extremely low pain threshold.The surgeon tidied up a pointy bit of skin I had at the end of a scar from previous tummy tuck surgery, for no extra charge. Doctor changed dressings and checked breasts again on last day. I was concerned about one breast being very different to the other but he said it is just swollen and will be ok. Once I was home and let them recover for 6 months, I could still see the strange shape and position of one breast. I also had one nipple noticeably much larger than the other, on my other breast.I paid £600 ( discounted from £1000) plus flights and hotel and went back to Istanbul for revision surgery, wasn't sure exactly what would be done until I was assessed in person. Was told at the consultation the night before surgery there would be another long scar under 1 breast in an attempt to make them more symmetrical and reduce the size of the larger nipple. The nipple was reduced, however there is a lot of fat behind the nipple since, so it now looks fat while the other looks flat. On the breast being fixed, not much changed, apart from a long scar I now have underneath just this one breast. It is still an unnatural shape. For an idea of what my breasts are like, my RHS breast is a FF cup while my LHS breast is a F cup. Possibly too much fat was taken from the left. It looks that way. The LHS breast projects forward with no finger space underneath, but there is a scar under, whereas the RHS breast sits naturally with fingerspace underneath. I have found it difficult to wear a bikini due to this. My LHS nipple looks normal, while the RHS nipple looks chubby. However, the left no longer feels as obviously higher than the right breast. You can not notice these differences in normal clothes, but the difference is very obvious without clothes on. [Edited: I am not able to comment on other people's experiences]I must mention, although my partner's crowns were put in very close together making it hard to maintain dental heigene, they looked very good and he has been extremely happy with them. From previous dental experience, I'm aware it's hard to create much space between crowns. My crown actually popped out yesterday whilst eating a bagel, but I do have short teeth which makes it harder for the crown to stay in.The dentist we thought would be doing the work did not, but another dentist who worked at the practice did the work on both of us. Please research thoroughly your provider AND surgeon, read possitive and negative and neutral reviews. Take not just negative but also positive reviews with a pinch of salt, and bare in mind the reasons you may find many more positive reviews than others. You can never do enough research! At the end of the day, the service provider can only deal with the service element. The surgeon is the one with your life and your body in their hands. Also try not to have high expectations when having surgery abroad.

title: No wonder no negative reviews, £5000 fine in terms and conditions
review: Horrible company. I first engaged with Longevita on Monday 16th October, having received a quotation for treatment plan via email & then a quick phone call on the same day which they call a ‘consultation’.It’s not a consultation at all - the people at the end of the line are simply a bookings team & know nothing about the procedure itself, so can’t answer questions.Having told them that I’d been referred to them by someone who had undergone a procedure with them, they took the plaudits & failed to make clear that they themselves are not the service provider, and instead a middle man who will book you in with a surgeon/clinic whom you’ve been able to conduct no research whatsoever, let alone speak to.After my ‘consultation’ phone call, I was hurried into paying the deposit & within an hour of my call, whilst busy running my own business, they were messaging me hurrying me to make the payment to avoid losing the booking slot - so I did.At no point had they made me aware of their terms and conditions, so I simply saw this as a holding deposit of sorts. The next day I received their terms and conditions which I was requested to sign, at which point I saw numerous clauses which meant I would never go ahead with this company.Firstly they remove all liability for themselves, as they’re not the service provider, just a middle man. Secondly, they install a clause to ensure nonnegative reviews from customers, with a £5000 penalty for anyone who has mouths the company online or otherwise. Massive red flags.Within 24 hours of being rushed to make the deposit, I contacted them to ask for my deposit back, since they’d effectively breached their own agenda terms by not clearly providing me with the terms and conditions before paying the deposit.They refused my request, which seems utterly ridiculous given that no time/costs would've been incurred within the 24 hour period.I’ll now open a HM tribunal & courts case to get my deposit back from what seems to be a scam artist, meat factory like, business.

May I add the complainants team where amazing took my complaint very seriously and are working internally to make sure they can be more inclusive and I believe that their team wants to be inclusive and understands the importance of this. title: Disappointing experience (inconsistent quality of care).
review: I visited DCT Antalya on 18/12/2023. I chose  this clinic because of the high ratings. Unfortunately, the process was not as smooth and pleasant as I expected. Booking & Organisation: 5/5Excellent communication from DCT before my arrival. They were very thorough, helpful and responded quickly to my inquiries. The appointments were organised well and the drivers were always on time.Initial Consultation (with patient coordinator): 3/5 This felt very scripted and lacked individualised care. I asked them to prioritise the health of my teeth and I wanted options to make them look better. The initial suggestion was 8-10 crowns on my top and 8-10 on my bottom teeth, which I found very strange as my bottom teeth are perfectly healthy. I had to ask for less invasive options, which should have been initially discussed. Not everyone wants a ‘Hollywood Smile’.  Also, there was no enthusiasm from the staff. However, I was happy with the final plan as it was more reasonable. The coordinator answered my questions to a satisfactory degree.Root Canal Treatment: 2/5The initial consultation was followed by my root canal treatment (same day). The root canal procedure was terrible. I will be clear and say that I was not in pain during or after the procedure. However, it was extremely uncomfortable and overwhelming. 1) The dentist did not warn me that he will inject anaesthetics - this surprised me and I couldn’t do anything as the needle was already in my gum.  2) He was very rough in his approach - I know this is an invasive procedure, but at least TRY to be gentle and empathetic when handling my mouth. He did not show any care. I actually developed a small rash which I am certain is from the equipment that he was using as it was rubbing on to the side of my mouth causing a lot of friction (I sent them a photo of this). 3) I was not asked once if I was okay, my neck and jaw were very uncomfortable. The dentist did not speak English well so communicating was difficult, and communication is the most important thing in any treatment. Teeth Preparation: 5/5 This was so much better. It was with a different dentist who was reassuring, explained what he was going to do and communicated very well. The procedure was smooth. I asked him a few questions and he was very helpful. Crown fitting & Overall result: 5/5This was with the same dentist that prepared my teeth. He made some aesthetic adjustments to the crowns. Although the crowns do not completely match my natural teeth, I was expecting this as I have some discolouration in my natural teeth. It definitely looks a lot better than before the treatment which I am happy about. Final thoughts:I am not the only one to make a complaint of this nature. It is clear that they are seeing so many patients which makes the process feel scripted and lack enthusiasm, personalised care and empathy. Customer satisfaction involves the process and results. The results are good, but in my case, DCT neglected the process - which was terrible. There are inconsistencies in their overall care so I would not recommend this clinic.Edit: DCT initially attempted to remove this review and they flagged it as ‘Fake’ even though I had a full discussion about my experience with the operations manager prior to posting this. I have now verified my experience with trust pilot so it was posted. Due to the dishonesty, I’ve reduced the rating from 3 to 2 stars.

title: So many red flags
review: I will give two stars instead of one because my teeth do LOOK good. However, these doctors/dentists are not trained correctly and only seem to care about the look of your teeth versus practicality. They also have horrible communication in office. I went in to get 12-14 teeth total.. during my consultation we discussed 8 top/8 bottom. The oral surgeon seemed great, explained I had a minor crossbite to fix and I said okay. I then went to another room to begin the preparation process and it was an entirely different oral surgeon and somebody I’ve never seen before, which was weird. They shaved my teeth down and put on temps. Only when I got back later that day did I realize they shaved down ALL of my teeth. Literally 25 of them. So without telling me they did 12 top/13 bottom? They changed the price on my final receipt to reflect the same total price I had agreed to but changed the price per tooth from 425 to 325 or something like that. So I essentially got a bunch of teeth for free which is great but still seemed super sketchy and odd? I reached out to them about this and didn’t get a clear answer. They said something about fixing my crossbite and it requiring more teeth. Fine but maybe tell me first? Also when we did the prep work and I was numbed, they hit a nerve that you should be trained to not hit. It’s not a huge deal because in most cases it goes away when the anesthesia wears off but it also sometimes take days/weeks and just simply shouldn’t happen if a dentist knows what they are doing. The entire side of my left face was 100% paralyzed for 12 hrs, even though I was numbed evenly. This is just a small example of not being trained well/correctly. Anyways, it’s been 3.5 weeks now since I got my teeth done. I have emailed DCT a few times regarding my discomfort and pain and know it hasn’t been long but the pain is now excruciating, unbearable and increasing everyday. I’ve seen 3 dentists/specialists here in the US and they have all told me the same thing. “My teeth look good but were not done correctly”. Essentially the way they changed my bite gave me TMJ (a super painful jaw issue) and my jaw/joints are not adjusting. I’ve been taking 6-10 ibuprofen a day just to function. I was super patient, hoping it was just gonna go away and have a high pain tolerance but it’s truly horrible. DCT has been responsive but my only option now is to fly back to turkey and spend thousands more on travel to have them HOPEFULLY* do it right this time. Which I’m not very confident in. I’ve been told it’s not an easy bite adjustment but would require completely redoing a section, if not all of my teeth by two professionals here. Not only am I in pain but very depressed and anxious about the whole ordeal. I don’t trust DCT anymore but also cant pay 50k+ here to try to fix them and can’t live with this level of pain much longer.. so not a great situation. Also frustrating that when I have redo them or fix them, there’s 24 to fix versus the 12-14 I asked for. Much bigger expense and simply not what I wanted or asked for

title: Too many RED FLAGS to ignore!! We thought we had found the right clinic for us..WRONG!
review: We were picked up from our hotel in a private transfer as expected. We were nervous but really excited and had taken two flights to finally arrive. We couldn’t wait to have the straight white teeth we had been dreaming of. When we entered the clinic it wasn’t the warm welcome we were expecting. There was a young local girl behind the reception who barely said hello. She took our names and then handed us a clipboard each with some papers to fill in and sign. Next to the girl was a security guard, I thought how strange? Why would they have a security guard sitting in a dental clinic reception? The clinic was busy with 10-12 people waiting, there was one lady complaining her teeth didn’t line up correctly and were uneven. Another lady crying holding something which looked like an ice pack on her mouth with her husband consoling her. It was bleak and the uncertainty and dread started to set in. The image they portray on instagram of all these ‘influences’ and ‘celebrities’ smiling and laughing drinking their milkshakes without a care in the world it was certainly NOT!! After a while we were called to have our X-rays then sent back to reception to wait, we sat for a good 40 minutes before anyone even offered us a drink. Finally a nice polite guy came over and we asked for water. We nervously waited a little while longer then were called to go for our consultation together. The lady quickly introduced herself, she was some kind of client coordinator and translator and got straight into it bringing up our X-rays. To be honest she seemed off and not really that friendly. I didn't really take a liking to her and considering how nervous and anxious we both were I expected at least some empathy and understanding but there was none. Soon walked in the dentist, again he barely said hello, there was no pleasantries and minimal to no eye contact as he ushered me into the chair and started to examine my teeth. He started to shout out to the lady who was writing things down. Then the same with my partner. Within less than 2 minutes each we were in and out of the chair and the dentist left the room leaving us with the client translator, she then started to tell us what the dentist had said. It all felt so rushed and so careless, how could the dentist just walk in and within two minutes just walk back out and expect someone else unqualified to give us the information and answer our many many questions. My feeling of ´this is wrong´ grew more and more and the red flags kept on coming. We had to take a break from the consultation and catch some air and discuss what was actually happening. They wanted us to not only make a decision there and then but to actually start the long 3 hour session of shaving down our teeth! It was so quick , so careless and overall so disappointing. The decision to go ahead and do something like this is obviously irreversible, life altering and so final but to them it was like it was nothing. Our instincts luckily kicked in and saved us and we declined and walked out the clinic. It honestly felt like they didn't care if we went ahead or not , they seemed to have plenty of customers and they haven't even bothered to contact us since.I'm honestly baffled by all the positive reviews they have because we experience the total opposite. We were so hopeful flying all the way there to put our trust in this company and the level of care was truly shocking and honestly disgraceful. - - - - - - - - -In reply to your pathetic reply :You think less than 10 minutes with a dentist who doesn’t speak your language is acceptable to make a life changing decision?You think it’s ok that he walks in and walks out without even sitting through and answering our many questions face to face? Instead he leaves you with the unqualified assistant to try and answer, you think that’s ok?  Its NOT! It’s dangerous, irresponsible and so unprofessional.Say what you want to save your image but we know what we experienced and we had a lucky escape!

title: Poor after care service
review: I had my initial visit to this clinic 5 years ago and was overwhelmed by the service, following which I left a good review and showed my gratitude to the staff with gifts. I recently returned to their new clinic and this review is to supersede my previous one, which was mis-informed at the time, to express my disappointment with the after service and hopefully give a true representation of what to expect form Dental Center Antalya.Both myself and my partner had the same package with the lifetime warranty and aftercare that this center boasts about.  5 years later, in an attempt to make use of this after care, we booked flights to Turkey for a follow up treatment. Upon arriving to their new clinic, the service and personal attention we had received from our first trip was not matched, making the experience as a whole uncomfortable. Over 5 years, there has been a clear decline in the level of customer service. Although their new premises consist of complimentary drinks from their café, this compromise does not justify the lower standard of care when compared to their clinic in 2015.The reason for our trip was for a checkup following an x-ray done on my teeth in the UK, where my dentist had advised that I should go back to Dental Center Antalya. My partner also had gaps coming through and a crack in one of her crowns. While they were happy to rectify the issues with my partners teeth (replacing front teeth, canine to canine), my personal after service was appalling. They refused to honor their lifetime guarantee, and had given me a quote, even though they had agreed to cover my partners teeth under the same guarantee. When I raised my concerns, they could not justify to me why they could not apply the same service to me as they did with my partner. From sheer frustration, I booked a flight back on the same day, losing out on the money spent for the trip and 5-star hotel.Having returned, I have since received a quote from a Harley Street dental clinic for £6000 to cover the same works and lifetime guarantee. Although this is more expensive, I hope that this review would help advise people in a similar position to myself that this option is cheaper and more convenient in the long run. It saves multiple week-long trips to Turkey which, all in all, would be around 2000 a time. If you are happy to stay in a 1-star hotel or bed and breakfast for the week, then this Dental Center Antalya might be more financial viable, however in light of the additional charges, and considering most people would not want to spend a week in uncomfortable accommodation, a UK clinic would prove more appropriate and convenient. I am not one to go out of my way to write negative reviews, but the purpose of this is to give anyone considering treatment in Turkey an insight into what it entails, and the frustrations you are likely to face, in order to allow you to make a more accurate comparison with any other options you might be considering. Lastly, I would kindly ask Dental Center Antalya to remove my picture from their website as soon as possible, along with my previous review as it does not accurately reflect the current service of the centre.Simon Faherty

title: Beware - almost impossible to cancel subscription
review: I signed up for the watercolor subscription and have no complaints for the quality of the products however there are some unusual penalties to cancel the subscription.   About 4 or 5 months in, I decided that this medium is not for me and I did not like it.  Under the assumption that like other subscriptions I could cancel with notice, I sent an email.  Got a form email back thanking me for making contact and I would get follow-up email from them within a short time.  No follow up emails.  I ended up sending 4 more cancellation request over the next 4 months with the same result.  As my emails became more insistent, I got a different form email asking if I’ve gotten the emails they were trying to send me for the cancelation.  Of course, I had not.   I sent another cancelation notice immediately after I was notified they had, yet again, charged me for another box.  I notified them in the email they could no longer charge me.  I then immediately notified the subscription payment servicer that I did not authorize any further payments.  Craftamo then attempted to charge me the next month.  Of course when the payment did not go through I finally got an email from a person that said that they would cancel my subscription for an additional fee since two upcoming boxes were left.  I have asked for the contract that allows the additional fee and if it’s in there, I will have no choice but to pay it.  I am making this review to let people know that if you sign up for a subscription, make sure you are committed to it because it appears almost impossible to cancel.  And it is definitely expensive to get art supplies you won’t use.  I paint with oils and acrylics and thought it would be interesting to try this but this is not a “try it” subscription service.
