review: I bought an annual subscription to the Emma Lefebvre Watercolour box and paid $628 for the year, an extravagant birthday purchase but I was thinking that would be the entire cost (as with most annual subscriptions). However a month in, I received another bill for shipping and was told that shipping costs would be an additional charge each month and you never quite know how much this charge will be....so far it's gone from $13 to $16. This essentially brings the total cost to nearly $800 for the year. This for a set of brushes, paper, and a paint palette over the course of the year (4 paints each month). Not great value, in my opinion. The brush and paint quality is not to a good standard; the number 8 brush bristles started to split after one use. Not great customer service either---apparently they are not willing to allow me to cancel and receive a refund, even after I contacted within 5 days of receiving the first box and expressing my disappointment. Oh, and I loved the quote from the customer service rep when I asked them to provide the terms of service that explained the extra shipping costs--they told me "look at the website, it's not hard". I tried posting a review on their website, which they refused to publish. So I am going to go through my credit card company to file a dispute.

title: Avoid at all cost.
review: They claim to be ecofriendly even tho they wrap their brushes up to 3 times in plastic. I guess they received complaints because they took their ecofriendliness out of their Instagram bio. A few of my brushes fell apart within not even 5 minutes of using them. A 1€ brush for elementary school children had better quality than the ones that fell apart. So much for their quality checks. They don't reply to complaints unless you take it to social media. I had to make Instagram stories of their products to receive a reaction. I read from another person that her complaint ticket got closed without receiving any help so I feared that I will meet the same fate if I didn't post the story. Their ambassadors are basically their customer service since the actual customer service doesn't reply. They only accept 5 Star ratings on their own site and push their ambassadors to comment under posts of people who had negative experiences how great the products are. If they put as much effort in their service as they put in their marketing they would only get 5 star ratings. When the brushes work, they are fine. For my taste they absorb a bit too much water and don't give back the full amount of pigments. They stay in shape for a long time. The paint on the brushes wood chips quickly. I wrapped washi tape around it because it was uncomfortable. I wouldn't buy again because of my negative experience tho. They could be a good company if they put in the effort.

title: Disappointed with Pets at Home Groomers – Not Suitable for Larger Dogs
review: I took my 6-month-old German Shepherd to Pets at Home Groomers today for a full groom, which was supposed to include a bath, nail trimming, and eye/ear cleaning. Unfortunately, the experience was far from satisfactory, and I’m extremely disappointed with their handling of larger breeds.My dog came back more stressed and aggressive than I’ve ever seen him, almost as if he hadn’t been treated kindly during the session. He was visibly distressed and unable to settle, which is completely out of character for him.I was told the groomers backed off from him because he was growling, barking, and getting nippy, but surely a professional groomer should be equipped to handle such behavior in young dogs. They could have used a muzzle or spent more time bonding with him to calm him down. Instead, they only bathed and dried him in the 50 minutes they had him, leaving the rest of the services incomplete.This isn’t the first time I’ve had issues here. I previously brought in another dog and experienced the same poor handling and lack of care. It’s clear this groomer is not equipped to deal with larger breeds, despite offering services for all dogs.I will no longer be using their services, and I strongly recommend Pets at Home Groomers update their advertising to reflect that they specialize in small dogs. Larger breeds deserve groomers who are patient, experienced, and prepared to handle the challenges that come with working with bigger dogs.

Guess I'll stick to Amazon next time. I have some glue so there's not even much the company could do short of changing their processes and doing better on future orders.

title: Honest Consumer Experience: Don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and money
review: Honest Consumer Experience: Don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and money I am writing this because you should know my experience in dealing with  SwissTimepieces.co.uk, which had an add for a Longines Flagship Heritage Stainless Steel Automatic Mens Watch L47954782 posted on Chrono 24 (the site doesn't sell any products, sellers sell through the site - think ebay). The add was first posted in Octomber on Chrono24. The seller claimed to have the above mentioned watch, and offered fast delivery to my country.I contacted SwissTimepieces.co.uk directly about the watch add. We agreed on the details and the seller sent me a Paypal link to make the transaction. I made the payment for a Longines watch, for 995 british pounds, which the seller claimed to have on sale, in October 2017.After the seller confirmed the payment, the seller said the item would be delivered in 14 days. After some follow-up e-mails, the seller, in an e-mail on the 6th of November 2017, provided a second estimated date for delivery, 4 weeks from then. This delivery date also expired and still no item delivery (not even an estimate date).After some e-mails exchanged, the seller then provided December 2017 as a definitive delivery date. Finally, now very late December, the seller estimates (I highly emphasize "estimates") maybe January 2018 for a delivery date.This is unacceptable behaivour from an authorized English seller of Swiss watches, and for any company. 5 changed delivery dates, and this only after some serious e-mail correspondence from the buyer, is just unacceptable. I have waited a very long time for the item, which has caused me stress and anxiety. I would have never agreed to a "possible" January 2018 delivery, back when I made this transaction, in October 2017.The seller, SwissTimepieces.co.uk, posted the same add in December on Chrono24, claiming to deliver the watch to potential buyers in a few days. When I confronted the swisstimepieces.co.uk about this, they blamed Chrono24 for automated messages or delivery dates calculated automatically. I asked SwissTimepieces.co.uk to call me to talk about these issues. They told me they don't have a phone plan outside the UK. This was a big red flag for me, what business can't afford to call their customers? I just payed them more than a thousand euros. They claim to sell premium Swiss watches. But I digress. I gave the guy the benefit of the doubt, and told the seller I would call him, provided they give me a number to call.This was the second red flag, since SwissTimepieces.co.uk answered back that they don't have a phone line (!!!) and that they do all their "business" by appointement or throught online means.  It was obvious then, for me at least, that I wasn't dealing with a serious seller, who has 1200+ Euros of my hard earned money, and without an estimate on delivery 3 months after I made the order and the payment.I asked SwissTimepieces.co.uk to give me a refund the next day. No answer. So I put the request through Paypal, it escalated to a dispute and the case was forcibly decided in my favor, by Paylpal, and I finally got my money back in January 2018.After this incident, I went through another seller, used Chrono24 Trusted Checkout (which SwissTimepieces.co.uk did not use at that time), and was very pleased with the end result.In conclusion, don't do business with swisstimepieces.co.uk unless you want to waste your time and moneyUPDATE - in regards to the above review I would also like to add the following.Just an few minutes after posting said review,  swisstimepieces.co.uk sent me an e-mail, threating me personaly, asking to remove the review or else they will use my personal data, and call my employer (!), etc. even mentioning the phrase "Do not call my bluff". Of course, my employer, if I have one, has nothing to do with this, if I had any business transaction with said company, it was in my capacity as a consumer. Also, I didn't mention my email in the review, but apparently, they also have no problem in sending me personal messages or threating to call my employer. Wow. I don't think they know if I am employed or not, or who is this supposed employer of mine, but clearly I gave them no such data.I think this is a clear breach of any code of proffesional etiquette.Please take this opportunity to consider doing business with this strictly online "business" .Thank you for reading

title: Bespoke Design Package
review: My partner and I chose to design our engagement ring using the Bespoke Design Package. While we are happy with the finished ring, there were some aspects of the design service that could be improved upon. We were quite apprehensive about ordering a ring online, and not being able to see the final design before purchase. This was one of the reasons why we decided to go with Lily Arkwright as we liked the idea of having a prototype ring to try on. We did find the design process to be a little inflexible and while we could tweak our design numerous times, we weren't able to make significant modifications to our design (we asked to see our setting without the side stones and were told this wasn't possible as this would be going in a different design direction). The renders were also not overly realistic and we were told the setting and band would appear a lot 'chunkier' in the visuals than in real life. The prototype was also only of the band and setting so it wasn't possible to get a good idea of what the ring would look like when the stones were in place. We were not sent any photos of the finished ring prior to it being posted to us. Unfortunately, once we received the ring we noticed that the band differed from the final design we had agreed upon. We alerted customer service to this issue and were able to post the ring back to be altered. While the customer support team handled this matter efficiently, this delay meant my partner had to postpone his planned proposal.

review: I bought the "Fly EO3/E". The quality control of the products is somewhat lacking. The first watch I received had a white piece of dust inside it which was very eye catching. The leather strap broke after just being worn for just an hour. That being said, they sent me a new watch and strap immediately. Unfortunately the watch I received also had a flaw. The reflection on the hour hand was irregular. Like there was some kind of stain on it. Nevertheless they accepted the complaint and replaced the hands. In the end I have to say I'm very pleased with the watch. It looks really good. It ran at about +12s per day but after a quick calibration I got it to run at +/- 1s. Some edges on the watch are a bit sharp, it isn't visible when worn though. The level of finishing is good for the price point. In a perfect world I would also like it to be a mm or two thinner. The leather strap looks great but is a little stiff, for some reason it turned black after a while. Maybe because I bathed in salt water with it.Customer service is 5/5 but the quality control is unfortunately only 2/5 making the whole experience a 3/5. If I would have received the watch I have now from te start, I would give it a 5/5 review.

review: I now regret my previous review.  I bought my watch 18 months ago and reviewed it too soon!  The strap has now failed.  It is a dive watch, with a stainless steel strap and a security clasp to prevent the strap from accidentally opening and the watch coming off.  The security clasp has broken and the strap is no longer secure.  The clasp is beautifully engraved with the enoksen name, yet on contacting Enoksen, they tell me that the strap isn't considered part of the watch and they don't guarantee them - even though they proudly stamp their name on it.  So beware, what you might consider to be a watch is actually only part of the watch. Straps aren't included and there is no goodwill from Enoksen.  If I could submit a photo I would, its a small part but critical.  Update.  I have been asked to remove a member of staff's name, so I have.  The company has been in touch subsequently but the damage is done - it doesn't help when they tell me that the item seems to be damaged and that is probably the cause of the failure.  It is not damaged in any way.  I will respond to them, but I have other priorities that I have to deal with.  The whole thing leaves a sour taste.

title: Lack of planning
review: A group of us attended an evening with Dominic Herbertson and Davey Todd. The evening started well, with good food and conversation with Dominic and the host. Davey arrived a little late, which didn’t dampen the evening too much. However, as the evening reached a point where audience questions were to be answered, everyone in the building of the hotel had to be evacuated. I realise that this is completely out of the control of Duke…however this incident highlighted that there had been no contingency planning in place. It turned out to be a false alarm which is just as well - because no formal‘house keeping’ had been presented at the beginning of the evening and a clear lack of understanding of procedure thereafter was evident. The best that Duke could come up with was to have a photo with the fire engine before re-entering the building to so that the host could sell his book and Dom and Davey on hand to sign a few autographs at the end. Not many of the audience returned… which is largely down to the evening had effectively been ended - even though it wasn’t clear that it actually had. Had a few of the questions been answered by Dom and Davey (there was plenty of time for this) … it would have rounded off a key part of quite an expensive evening, nicely.

title: Hello I bought three opro Gold youth…
review: Hello I bought three opro Gold youth (up to age 10) mouthguards for a child. Now I wanted to fit my eldest son's mouthguard. I did everything according to the instructions and had to realize that the mouthguard did not fit. I have now noticed that the compression cage is the same size as the one on my Opro Platinum Adult. As a result, the mouthguard cannot be properly brought to the teeth or into the right shape. I was told in an email that I should adjust it without cage and try to adjust the mouthguard several times. However, the quality is best when it fits for the first time. I have now started a second attempt and it also went wrong. The product is generally very good, but not suitable for children under 10 years of age. Unfortunately, this realization cost me 50 euros..... Best regards Christof

Balsam Hill's website is easy to negotiate and questions to their contact line are answered really quickly. I was a bit nervous that I might have left it too late to have it for Christmas (I think it was the evening of 18th December) but it arrived at about 2.00p.m. on 20th.In order for an artificial tree to be more eco-friendly than a series of natural trees it has to last a minimum of 10 years, which is a big ask. I really do think that my Balsam Hill Christmas tree will still be going strong in 10-years: if I'm still here, I'll let you know!

title: I am facing Christmas day without any…
review: I am facing Christmas day without any lights on my tree.  I only purchased a new tree last year from Balsam Hill and it was perfect.  I am shocked that only after one use i am faced with a faulty product.  Unfortunately, I made the mistake of purchasing another tree for a different room this year.  I wished that i had tested the durability of these trees.  They are expensive and in my opinion not worth the money.  I should have bought from John Lewis.  I am waiting a response from the company but what can they do two days before Christmas.  If their products had better durability this should not have happened. Something to bear in mind is that if you have prelit trees you could face the same problems, however, after only one use i am shocked that this would happen and quite frankly, this is not acceptable given the cost of a premium product.

title: I wish I could give it zero stars

What they don’t tell you is that also take taxes out of the refund. They advise you that once they have the item it takes 3-5 working days for the money to be returned and then 30days for the money to show on bank statements. My item was returned the beginning of November and I am still waiting on my refund. Contacted them who advised the money had been sent and that the issue is with my bank! Haven’t had any issue with other companies which had been paid in the same way. I have since had to contact my bank to raise a dispute. Not acceptable at all. Do not buy from them especially if you then need to return an item as you won’t see the money.

Turns out their premium garlands, which I saved hard for and expected to become part of our family tradition are such rubbish quality that they won’t guarantee them longer than 1 season. 30 days, that’s all you get. They rolled out a bunch of platitudes, pre-written ‘get lost’ messages and basically refused to entertain me and my sub standard garland. Utterly shameful when they’re overpriced tat Edited after their response - I wrote the review AFTER using your ‘chat’ which was not in the lest bit helpful - put new batteries in and screw in the bulbs. The bulbs aren’t loose, one whole third of my garland doesn’t work. Your solutions? Take it to a light shop. Look at our policy - guaranteed for 30 days only. We can’t help you. Goodbye. Stop trying to pretend you care, you clearly do not and stop trying to pretend you may be willing to help - I have exhausted that option and you are not. Shocking

title: Good until you have a problem
review: I have been attending Thérapie in Eldon Sqaure for nearly a year now for a course of 10 laser sessions which set me back £500.Some of the staff are so lovely, caring and attentive when some of the others not so much. I was going to be a returning customer due to the okish prices and most of the time a great experience however now I will not be. I was due to have my final session of laser today which I was looking forward to as I have seen amazing results over my last 9 sessions however due to a security incident in work I am last minute not able to attend. I called Eldon square right away to let them know and to try and change however I was told due to a 48 hour cancellation policy they cannot move or change my appointment on the system and was given a phone number to call head office to try and change where I was advised the exact same. I appreciate there is policies however not once have I tried to change within 48 hours nor have I never not turned up. This has also annoyed me due to earlier on in my course of laser I had an operation. I was never made aware that I needed to be clear of anaesthesia for 2 weeks before I had another round of laser so a week after my surgery I was due to attend the clinic. I completed the questionnaire 48 hours prior telling them that I had surgery however until I drove into town, paid for parking and turned up I was not made aware I couldn’t have it done that day and they changed my appointment there and then….. I was very annoyed about this due to the time I’d wasted and also money lost on parking and fuel considering I had completed the pre appointment form and it clearly wasn’t reviewed until I attended. I let this go due to being understanding the girls might have been busy and it was overlooked. However therapie have no understanding of other people’s real life problems.So now I am left with not being able to attend my final laser session. Considering I have been a loyal customer and raved about amazing my results have been I’m left extremely disappointed.

title: Feedback on Pricing Changes and Communication
review: I recently visited your London Central location on Wigmore Street for a lip filler treatment with my usual Dr. While the treatment itself met my expectations, I was quite disappointed to learn about your updated pricing policy, where a minimum purchase of 1ml of filler is now required. I had no prior knowledge of this change and only discovered it during my appointment.It is concerning that such significant changes to pricing were not communicated in advance to your patients. Transparency about pricing policies is essential, as it allows your clients to make informed decisions before booking appointments. Learning about the changes during the appointment not only creates an awkward situation but also limits options for patients like myself, who may require less than 1ml of filler.While I understand that businesses must make adjustments from time to time, it is only fair and professional to notify your clients of these changes in advance, whether through email, text, or other forms of communication. This would help avoid misunderstandings and ensure that patients feel valued and respected.I strongly urge you to reconsider how such changes are communicated in the future to avoid frustration for loyal clients like myself. Additionally, I hope you might revisit this minimum purchase requirement to better accommodate patients who prefer smaller quantities of filler.

title: Crappy policy!
review: I’ve been using Therapie Clinic for a while now. I had 3 sessions left on a face and neck package when I bought another 10 sessions during a Black Friday event as they were offering a very good deal. A few days ago I went to book an appointment and saw that the 7 treatments I had left had disappeared. I emailed Therapie Clinic and was told that per their policy, laser treatments had an expiration date of 18months. I’ve used other laser companies before and this the first time hearing that you had to use your sessions within a specific time period. Had I known this I would have requested a refund when I initially purchased the 10 sessions. Having an expiration date for laser treatment is such a silly policy as everyone’s body and the rate their hair grows varies. Consistent laser sessions has slowed my hair growth over time so I only need an appointment every 3 months now. Considering that their website recommends you buy a higher number of sessions as it saves money, it really doesn’t make sense to then put a time limit on the usage of those sessions.  So I’m now out of pocket. To say I’m annoyed and very disappointed is an understatement!So I’ve amended my rating to 3 star as the Thérapie Clinic customer service team got in touch and refunded me back 3 sessions out of the 7 I had on my account. Not a a full refund but I appreciate the gesture

title: I’ve had Botox in the past with other…
review: I’ve had Botox in the past with other providers throughout the years and results have typically lasted for about between 4-6 months despite the normal expected timeframe of 3months.  However, I had Botox to 3areas first week of October and initially I was satisfied with results and I was expecting a follow up appointment for review 2 weeks post treatment but I didn’t hear anything and didn’t complain bc I was satisfied at that particular time.  Today I rang to express my dissatisfaction as I’m almost back to my pretreatment phase and it’s like 2months in.  I was advised that the window of opportunity for review is 2weeks post procedure to which I informed the call operator that I was satisfied at that point but despite not receiving a follow up appointment I wasn’t concerned but based on previous experience from other practitioners I know that the effects should last longer than 2months.  I pointed out the fact that I wasn’t blaming the doctor that delivered my treatment but rather the product that they are using is questionable and ineffective.  I was put on hold as phone operator said he would try to directly contact the clinic but when he came back to me he said that they didn’t answer but he sent em asking them to contact me directly and it would be asap… I unsurprisingly didn’t get the call back.  Other ppl I have spoken with have expressed that they expected results to last 3months but they didn’t.  Has anyone any idea as to what product/ supplier they are using as it may initially seem cheaper but it’s actually not as requires top up months sooner… I hope this helps others

title: Extremely Disappointed with Their Lack of Compassion and Flexibility
review: I am appalled and deeply disappointed with the service I’ve received at Canary Wharf TC. I have been a loyal customer since 2021, but after my recent experience, I will not be returning.I fell very ill this week with a severe chesty cough, which is uncontrollable and causes prolonged coughing fits, and I also developed an infection near my armpit and chest—exactly where I was scheduled to receive laser treatment. Despite informing the clinic in advance (I emailed them at 1 a.m. on Wednesday because I was unable to sleep due to my condition), they insisted I still attend my appointment.I called again the morning of my appointment, coughing heavily, and explained my condition, but they simply told me to wear a mask and come in. Not only was this dismissive of my health concerns, but it also ignored the fact that my uncontrollable coughing would significantly disrupt the treatment process, prolonging the session unnecessarily and risking the health of their staff and other clients.What’s worse, they refused to reschedule my appointment because of their 48-hour policy, even though I notified them as soon as possible and did everything I could to communicate my situation while being unwell. This complete lack of empathy and understanding is unacceptable.To make matters worse, I have severe anxiety when traveling with a cold or cough, which has been an issue from COVID times. I have always made my appointments, and this is the first time I have been unable to attend due to health reasons. Yet, the clinic showed no flexibility or consideration for my circumstances. After this experience, I will be seeking laser treatment elsewhere, such as Laser Clinics, where I hope to receive a better standard of care and professionalism.I would not recommend this clinic to anyone who values a service that considers their health and well-being.

description:
Just Bee Vitamin Honey. Delicious Pure Honey Supercharged with Vitamins. 

Looking for a daily immune boost?

Our Vitamin Honey is supercharged with Vitamins D, C, B6, B12 and Echinacea.

Each teaspoon contains 25% of your recommended daily allowance of these vitamins which help support your immune system. And you'll love the mellow and sweet flavour.

Just Bee was inspired by co-founder Joe's family, who have a long history in beekeeping. Joe’s dad is a beekeeper in Lancashire and his grandad was a beekeeper before him in Ireland. Back in 2014, we started with a very simple idea – to create great tasting and healthy products using honey and to save the bees. This is still true today and now we work with beekeepers across the UK, Europe and New Zealand to source the highest quality honey. 

It’s really important that our products help save the bees. did you know one in every three mouthfuls of food we eat relies on plants being pollinated by bees? And over the past few years there has been a global decline in bee populations, including here in the UK.

Well, we’re determined to do something about it and we need your help!

All our honey orders come with a free packet of bee saving flower seeds.

But I also read that scientific advice is that you should not use valerian as a long-term treatment for chronic sleep disorder.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: The phone never gets answered you have…
review: The phone never gets answered you have to wait for a call backKong wait for delivery.Wine choice is excellent

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: I'm not a big wine buyer so picked…
review: I'm not a big wine buyer so picked Majestic hoping for some friendly introduction. Unfortunately, the store guy mostly ignored me and in the end didn't even have a simple card carrier for six bottles of wine, the sort you get in supermarkets. The wine itself seemed reasonably priced and most of my picks were good due to the useful notes around the store, despite the absence of in-person help. I have now switched to the Wine Society although I don't rule out giving Majestic another try in the future.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Lack of flair in staff
review: It’s a shame that the enthusiastic youngsters that really ‘made’ Majestic are long gone. The current replacements are ok but don’t seem to know their wines or recommend or do anything with flair. Luckily, I know what I want. The days of Johnny ringing me to tell me of a bin-end of good claret, reasonably priced, are long gone, so I fear is the magic of Majestic (since the Naked Wines disaster) - now no different from Waitrose Cellars or Sainsburys

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Mixed experience
review: Using the local branch in person is fine with really helpful staff. The downside is very limited parking and if the handful of spaces are full there is nowhere else to park so you turn round and go home.I’ve ordered for home delivery before but the last time there was a problem with payment meaning my card was blocked. The account  section of the website is very poor and having just had another go have decided to leave it.Have you thought about using Shopify which is brilliant. As for using Yodel to deliver wine from the main website, no chance.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Loyal customer feeling peeved.
review: I buy probably 75% of my wine from Magestic.Have never had a bad experience with the wine. However i am annoyed that i bought 12 bottles of monopole champagne 3 weeks ago on offer only to find it on offer again  at a lower price, I could have saved myself £48 if i waited. Feels unfair bought for Christmas before the  rush as advised, paid the price!

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: They don’t offer tastings when you go in of already opened wine when you are spending.
review: The sales experts have Good knowledge. I spend a fair amount of money ordering 6-12 bottles a time. But i notice when i go in. I never get offered what they have for tasting. After all how do they expect to sell new wine if they can’t offer an already opened bottle for a taste…

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: A new Majestic outlet in Crouch End
review: A new Majestic outlet in Crouch End! Walking distance from home and an overdue replacement for the defunct Oddbins. The annoying locked door involving a “shall-we-let-this-person-in” procedure is I guess a symptom of the times, although it immediately makes you feel that you have to justify your presence, unlike say next door Waterstones where you can browse aimlessly.  Visually the store is a sensation - great lighting, cool on-trend colours, the ambience is spot on. It’s a destination! My gripe is not about the quality of wine, that seems pretty excellent but the quality of the sales assistants. Its 50-50 as to whether you are met by someone really helpful or someone who is arrogant and downright rude. In the latter case the attitude seems to be “I’m far too clever and overqualified to be here, wasting my time serving, I should not be dealing with someone who can’t even pronounce “Viognier” correctly - now get out”.On one occasion (not the Crouch End branch) I ordered six bottles of white plus a 20-year-old port, the assistant proceeded to cut a hole in the top of the wine box and ram in the upside-down bottle of port like it was a nail.I do not like the “do we have your profile” question (euphemism for your sales history). Why can’t they just say “your details”. As the postcode is typed in you can sense them sneering at the paucity of orders on the largely blank screen. No further eye contact with you Sir!Maybe I should get out less, decouple myself from the retail experience and order online.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Great store, terrible delivery
review: Love the store and the wine. However as they were out of stock for the wine I wanted I ordered online and chose “nominated day delivery” for Monday. Yodel finally delivered on Thursday…This is really not good enough.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Alluria Pinot Grigio Terre Siciliana in…
review: Alluria Pinot Grigio Terre Siciliana in a box - tastes wrong and not at all pleasant. Will try to use it for cooking.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Staff are helpful
review: Staff are helpful; but I resent them pestering me for name and address when I buy wine. Majestic sell me wine- I give them money. That’s the deal.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Some issues with staff at Tenterden branch which spoilt experience
review: I used Majestic Wine Tenterden for my wedding earlier this month and on the whole we had decent service. Good wines, an excellent tasting session in the Brighton branch, free delivery and free glass hire. Things to mention is that they do not pick the glasses up and they need to be returned clean - this can make for quite a stressful day after the wedding.The main reason they lost stars however was one rude employee when dropping the glasses back. It's a £1 per glass deposit which you should get back when you return them clean - for the number of glasses required for a wedding that is a lot of money and a big task for the next day but we did it in a timely manner. This employee tried to give us grief due to water damage to the extremely poor quality cardboard boxes that the glasses came in and refused to return £50 of our deposit due to that damage even though the glasses had been returned clean. Basically charging £12 per damaged box saying they could not use the glasses that were in them - although they were happy to keep all those glasses anyway. This was clearly ridiculous - she was rude and unreasonable and we just went round in circles with the argument so I left.On emailing the branch a more reasonable member of staff refunded us the money so it was all resolved pretty quickly which I appreciate. However, it did add an unnecessary amount of stress to what was already a busy and stressful day when we were desperately trying to hold onto some of the joy from the day before. And I needed to email and call them to organise the refund whilst on honeymoon. When planning a wedding I cannot emphasise enough the importance of good communication and smoothness of the providers - people being kind, understanding and reasonable goes a huge way when you're dealing with so many providers for such a big event. Unfortunately, even though the service was provided, some of that smoothness and communication was lacking and for that reason I probably wouldn't recommend them for use at a wedding or large, stressful event. I hope that they can provide some training to their staff to ensure that they treat their customers better and that they are better representatives of Majestic Wines.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Dementing Website.
review: The real live experience would be a 5+ but the website experience is most definitely a minus, hence my miserable mark. Don't waste a MOMENT on the website, would be my advice - it's just awful unless you are ordering to your own home and never want to send a present or to anywhere else.  Even the poor staff on the telephone can't get the brute of a site to work properly - by the time you've grappled with the system, you'll need enough booze to anaethetise you and I can only imagine that this is the intention.  Great staff, great selection, THE WORST website.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Great value wine and fizz, but…
review: Great value wine and fizz. They offer four nice glasses if you spend £125. Spent £700 but said only four glasses. I could have split the order but didn’t envisage they’d be so mean given the amount I was spending. Leaves a bad taste.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: We want to taste the wine before committing
review: Whilst happy with the actual shop, we had a quote of roughly £740 for 1/2 white, 1/2 red for a wedding, but weren't given the opportunity to actually taste the wine. And so we went elsewhere. Such a shame when the order was guaranteed if the wine tasted ok. Hopefully this comment will be taken as constructive criticism and a way to move forward with the business.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Wrong champagne- again!
review: I just collected my wine order from Majestic Muswell Hill, London N10.I ordered 3 bottles of Nicholas Feuillatte Vintage 2012/2015, however for the fourth time my box contained Grande Reserve instead of 2012/2015. I asked to check the box having had previous experience  of the wrong champagne being delivered or collected and yet again it was Grande Reserve instead of 2012/2015. It was not just at the Muswell Hill store that this happened,  it also happened at the Gosforth store. This seems to be a deliberate policy of substituting a lesser wine.I would like to know what you are going to do about this.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: I’ve spent over an hour setting up my…
review: I’ve spent over an hour setting up my online account and trying to buy a case of wine as a gift. I’ve now given up. The website is poor and keeps asking me to complete my address even though it was automatically downloaded using their postcode finder. Life is just too short. The local Newmarket store and staff are excellent, but the website has cost me too much time and you your profit on the sale.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Wanted to buy 6 bottles of Elysium…
review: Wanted to buy 6 bottles of Elysium dessert wine. Popped into local store before Christmas only 5 available but told they would be able to get extra bottle in after New Year. Popped in yesterday now only 3! Then told they can only get additional stock from other stores but would not be going and that from ware house would take weeks. No offer to phone and see if other stores had it and I would have gone and got it. Have now sourced on Amazon and spent (after my experience) over £1000 at another wine merchant.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Online order experience
review: Placed a mixed 12 bottle order more than a week ago, as I didn’t hear anything about my order, called them today to find out, said they don’t have wines I ordered (any of them!! bit unbelievable tbh), anyway they cancelled the order to refund me, disappointed to be honest I needed wines for this week, I would have expected they could have informed me this sooner without waiting for me to inquire why didn’t I get my order after a week!PS: I appreciate Jonathan calling me back and trying to find out what happened! Thank you.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Grumpy manager at Westbury branch
review: Grumpy manager at Westbury branch. again the manager was clearly too busy to give more than cursory answers to honest questions. Not made at all welcome and not the first time-puts me off going there. Fortunately there is another branch in Bristol so will go there instead next time.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Not what I am use to here
review: I am  a big fan of the store where the wine selection and staff attitude is usually excellent. However, at lunchtime today my husband and I entered the store to buy a selection of wine, and although received a friendly welcome, loud rock music was playing in the background which was very distracting and not conducive to a calm shopping experience. We tried to ignore it but eventually found it too much so left the store without purchasing anything. I wouldn’t complain but I had the strong impression the music was being played for staff pleasure  alone.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Poor online ordering experience
review: I've been a Majestic customer for many years. I lost my local one and now do occasional orders over the internet for delivery. I ordered some items on the website on Wednesday for Christmas.The first issue I noticed during the ordering process was a default selection on an "accept substitutions". I certainly didn't want any for my wine and I missed unticking the default of yes the first time I was preparing my order. That needs to either be more clear or have a default of no. I can see other people ordering some beer for an unimportant event might want this, but I don't. I think some sites offer per product substitution.The order acknowledgement email appeared with a vague delivery date range of 1st to 6th. I thought checking my account on the website would help narrow this down but that gave and still gives "We're sorry, an unexpected error occurred" if I view my order.I phoned the shop once and they said it was due to go out on Friday. It's Friday and I haven't received any emails or SMS to tell me to expect a delivery. I called them again (Friday 3pm) just to check it was on its way - it is so I just had to wait around at home.Just after 5pm the delivery turned up. The delivery guy had already spotted one bottle was missing, fortunately. Unfortunately, I've now go to hang around for another day for the missing bottle.I like Majestic but this isn't a great ordering/delivery experience. This low standard might have been common 30 years ago but it isn't acceptable anymore, more so for a high value delivery. I like that I can phone them and speak to someone quickly but it's not always efficient and it would be nice if the website just worked so I didn't need to do that. If there were delivery notifications the day before and on the day that would be useful.There were also 2 out of stock bottles on a mix-six offer. It would have been good to have some way to efficiently order those as part of my order. All of this is a cue to try elsewhere next time.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Online order
review: Ordered champagne online via the website. Local store had none in stock so delivered a different brand (I had said no substitutions). Now having to arrange for them to uplift before I can get a refund. Very poor.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: I ordered 96 bottles of Bouvet which were not delivered.
review: I ordered 96 bottles of Bouvet on line on 25th August. on my return from holiday they had not been delivered.After two phone calls to my local Majestic (Abingdon) they were delivered today 21st September.Not very good...but usually delivery is much much better.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: One for the price of two
review: Purchased two cases of beer for a party. Paid £8.99 for special delivery to ensure they would arrive on time. However only one case arrived. The other is still not here, but it is too late now anyway and no longer required. This is my first experience of Majestic and can’t say I am particularly impressed. Unlikely to use them again.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Don't believe Majestic's next day delivery promises
review: I ordered some champagne for my sister-in-law's birthday. It was on the Tuesday after a bank holiday so, to be sure it would arrive on time, I ordered on Thursday evening and paid £8.95 for Saturday delivery. It was emblazoned all over Majestic's site that if I ordered by midday on Friday I could get next day delivery. Confirmation email said Saturday delivery confirmed.When did it arrive? The following Thursday, a week after I ordered. No update until the Thursday morning so I was not even aware that the present would arrive late until it had missed her birthday. Majestic refunded the delivery cost (hence 2nd star) but offered nothing else. I would not have ordered from them had I known the delivery would take so long. Don't believe their next day promises!

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Majestically Minging Wines
review: This is the second time in about four years I've been to Majestic and my experience both times was disappointing. I get far better wines from the main supermarkets for a lower price. On the last visit (February 2023) I bought a Californian Zinfandel (Majestic's own). I was told it was not excellent, at about £10 per bottle but very drinkable (meaningless comment). It turned out to be pretty horrible (high tannins, bitter, oily) like a bargain basement supermarket red wine for £2.99. Then I also got a bottle of Beef Steak red wine, also for about £9.99. It was totally undrinkable - like vinegar. I used it for cooking. They may have better wines but you have to buy them six at a time to make them as reasonable and good quality as supermarket wine in the price range £8-£14. Given the minging quality of the two I bought from Majestic I am not willing to take a risk on six or suffer the BS of their sales pitch.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Non-Existent Customer Service
review: Although an apparently simple task, Majestic Wine have failed to provide an invoice for my recent order. It may seem a minor matter but it is essential to me for accounting purposes. The central Customer Support Centre has not even acknowledged receipt of my latest email.The local store is outstanding and deliver really promptly but I will be placing any future orders with a supplier which can provide invoices!9th December - Information requested by Majestic has now been provided.10th December - Invoice received from Majestic together with an apology which is greatly appreciated but it is a real pity that I had to post on Trustpilot before I could get any sort of response.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: It's nice exploring a range of wines…
review: It's nice exploring a range of wines that can't all be found in supermarkets, and usually in person service is friendly. Almost every time I visit the Cambridge branch, though, I find an error with displayed pricing v on the Web. They always say it's hard to keep up with the price changes, but I have seen the same error displayed several days apart....It goes with the territory that you keep visible prices up to date, and supermarkets have far more of these to cope with but generally manage much better.The Cambridge branch also needs to bother to ring back if you leave an enquiry on their ansaphone. I phoned early in the evening, Saturday, when I know they were still open.I've now phoned again, Thursday, and the phone was picked up, but no apology for not having got back to me. They do need to remember better manners and lower themselves to do the ordinary boring jobs: correcting labelling; ringing back to answer queries; saying "sorry".Updated:I don't expect the manager to take advantage of carrying wine back to the car to "have his say" about my feedback. All too common an approach to criticism from stores these days. The customer is no longer always right, it seems.Just a litany of excuses. Spoiled what had otherwise been a pleasant evening. I won't be using Majestic again.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Lesser substitute wine - promised refund didn't appear
review: I was using Majestic for the first time having for many years bought from another supplier. I didn't spot that the default for online orders is "allow substitutions" (that surely should be flagged up more obviously) and indeed a substitution did occur. But the wine that was substituted came from a different area, with a different grape, a different producer, a different vintage (and a low approval rating from Majestic's own customers) - and to cap it all was a cheaper wine than I'd paid for when priced at the "mix six" (which I had used). I contacted Majestic and they promised a partial refund would be made. A month later no refund has appeared.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: missing bottle
review: generally pretty good but just got a delivery with a missing bottle of wine and the packaging was pretty haphazard.Not great getting scammed out of a full bottle

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: I always thought of Majestic as a blue…
review: I always thought of Majestic as a blue chip company but I have discovered otherwise.  I signed up to a quarterly subscription with their wine club for my husbands birthday and received the first box within about a couple of weeks.  We then had a second box left in our porch about 3 weeks later and the fee for it taken from our account.  We were away and it was just fortunate that my son was staying and spotted it.  I rang Majestic and asked why I'd had two boxes delivered and two payments taken within such a short space of time.  They advised that I had set up the subscription right at the end of one quarterly period so the first box was from the end of the first quarter and the second box was from the second quarter.   I advised that we didn't want the second box so close to the first and we wanted them three monthly as per the subscription we'd signed up to.   It took over 2 weeks for them to collect the box and they wouldn't refund the money they'd taken until they'd collected the box.  I had to chase the collection several times and then chase the refund.  I was promised calls back buy they never materialised. The next delivery was due mid August but I have just had an email from them saying the delivery is delayed due to severe weather conditions and we can expect it in September.  The shine has now completely gone off the gift.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Ridiculously unreliable deliveries
review: I ordered some wine for a good friend as a Christmas present. I placed the irder on the 16th December. The automated email I subsequently received said that the wine was to be delivered by Yodel, a tracking button provided and the message said Yodel would email me. The tracking button did not do anything. I never got the promised email from Yodel, and my friend did not receive the Christmas present. Now, 10 days after I paid for this wine, Christmas day has passed, there is still no news of my wine, no tracking information either.It astounds me that Majestic Wine still use Yodel as their courier. They are rated as the worst UK courier by far, and are undoubtedly impacting Majestic Wine's reputation. I will no longer use Majestic Wine, which is a shame as they have some great wine at very good prices, but that's no good if you can't get it delivered within a reasonable timescale. I have heard similar complaints from colleaguesand friends. This is not the 1st time Yodel have failed to deliver my Majestic Wine, but it will be the last....

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Disappointing tone
review: I recently visited my local Majestic store to purchase a regular "lock-it-in" wine. When I mentioned the price I had in mind, I was abruptly told it was completely incorrect and outdated, with a dismissive tone suggesting I should check my account more often.Hoping for a better experience, I asked for a wine recommendation to pair with a specific dish. However, the staff member admitted they didn’t know what the dish was and suggested I ask someone else instead.Given my loyalty to Majestic over the years, I have never felt so undervalued as a customer. Providing quality service is a fundamental part of their role, and I expected far better from the team at this store.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Very poor service
review: Ordered wine exceeding £200. Promised a delivery date but then a day before the due date I was advised that delivery delayed. Contacted customer service who advised that delivery should be within 24 hours. Nothing received! Contacted customer service again but received little help. Wine eventually arrived 3 days late but no mention of any compensation from customer service. Much better service received from other wine companies.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Deceptive pricing
review: Deceptive pricing. All wines are displayed with a price that seems reasonable yet when you get to the checkout you are charged considerably more because the price displayed is actually the price per case of six. The lighting is dim and I didn't see the small print which must've been somewhere. To be fair, the sales assistant did mention this just before I paid however I didn't want 'the walk of shame' and have to drive to Tesco's to get the same bottle for four quid less. If it had been an expensive bottle I would have been a bit annoyed. One star because of deceptive practice. Won't be going back.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Terrible delivery.
review: Delivery itself was absolutely appalling. I ordered this as a gift (not that majestic knew this). The driver arrived today and presented a box to my husband saying: here are your sweet wines. On top of this the box was an old recycled shabby broken box that wasn't even sealed. I would at least have expected the box to be sealed but instead all the bottles were rattling around in an open shabby box.There was no indication that the delivery would be like this. That the wines would be delivered in an open old recycled pinot noir box. At least seal the box so that the contents are not visible to everyone and the items are protected. Appalling delivery. Ruined the surprise for my husband. Ruined the shopping experience for me. I won't be buying from Majestic again. I'm so disappointed - and they charged me for this shoddy delivery.If they have a policy of recycling in unsealed broken boxing, customers should be clearly warned. These wines were part of a gift to be repackaged, so I did not anticipate having to mark them as a gift. Let customers know how you will be sending out your wines, like other reputable wine suppliers do.DO NOT order from here if you expect professional well presented wines on delivery.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Majestic patronising and did not listen to customer - horrendous delivery issues
review: Majestic patronising and did not listen to customer - horrendous Yodel delivery issues - Wasted hours waiting in the house. Unbeknownst to me before purchase Yodel only tell you what day they are coming - then it's a 15 hour time slot and they only tell you the 2 hour time slot on the day they are coming but they didn't tell me until after midday that it would be an evening delivery so I had  to be in all morning anyways ?? Then off their own bat Yodel only delivered a partial order - this may be a health and safety issue to do with liquids but Majestic/Yodal should inform the customer of this issue before purchase. If I'd known I had to suffer 2 Yodel deliveries I would've gone elsewhere. Yodel said they were going to deliver the part order but they failed to do so (I had waited in for a further 2 days for it!).   Although I informed Majestic that Yodel told then me "contact sender - order has been returned to sender" (I also sent Majestic a link and a copy in writing of the Yodel tracker message) they did not believe me and told me it would be there that day which it wasn't. - In the end the local shop had to deliver part of the order instead of Yodel - it was an imposed time slot and they did not stick to it - just as well I made sure I got back home early as I anticipated they would not stick to the time slot. They also  said they had cancelled the order that was with Yodel as if they were doing me a favour - patronising in the extreme (Yodel had already cancelled the order). Chap told me they spend a lot of time sorting out Yodel deliveries - so if you know it's a common issue don't patronise your customers when they tell you Yodel is a problem. Much of the wine I bought was ordinary party wine which I could have got in Iceland (free delivery) or supermarkets such as Asda who have a 1/2 hour time slot which you can choose for yourself before point of purchase (also the Asda price was nearly as good as the Majestic price). Majestic used to be brilliant but not now.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: First & Last Visit
review: What an awful experience I've had at Chester branch. I'm a first time visitor to Majestic Wines and selected two bottles of wine that I thought were priced at £7.99 each. When I checked out it came to £23.98! I queried the price and the member of staff was a bit off with me explaining that's the price if you buy more than one. This wasn't clear to me. I'd already tapped my card but then on realising the error I asked to be reimbursed. Again, the staff member was off and seemed irritated by my request.As a first time visitor to MW, I'll make this my one and only visit. I wouldn't go back because of this staff member's attitude.I rang the store asking where my money was because it hadn't been credited within an hour and again, she was off with me Terrible customer service 🤬

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: STOP USING YODEL!!!!!
review: Yodel spectacularly failed to deliver a crate I ordered for a family visit that I needed for tonight.  They're only here today for 2 days.  Yodel have been dreadful - they delivered to the wrong address and by the time I got to the wrong address an entire hour later someone had taken it - the resident family are Muslim, don't drink and swear they could not find it.  I rang Yodel who were utterly appalling, swear they had no photograph or sign-off and refused to help me and suggested I contact Majestic instead.  To be fair I contacted Repkeyne at Majestic who strangely enough gave me a photograph and told me that Yodel considers deliveries successful if they land within 158 feet of the actual destination!!!!!  This was more like 500!  I am still waiting on my delivery which by the time it comes to me my visitors will be gone and I am so very let down that I had to fight and investigate for this.  While I appreciate Yodel are not part of Majestic it completely reflects on Majestic's product delivery and customer service and they have been repeatedly found to be disgraceful.  In fact Repkene told me there was another order of 1500 bottles urgently needed for an event lost by Yodel twice!!!!  This is a disaster - terminate your contract with them NOW and use somebody competent!Update 7 Dec: a very helpful chap named Daniel rang me at 9am apologising for the entire experience and organised a delivery fee refund and a new box which arrived at noon.  This was a great response but it's really evident Yodel are a huge problem and are massively letting Majestic Wine down, especially at this time of year.  Kudos and thanks to Daniel it's been sorted.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Awful first time experience
review: Awful first time experience. Ordered wine as a wedding gift on 1st September. Yodel broke the first delivery, lost the second, and the third order Majestic forgot to add the gift message! Took three weeks to finally arrive... and the wedding has been and gone. Got my delivery charge refunded and the email response was littered with spelling errors and typos. Clearly not customer care anywhere!

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Avoid home delivery unless you're home 24/7
review: Ordered 12 bottles on the website. Now it used to be that a local branch would ring you within 48 hours and arrange a delivery slot. Now you are told it will be delivered within a week. I got mine two days after order saying the wine would be delivered in a few hours time and that they would leave it on the doorstep if nobody answered the door. I live in a busy road - so that's a pain. When it turned up it was only half the order. Nowhere does it say that it's only part of the order or where to find out if the delivery company have got it wrong. Had to look it up and then find a way to contact Majestic. Their answer was pretty vague - I can expect the rest of the order in 6 days but no sign of when that might be. Just too much hassle for somebody who isn't home all the time. Shame because they do have some nice wine. But I'll go back to The Wine Society.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Not a good experience at all
review: Always quite liked Majestic, particularly their in store service however my latest experience wasn't good. On Sunday I ordered over £240 of drinks from them for next day delivery as we had a birthday celebration last night. Yesterday when they were due I get an email saying the deliveries would be a day late! I am ok with the odd hiccup but it didnt stop there, today I get the delivery and there are 6 bottles of wine missing, when I go on the Yodel site it simply says they have it at their depot but can't deliver it and have told Majestic. I take the £70 bottle of Japanese Whisky out to find the lid has been torn off the packaging so I won't be able to display it in my Whisky case as was planned! So don't deliver when promised, then dont deliver all the items and deliver expensive items damaged, not good at all and what is most disappointing is the total lack of communicationAn update - they sent a replacement case today - it was damaged so the courier didn't even get it out of his vanA total shambles

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Nonsence and they don't give a dam*
review: Tried to buy over £140 of wine to use a £20 voucher. The voucher was not valid against fortified wines. The branch manager told me that the system was classifying sauterne (sweet bordeaux wine) as "fortified" such as port and sherry. This was obvious nonsence but the manager (after trying to argue that it was fortified wine) could not overrule the system. I didn't place the order and rang up customer services the next day. Agent didn't have authority to wash tea cups but accepted my requirement that the customer services manager (Charlie) give me a call. 24 hours later still no call. Majestic demonstrates both incompetence and contempt of customers. Do they care?

review: What is going on at Majestic Wine?I’ve bought at Majestic since they first opened in London.  My local Ludlow store is brilliant. description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.
title: Saturday evening went to Majestic to…
review: Saturday evening went to Majestic to buy some wine chose our six bottles and took them to the counter whereupon two girls come in and start asking the staff member questions and he lets them try some wine while we stand there. He then proceeds to help them with all their questions and demands while we stood there waiting he couldn’t do enough for these ladies who also didn’t acknowledge we were there before them. At no point did he acknowledge us make eye contact even though we were the first customers. Just really terrible impolite service so we had no option but to leave after standing there for over 5 minutes.

description: The UK's biggest and best wine retailer offering online ordering with free delivery, award-winning service and market-leading deals.

God knows what we’ll get, if anything. Thinking it’s a scam. So beware.

You then go to your local Majestic Wine shop who confirm they sell that wine....but only to commercial customers 😱🤯🤔, honestly, why do you have such a stupid rule. The customer is obviously not always right at Majestic, who have now lost a customer wanting to spend money with them. Beyond belief in these trying times when you would think businesses would want to sell to customers 😟

description:
Beer52 is the UK's most popular craft beer club, based right in the historic heart of Edinburgh, where brewing has a long and rich tradition which we’re proud to be a part of.

 
Each month we send you out a carefully, curated case of the finest craft beers to enjoy - tailored to your tastes and sourced from the best independent microbreweries from around the world. 

 
In a nutshell, we’ve made it our mission to build and foster a community of people who’re just as passionate about craft beer as we are, we’re committed to finding the world’s best craft beers and broadening your beer horizons with some unique and exciting flavour profiles, straight to your door!

 
You’ll get to enjoy a few extra goodies each month too! Come behind the scenes at the world’s most exciting breweries each month with your included issue of Ferment magazine, join us as we travel the world, navigating the exciting world of craft beer, with some snacks for good measure.

 
 
For more information, see our FAQs: https://www.beer52.com/faq


Or if you need to get in touch then please reach out to us via https://www.beer52.com/help


 
Winner of SIBA: Best Independent Beer Retailer of the Year 2016, Winner of Business of the Year 2016 at Startups.co.uk. Winner of Buchanan Awards: Overall Business of the Year 2016 and Growth Business of the Year 2016
title: Friendly, relaxed and helpful service
review: The person I spoke to to cancel, Andrew, was really friendly and relaxed. He was up front about seeing if he could persuade me to stay but it was very non-pressured which I always appreciate, it makes me more open to hearing the offers. I've always had very good customer service from this company. They do offer really good deals but if you do want to cancel it's easy to do and they don't mess you around at all. (I've left and come back before).

Each month we send you out a carefully, curated case of the finest craft beers to enjoy - tailored to your tastes and sourced from the best independent microbreweries from around the world. 

 
In a nutshell, we’ve made it our mission to build and foster a community of people who’re just as passionate about craft beer as we are, we’re committed to finding the world’s best craft beers and broadening your beer horizons with some unique and exciting flavour profiles, straight to your door!

 
You’ll get to enjoy a few extra goodies each month too! Come behind the scenes at the world’s most exciting breweries each month with your included issue of Ferment magazine, join us as we travel the world, navigating the exciting world of craft beer, with some snacks for good measure.

 
 
For more information, see our FAQs: https://www.beer52.com/faq


Or if you need to get in touch then please reach out to us via https://www.beer52.com/help

title: I’m not continuing - but it’s a great product
review: I took 3 deliveries/cases. The literature was very informative and the company obviously care about their sourcing and product and I like their values. Some beers aren’t to my taste - but that’s partly the point of trying a variety case. The product is good, well priced and it’s all well managed. I just couldn’t manage getting through the beers and I’m cutting back on my alcohol more widely. Seems odd to recommend something I’ve stopped but I’m pleased with what I had - and if you like to try varied beers with a well organised, fairly priced and thoughtful set up, this beats more mainstream offers hands down.

Definitely a premium product but you get what you pay for.Although I called just after lunchtime and queued for a while Mia (who was great) made it very easy to cancel, just wanted a bit of quick feedback and I was more than happy to stay on their mailing lists, just wasn't the right deal for me right now.  The subscription is very flexible though.

title: Introductory box

The beers came quickly and are a great Christmas present. I only wanted this box and not the subscription, so went online to cancel, however you do need to call them to cancel. title: The beer is great but the cancellation…
review: The beer is great but the cancellation process sucks. The good: The Beer selection is great, the orders and the snacks are good. It's a service I enjoy and was pleased to pay for. What could be better: Pricing wise, it's a little steep so I was always having to weigh up if it was something that I could afford. I do believe the service represents value for money, it's just very much on the 'treat' scale for me. The cancellation process is a pain in the Bum. It's clearly designed to send you through several screens with the cancellation button designed to be the hardest option to click. At the end of that journey you are directed to call and speak to an agent, who then tries to persuade you to stay. The agent I spoke to was great, really helpful and quite understanding when I gave my feedback. However, the whole cancellation process took approx 20 mins, which would put me off ever returning, knowing that I have that many hoops to jump through.

title: Product ok, well discounted but hard to cancel
review: Bought subscription for Beer and Wine with a special offer. Pleased with the products I received. However thought I’d already cancelled but 2nd boxes turned up over Xmas. Put that down to experience but it’s pretty tricky to actually cancel as you cannot do it online. You have to call, wait in a queue and only between 0900 and 1700 Mon-Fri which is very inflexible. I have to say it feels deliberate to make it as difficult as possible to cancel. Lady was polite enough but kept trying to tell me all these things to keep me to stay but I just wanted to cancel!!! That’s annoying and disappointing customer service. Eventually she did as I asked but I would hesitate about getting involved with them again as a result. I’ll stick to Laithwaites where there’s no subscription and I can buy as much or as little as I want, when I want and with no pressure.

title: Great value & service, but has deceptive patterns that may be hard for some
review: Beer52 provides a great quality & value craft beer service. While I don't drink myself, I'm told that their beer is really tasty and has a good variety. The snacks and magazine included in the subscription box are a really nice touch. I've purchased their subscription box a few times, and advent calendar - all of which were loved by their recipients.However, I do want to highlight some deceptive patterns around the process on their subscription box. They unfortunately, don't send emails before they charge your card and require three working days notice to cancel a shipment. If you're like me, and have difficulty remembering stuff this leads to multiple times having my card charged when I didn't intend on it. I often buy a box individually as a gift, and don't intend to keep a subscription. This problem is compounded as the only way to cancel is to call them. Additionally, they try to up-sell you when you purchase something or cancel.If the above doesn't bother you, then I can still highly recommend Beer52. Additionally, while their support was unable to help me with a refund on erroneous charges they're incredibly kind and easy to talk to. Whether that's because they have this upsell model (that they even try when they cancel you), or they're just kind people, I don't know - but they're kind either way.

title: Good beers, dodgy sales tactics.
review: The beers were very good and from interesting sources. I took advantage of the free trial as I'm not a big beer drinker and couldn't justify the monthly expense. If you really like beer this might be worth it.However their free trial requires a credit card and they intentionally obfuscate a convenient way to cancel. They try to force you to call their sales team, which is only available during work hours. You can, however, cancel via the contact form if you do a general enquiry and request cancellation. If you choose "end subscription" in their contact form it will redirect you to their call centre number.For that reason alone I have to mark them down as it's a pretty duplicitous sales tactic, IMO.

title: Some interesting beers but pushy sales…
review: Some interesting beers but pushy sales tactic. They are happy to take your money and for you to sign up online but won't allow you to cancel online. Having dragged you through multiple web pages asking if you're sure you want to cancel and the reason why, you then get a message saying you have to call their call centre. So, I call the number, sit on hold for a bit, then have to go through the whole process again on the phone. But, instead of accepting my decision,the call handler tries to tell you why it's not a good idea, and when I stand firm that I want to cancel, continues to blather about 50% off if I stay. What should be a very easy process (unsurprisingly there wasn't all these hurdles to jump through to sign up) becomes a long, drawn out farce. It's coercive selling 101.

title: Questionable
review: Bought as a gift after receiving an offer via Argos. Didn’t realise it was a subscription, as this isn’t made very clear. Went to cancel immediately online to be told I had to wait 24 hours. title: As close to a legal scam as you can get.

title: Decent concept but too difficult to cancel
review: Decent concept but insane that it's so difficult to cancel. The model functions on recurring orders via subscription, which is understandable. They re-order your next month's box before sending confirmaiton (money is out of your account before you hear from them with the new menu). To cancel you have to go through multiple prompts online, ignoring their offers to pause for a month or reduce frequency, only to be led to a phone number (available between 9-5 M-F also). Once on the phone, the person is nice but obviously following a script from Beer52 to desperately try to keep you by reiterating the savings available on next box and all the points (!!) you'll lose by cancelling. Beers in my 2 boxes were mid too.

title: Avoid
review: Avoid. Heavy marketing to get you to sign up then they make it very, very hard for you to unsubscribe. IE endless click throughs once you've eventually found the cancellation page on their site. Your then met with a barrage of other offers you have to refuse, then you're presented with a phone number to call between 9am and 5pm to cancel where they'll try to hard sell you yet again. Cancelling should be a simple as signing up. Utterly disgusting practice. The beer isn't to my taste either. Metallic and chemical tasting with very little variety. Overall a very unpleasant experience. I'll get by beer another, much more simple way.
