description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

review: Very nice cottage with massive garden and great place to stay, easy reach of beach and amenities, very relaxing even in the winter, would like to stay in the summer now.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

review: A very enjoyable stay. So nice to have a Christmas tree and other Christmas decorations to help the festive feel. Thanks also for some festive goodies to eat, very nice. Great to have allocated swim pool times for exclusive use, a great bonus.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Easy to use the website
review: Easy to use the website, we needed to contact them regarding the property before our stay and they got back to us straight away. Would definitely book through them again but just not the same location.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: All round great house
review: All round great house, facilities and location . We went on great walks on the coast and in the hills .

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: only 2 logs left for the open fire…then had a power cut !
review: only 2 logs left for the open fire meaning when we had a power cut we had to go to bed to get warm ! the local pub which we were looking forward to was shut over winter ! the pub to us wasent local being uphill thru a muddy narrow dark lane to get back home , half hour to us isant a local walk !

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

review: The house was in a great location, but was a bit run down and in need of an update. The main front door failed on our first night . The plates and work surfaces were dirty and we need to clean them before using.  The cottage was not decorated for Christmas although it did state decorated for Christmas in the listing which was frustrating. Exiting the drive was difficult due to us having 3 cars and the neighbours parked right outside the gate meaning we could not reverse out.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Christmas
review: Great property to spend a family Christmas but there were a few issues. No Christmas tree inside the property, younger children disappointed. Kitchen needs more saucepans, sharp knives, measuring jug, tea towels and dishwasher tablets. Extra towels for hot tub not supplied. There was also an issue with flies in the top bedroom. Having said all this the property is situated in a great location and a very nice social space for a family gathering.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Mixed performance with problems making ferry booking with promised 20% discount
review: Cottage booking went smoothly (1st January 2025) with timely email confirmation of the reservation. Problems arose with the promised 20% discount for the ferry crossings to the Isle of Wight - the unique code I was given by email is not valid at Red Funnel Ferries - still not resolved after several phone calls as I am told there is an IT issue with Holiday Cottages which is being looked into. No timeline for resolution which is a concern as I am obviously keen to secure the ferry booking asap.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Great location for cottage
review: Great location for cottage .it was warm and cosy. More attention to details and information for things like waste management and heating would have been helpful

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: the property is well equipped and ideal…
review: the property is well equipped and ideal for families and able bodied people. My mum is 83 and can't walk far and has COPD, but I had no idea how steep the indoor stairs would be and she had great difficulty climbing up and down. The walk into town is 25 minutes for a fit person such as myself and would be hard going pushing a wheel chair. I think the property is perfect for younger fit people or families with teenage children, the stairs would need a baby gate for anyone under 5 as they are treacherous. I think if the advert had said 25 minutes walk out of Ludlow and not suitable for people with poor mobility (not even disabled), then it would be perfect for youngsters and families alike.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Holiday Cottages were a little slow to…
review: Holiday Cottages were a little slow to reply to emails and never answered the phone.I dealt with the owners direct which was perfect as they reacted quickly and were happy to answer questions as well as dealing with requests directly.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.

review: We requested if we could take 3 dogs but we were told we couldn't then I had an email saying we could, so communication not brilliant.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Cleaning issues!!
review: Fires out of service.Uncomfy beds.Dirty kitchen cupboards and floors n drawers.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Perfect Location
review: A very lovely, cozy warm feeling to the accommodation. The sofa is very comfortable - we loved it! We would have liked to see some basic things in the kitchen though to be honest. Tea, Coffee, Sugar, Salt & Pepper. Same with utensils; the pots and pans are so worn out they have rust in the bottom and are no longer suitable for cooking. Also an over tray would have been lovely too. When spending around £600 for 3 nights stay, we feel that providing/upgrading these basic things should be a must.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Apartment was clean
review: Apartment was clean. Facilities for cooking were good. We couldn’t control the heating, so the apartment was cold. We cut our stay short, we paid for 7 days but left on Boxing Day due to us being ill. Wouldn’t go again.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Nice cottage but poor resolution of issues
review: Cottage was nice. Had a problem with the boiler from the day of arrival. Took 5 days to fix. Appreciate that these things happen but the resolution seemed to take forever and wasn’t well managed between the owner and holiday cottages. I ended up fielding multiple calls from both the company and the owner. I’m aware that they were trying to keep us updated but it was disruptive to our holiday.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Humbug
review: The start set the tone. Due to my request not being carried out and christmas not present within the appartment, a paying guest and not a christmas hoilday experience was how I felt.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Equipt well, but cleanliness not great
review: The property was well equipt. The cleanliness wasn't great as upon arrival we found a pair of dirty socks on the floor in one of the bedrooms. The kitchen utensils were dirty/ greasy. The furniture was quite dated, uncomfortable and faded.I spent Christmas at the property the weather was not kind and therefore hardly ventured out but when we did the location and views were stunning. I spent Christmas at the property with my young children. The advert explained decorated for Christmas. I must say me and my children were quite dissapinted as the tree was old and tatty and the decorations were sparce. I could see right through it. No other decorations. This really put a dampener on my time here as it just felt no effort had been made. I had chose to spend Christmas at this property and just felt a old tree had just been thrown up with one or two decorations thrown at it. No real effort had been made especially with the price paid to stay. Overall the property was well equipt, the cleanliness wasn't the best and was really dissapointed with the Christmas decorations was payed up for a week but we ended up leaving a day early to go home and spend Christmas at home around our own tree.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Cosy cottage
review: The cottage was great itself, cosy and warm, especially with the log burner. Hot tub was amazing.The hosts of the cottage were lovely, really friendly. The only downside for us was the cottage itself was located off a busy road, traffic at times was really loud.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Damage Insurance .
review: I dislike the fact that we have to pay insurance even though we have our own insurance. Holiday Cottages tells us it’s the owner and the owner tells us it’s Holiday Cottages that insist. Very confusing!A pity holiday cottages can’t be more flexible in that other holiday companies accept our insurance.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: They were always contactable for any…
review: They were always contactable for any issues and tried to resolve them. A lot of tooing and froing and they didnt have all the answers.

description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Christmas Week 2024
review: Stopped over Christmas week in Tao Lodge , not the best  of experiences The cottage was cold I had to go out and purchase a small heater to supplement the single radiator in the living room to make it comfortable in the evenings, all the stone walls feel cold to the touch.The left hand wall in the single bedroom is physically wet in the far corner near the bed causing the bedding to feel damp. There is definitely a damp problem there that needs attention before it turns in to a serious mold problem. The end wall in the single room is also wet and has black mold around the socket and skirting which is not healthy for guests atall as its next to the head of the bed. description: Holidaycottages.co.uk - Personally inspected Holiday Cottages for you across England, Wales and Scotland. Voted 'Gold' for customer service by Feefo.
title: Not worth the £2k + price for 4 night stay
review: Not worth the £2k + price for 4 nights! I expected more from a luxury priced property - it is sparsely furnished and equipt from Ikea. In the living area there are no tables for drinks. With young family this was problematic- putting glassware on a tiled floor - thankfully no accidents yet but not a great set up.  Lighting in the living area- 1 small lamp for a large room or the bright lights on. Not very atmospheric or homely. Floors all bare- no rugs of any kind in any room. I was under the impression the house would be decorated for Christmas- it wasn’t. I am Disappointed as we came with family for post Christmas celebration’s. The Kitchen ill equipped.  Not enough cutlery for everyone. I had to source extra.  There is a 2 slice toaster for a house that sleeps 8 people. Breakfast time it was a timely affair. Only wine glasses or water glasses, no champagne flutes for New Year’s Eve or celebrations. There is a washing machine but no where to actually hang wet clothes. No table coverings in case of food that could stain wood work. One thing they certainly would want replaced if the table was stained. The light in the hallway doesn’t turn off- faulty light switch. The bathrooms have new locks that can be opened from the outside. The sofa is torn from previous families. The rental company told me there were no sofa beds, in fact there are two. They also stated no high chair, there is one available. Towels are also included we were told to bring our own. No access to the garage. I have never stayed in a property where you could not access the garage to put bikes , prams or bags ect. The garden is not enclosed- for family with young children and pets it was very inconvenient for safety. No side gates and open to the fields.  The hot tub also exposed to passing neighbours and in full view. Check in was very late. The website stated 4pm but email 5pm. I have never stayed in a cottage where we couldn’t access by 3- 4pm latest.  I have rented many houses over the years for holidays. I feel that the property does not live up the expectation of a premium priced retreat.  The owner is missing a trick- it’s a lovely house but sparcley furnished. The house is for sale and it’s obvious that it has been furnished on the cheap.

My advice would be to use Uber where they have it, we saved a lot of money!

title: The Company were very helpful
review: The Company itself were very helpful. However, from the time of staring to do an online reservation to checkout  the price went up by £100 due to the hotel company (Hilton) changing the pricing for dinner, bed and breakfast by the time we got to checkout .    There was no warning that this would happen. Naturally,  we believed that the advertised price would be the price.  This meant the advertised  "deal" was not such a  deal after all and we could not progress with the booking as we could not afford an extra £100 since it would have meant that dinner would have been £50 per head... far more than we would every pay anywhere (including there.. .having eaten there. only recently).   The same thing happened when we tried instead to book bed and breakfast at the advertised rate. Again the price went up significantly by checkout. The irony was that the company was recommended by Hilton for dinner, bed and breakfast when my brother stayed at the same hotel but on room and breakfast only as the hotel did not directly offer d,b.b.  If companies like HILTON can  offer a rate and then change  it  without notice  then it does nothing for customer relations  and really against the  spirit of Section 20 of the Consumer Protection Act which states (sic)........makes it a criminal offence for a person in the course of his business to give consumers a misleading price indication about goods, services, accommodation ..... The staff on the phone at my hotel break .com  were very helpful  because  our  attempt to pay failed due to our first attempt wanting a code to be sent to a phone. However because the card holder was already on the phone to me booking on their behalf on line,   (as they are not on the internet) the code number sent online lapsed so it all got very complicated. It has been drawn to my attention that some of the rates now on booking.com  are less.

title: The Bowfield county house and Spa Johnstone
review: I receive gift vouchers and choose to stay at at the Bowfield spa hotel. Having previously stayed there before I was really looking forward to it however, this time I was disappointed. There was building work going on at the swimming pool and we were given a room next to it. From 7am the trucks started to arrive and the noise began. Food portions were tiny (my husband asked if he had a child’s portion) and we were given an allowance towards dinner (£15). Usually you are offered a set menu with a choice of 2 courses. We found the menu very limited and on the expensive side. £15 was no where near enough to get a 2 course meal. Breakfast was very nice though. We should have had a bottle of wine in the room but this never arrived.I am not a wine drinker so wasn’t that bothered but my daughter did call them when we got back but they never followed through. On the upside though the staff were very nice but I didn’t enjoy my stay. I don’t think I will be back.

title: give this hotel a wide berth/reply from hotel,
review: Thank you for providing us with Mr Black’s feedback regarding his stay back in February with us at the Pitlochry Hydro.  I have looked back over the notes for this reservation and can confirm the following. As there were no dinner reservations in our diary for that evening from 7.30 onwards (the last reservation was for 7pm) the Chef decided to take the a la carte menu off and just provide the Set Menu. I can see Mr Black advised that he had booked a dinner time when at breakfast, however on checking the diary there doesn’t seem to be any record of an 8pm reservation. I will certainly try and ascertain which members of  staff were on duty that morning to see if there is any recollection of this and also make sure my team are aware that guests should be directed to reception should they wish to book a meal time to ensure this is added to the diary properly. Please be rest assured that the set menu meals are no way microwaved and are prepared fresh for the night. Breakfast is a buffet and again freshly made for the breakfast.  From the notes on the reservation I can see that Mr Black did issue a complaint regarding the meals and was issued a refund for their dinner straight away. Mr Black also received an upgrade to a room with a view with our compliments and no issues were raised at all at the time of check out with regards to the bedrooms. These rooms are the same as our standard rooms, however have an upgraded view therefore do normally carry an additional supplement. Neither of the changing rooms have any tiles in them  – so I am unable to comment on “Changing room had missing tiles filled with cement” Our sauna does have a drain however we have found that if guests go in there fully wet after a swim then it does take a wee bit for the water to drain away. Unfortunately we don’t have the resources to mop this up after every single use.

title: Duped
review: We received vouchers for our first wedding anniversary from myhotelbooking.com special price £99 per night) we saw this stunning hotel Derwentwater Hotel, Keswick and had to book a two nights stay, we upgraded to the premium plus room for an extra £25. The receptionist was lovely and very helpful, but thats all the good i can say about this hotel. The beautiful pictures from the website are a total con, the hotel is up a very dark, narrow, back street, the car park (which you have to pay for) has tiny spaces and our car was scratched, then the door bashed so hard it left a dent, the room was filthy, the feature wall had obviously been painted a dark green colour but was very slap dash and had green paint all over the skirting and coving, the rest of the walls, coving and ceiling were a dirty cigarette stained colour, the bathroom had blood in 3 places, in the bath, on the tiles and on the toilet seat, the shower was freezing and the toilet made loud noises when emptying and filling, the carpet was threadbare, the bed springs dug into our backs, the lock on the door had been removed, on the landing there was a big hole in the floor, we heard people trying to park and hit other cars in the car park… just an awful experience… we checked in at 330pm and out at 930pm… we couldn’t wait to get out… we dont know what they could’ve done to make our stay better, the receptionist said they were fully booked when we checked in, and this was their best room so god knows what the alternative option would be like! …i offered the second night free to my friends on social media and everyone who replied said they wouldn’t stay there again if i paid them… they hated it there… and the car park spaces were very tight… among other comments… tried to get some response from the hotel or the booking company but hotel is obviously used to bad reviews and the manager had terrible customer services, with lots of ‘copy and pasted’ bog standard replies, and the booking company said they were just agents, and palmed it all off on the hotel… please dont waste your money or time!… if you do decide to try here, go through bookings.com or google as we found the same night for £44! Looks 5* but I wouldn’t give them 1*…

description:
Travel the Audley Way
We arrange trips to more than 80 destinations throughout the world and across each continent.

Why book with Audley?
 
Audley Traveller Magazine

The world your way

Start planning your next adventure with Audley

review: I contacted Audley Travel to help in planning a trip to Milan in May.  We were contacted by Sage Waterson.  We had a video conference.  She answered all of our questions.  In the end, she came up with three plans.  These plans were great, but after really going over the plans, we decided that at our age of 78, the trip would be too much for us to handle.  We are embarrassed that we didn't think through our capabilities before we wasted Sage's time and effort.  It was our decision that we had requested a trip that we were not able to safely do.  I would use Audley travel again and would be happy to work with Sage at any time.  This is all on us and our over estimation about how we are able to travel overseas.  I recommend the agency and Sage.

title: Disappointing level of support when things go wrong & subsequent resolution
review: We went to the USA in June this year with Audley. The holiday was on the whole what we expected until we had a flight delay on our return. Due to storms in Miami our flight to Orlando was delayed and we missed our connection back to the UK. The customer support service that Audley rave about was useless and offered no help or solution. Our flights had been booked by Audley on American Airlines and Virgin Atlantic which are not linked, therefore we had no return tickets to the UK and had to pay for new tickets. All we get now are a few apologies and an offer of dinner instead of the £7000 plus additional cost we have had. Lesson learned, don't use an expensive travel agency and expect to be looked after if something goes wrong.Additional comments 10/12/2024I am pleased to say that, following a number of conversations with Client Services Executive, Chloe from Audley Travel, we have reached a very satisfactory conclusion with a full refund of the additional monies we spent. We would like to thank Chloe for looking into the issues and for advocating our case to a satisfactory resolution. She has understood our concerns and acted to provide true customer service.

title: Classic Costa Rica
review: We had a great time in Costa Rica based on the Classic Costa Rica tour - communication at home was excellent and usually by phone which made things very personal. My only complaints are that we changed flights in Miami for which we needed an ESTA, which was mentioned in our written itinerary but not mentioned in communications, so we had a last minute panic getting this sorted. Also, our detailed itinerary was given to us by the ground agent in the taxi from the airport to our hotel when we arrived after a 22 hour door-to-door journey, which wasn’t ideal! This could have been done before we left the UK. Also, because we made a few changes/additions to the standard tour, some trips were not necessary. This could also have been addressed beforehand and given us a little more free time. Other than this the organisation, hotels and service were excellent.

title: Audley Travel and Costa Rica _ Mixed travel bag
review: Audley Travel and Costa Rica. Prompted to write this seeing very similar experience listed on here in another review. Issues with the local agent Swiss Travel. We lost two days due to KLM flight cancelled resulting in missing Arenal centre. Left to sort out and reclaim ourselves.  We lost two nights of our stay.  Some rejigging was done but then communication from Swiss travel poor. Whats app and Phone difficult. Details inaccurate and confusing. Pick up at San Hose poor. Car pick ups altered and uncertain.  Costa Rica is amazing. The tour route and planning was good. However the execution was poor..  Front half of tour with flights and the local agents issue led to anxieties we did not expect. Final hotel amazing.  Costa Rica is a wonderful country to visit. This however did not feel like a smooth luxury holiday at all times.  Audley have addressed our issues and explained this was not a usual experience, somewhat of a backwash from Covid disruption. Our faith is restored and I would consider Audley again. This is edited after further support from the Audley team. Laura was excellent. See below

title: Never disappoint!
review: I have used Audley for various holidays across the world several times now and they never disappoint. This time I wanted a safari followed by a beach break and Theresa Arachi put together a great itinerary for me, starting in Kenya in a superb camp in the Masai Mara, followed by a lovely hotel in Zanzibar. I am a solo traveller and Audley ensured I was safely looked after from arrival and then leaving after 18 days in total. Any little issues are dealt with promptly so you can get on with your holiday. (Issues with the hotel in Nairobi for 2 nights, hence not giving a 5 star review, although this wasn't down to Audley). The specialists know the countries/areas they cover well which is very helpful (Theresa had visited many of the hotels and camps herself so knew what would be more suitable for me), so I highly recommend using them wherever in the world you want to go, either as a group, pair or solo.

title: Wonderful Private Tour in Mexico
review: Our country specialist was really helpful pre-trip, and extremely responsive when we suggested itinerary changes we wanted to make, and the trip itself was fabulous - we thoroughly enjoyed it all and it fully met our expectations.  There was only one minor blip when, well ahead of time, our flight out of Mexico was reported as delayed, and our driver was unable to contact anyone at the destination agent to see if we could be booked on another flight (though in the end we did, through our own efforts, manage to get on to an earlier flight.The one thing which was a bit disappointing was that there was no follow-up post-trip, other than for a fairly bland online questionnaire.  From our experience with other tailor-made travel agents, I would have expected that Audley would want a bit more 'colour' (eg we tried one of your recommended restaurants in xxx and it's no longer that great, or the hotel in yyy was fabulous because .....).  Otherwise, though, I would recommend Audley and would certainly look to use them again.

title: Landed 6 hours ago from a safari booked…
review: Landed 6 hours ago from a safari booked with Audley travel. Our outbound flight was delayed an hour due to technical issues. My wife contacted Audley to see if there was any contingency plans. Let’s not do anything yet as we might make it. No, their incompetence department rushed into action!! The cancelled our onwards flights and rebooked them. We found this as we tried to check in. We lost our private plane flight into the game park. We’re left stranded in Johannesburg. Eventually got an 8 hour drive to the lodge. Arrived with my wife being sick from stress and travel. Spent the next two days with a migraine. They wanted us to pay for the car. Then negotiated half, then nothing. Not what you want to deal with on safari. Nothing on the private flight I paid for into the reserve. On the way home, it was all last minute as the flight out of the reserve hadn’t been booked. The transfer from the private airfield to the main airport hadn’t been booked? We survived Audley travel due to the amazing kindness of the South African people. Additional note. Audley travel have responded to us personally and have put things right. Claire Losito has been excellent in dealing with this. Wish it hadn’t happened, but it’s nice to know that your holiday experience does matter to them.

title: Usually very good, now very disappointing.
review: I have worked with Audley many times in the past. Usually they are 5 star all the way from the agents on the phone to the ground people in country. I  have merely had slight hiccups, which are to be expected.I recently used them for a trip with my husband, who  now uses a wheelchair.  I asked specifically if you can handle a wheelchair tour in Egypt.  Yes definitely the agent said.  Whenever I spoke to him I emphasized that we needed a wheelchair accessible van and accessible bedroom.  He promised me these things. neither were available for this trip.  We had to haul my husband in and of a regular van with brute strength.  We stayed in three fabulous hotels.  Only one had a handicap room available when we arrived.  We made do with what was available.In Aswan we were scheduled for several trips on a boat.  I questioned if this was possible .  The agent Assured me they would be able to do it. Wrong again.  We were there three days and only went to on museum.The rest of the people in our group had a wonderful time, but I was seriously disappointed. Usually when I return home, the country specialist arranges a call to discuss my experience. This didn’t happen for this trip. Poorly done Audley, very poorly done.

title: First time we have used Audley Travel…
review: First time we have used Audley Travel and our last! Initial contact was great and our trip was well thought out by Lucy who was our contact. Then we received an email saying she was no longer dealing with our trip and she was handing over to Hannah.The personal touch had disappeared.This was an expensive 3 week holiday to Canada and we wanted  everything to be right. title: Pulling Teeth
review: My Wife and I spent considerable time looking at a 2 centre Holiday in Europe (same country).We researched the Country we wanted to visit forensically, candidate Airlines and associated Airports, Logistics around Transfers, areas we wanted to Visit, type/style of Accommodation, availability etcSo we had a pretty thorough itinerary with some flex on dates.We decided to invite Audley Travel to help us given their excellent reputation.Therefore, we provided a detailed brief which we felt covered all the bases.The initial e-Mail reply was encouraging the only question missing was budget.Given we’d indicated that we were seasoned Travellers we preferred Audley Travel to cost it out themselves as they might have different ideas given their vast experience so didn’t want to lead the witness.They did have a couple of reasonable and understandable questions so that was encouraging, which we answered immediately.The representative seemed to want to talk further which is some ways was fine but there was really nothing else materially to add as we had covered everything even down to what Trains we might want to catch!It was also an incredibly busy and stressful time for us hence looking to engage their Services.This Ping Pong started to become quite frustrating so we asked another specialist in the Travel industry to get involved.Within 24 hours they provided a fully costed itinerary which was first class.We thought we’d ask Audley Travel again as the representative seemed polite although unable to provide what we wanted.We hinted at a reasonable Budget, more than what we’d been quoted to be “advised” that it wouldn’t be enough for what we were looking to achieve.We’ve given the review 3 stars as we do think AT are a good business but, on this experience, they could have tried much harder especially given what we had done so in realty should be less.Bottom line their competitor showed more interest and initiative,

title: Overall good - Cuts corners
review: Overall good itinerary… all of the highlights covered. Details are often lacking — No driver from here or there. Unable to complete tours where cane user was clearly stated up front. Ie 2000 steps not accommodated for where there are stated needs. Drivers late or with multiple pickups at same time. Waited 30 min and then just walked back to hotel at 11pm - 25 min. Totally unacceptable for the price of these trips. If tui italia can’t get it done they need to find other local organizations. But overall had a great time and saw the highlights described. Would def return to the destination but would probably not use this travel agent. Too many shortcuts to save a few dollars when the price of the vacations are $$$$.

title: We paid for a 5 star holiday experience.  We didn't get it.
review: This was intended to be the trip of a lifetime - our retirement reward to a place I'd always wanted to go to, The Amalfi Coast.  We are not confident travellers and based on Trustpilot Reviews and Audley's website we felt safe trusting our trip to them and paying a premium price.  At no point did they admit to us that once we got to Italy, we would be dealing with third parties - mostly Tui and not Audley.  We would not have booked if we had known.  We booked our own flights to Naples and had the most horrendous time with threatened cancellation and a 3 hour delay.  We phoned the Duty Agent to ensure that our transfer was made aware of our circumstances.  The Duty Agent was rather off hand and said we should have called Italy direct but agreed to notify the company organising the transfer on our behalf as we were being rushed to boarding to ensure the plane could leave and land before midnight in Naples.  On arrival, weary and exhausted, we could not find our transfer.  Travellers who had paid far less and travelled with Tui were all collected.  There was no message on my phone, nothing.  We were left in Naples airport at the mercy of the touts.  We eventually got through to the ground agent, Citalia, who told us the transfer had been and gone and they couldn't find another.  When asked what we should do, they said, get a taxi and couldn't tell us what a fair price was - negotiate they said.  It was now past midnight, we were exhausted and had no option but to join a long queue where we were pestered by touts and taxi drivers who were trying to double book people to fill their seats.  We were lucky.  We were not ripped off and arrived safely at our hotel.  No thanks to Audley.  In the morning an email arrived from the duty officer telling me they hadn't been able to arrange an alternative transfer and to get a refund from the airline!  This was not an auspicious start.  Naples was a great experience, lovely hotel, excellent guide and the driver arrived on time to take us to Sorrento.  Unfortunately, the hotel in which were to spend the next 6 nights was not up to scratch.  Italy was unseasonably cold and windy and our hotel was only suitable to hot sunshine - the name Helios, says it all.  Its breakfast gazebo was freezing and windblown and the electricity failed for the hot food and toast.  The manageress was curt and mercenary when we asked for a bottle of water in the room and as for tea/coffee making facilities forget it.  There was only a tiny bar area inside - everything was outside but it was too cold to use, condemning us to our rooms which were not designed to be used that way.  The space was on the terrace, which was too cold to sit out on.  As the hotel didn't do evening food, you were always forced out to eat - a good 15 minute down the hill into town or pay £30 for a taxi!  There was no letter, as promised in the Audley booklet with all the details of your tours etc.  Both hotels looked blank when I asked for such a document.  This rather left us in the dark.   Questions we'd pre-asked and specific modifications, such as food we don't eat to not be served on one trip had clearly not been relayed thus particular experiences were not what we'd anticipated.  I want to make it clear that my lack of satisfaction is that our needs were not met and we had paid top dollar for this trip. title: Needlessly expensive
review: I can only write a partial review of Audley because I never got past the planning and pricing part.My initial experience with Audley was very positive, thanks to their outstanding travel consultant Alex. Alex is Audley's Spain and Portugal expert and in all my communications with her, both by email and on the phone she was upbeat, helpful and seemingly enthusiastic about customizing the tour to meet every one of our trip wishes. I will have to admit that the final customized tour she created for us was outstanding. The problem came with the price. Now I understand there is a premium to be paid for a customized tour. As with any other company, Audley has an organizational overhead and needs to make a profit. However, when that profit is more than 36% over the actual cost of the tour, I think that is excessive.   I know how much over the actual price of the tour Audley was charging because I priced the itinerary they provided independently, looking up the costs of the hotels and private tours identical to the ones that they described in their itinerary. In fact, I made sure that I rounded everything way up to make sure I gave them the benefit of the doubt. Even doing that, a trip that I could have booked on my own with just a bit of effort for $7,200 was costing me over $11,300 with Audley. Sure, we will be taking a cab rather than a private car from the train station to the hotel and back but for $4,100 less, I can certainly live with that. To make matters worse, the international flight from the US to Spain that Alex told me should could probably get me at a cheaper price through Audley contracts with the airlines, ended up being over $900 more expensive than the same flights I was able to find online in less than 10 minutes.   If you don't mind the  unnecessary personal extravagance of blowing a couple of thousand dollars for customized service then I guess Audley is for you.  I'd rather save that money and take another trip.****Addendum 10/09/2022As Audley Travel promised in their reply to my original post, a customer service manager, Lily, did reach out to me shortly afterwards to discuss my concerns. Once again, as in my experience with Alex,  my original Audley trip consultant, Lily was  extremely pleasant, patient and apparently very determined to explain the value of the Audley tour and try to work with me in any way to get the trip with them off the ground. Despite the effort, we could not arrive at a solution that would allow me to feel comfortable with the value I was getting for my money. Just as a matter of perspective,  by creating and booking an itinerary on my own, totally online, with a virtually identical itinerary to Audley's with the same hotels plus full day as opposed to the 1/2 day tours offered by Audley in all the places we planned to visit, I saved enough to pay for our two roundtrip flight fares from the U.S. to Spain in premium economy class.  In the final analysis, I was extremely impressed with the patience and apparent determination the Audley team has in creating a great trip for it's clients. Unfortunately for me, the steep premium that involves just does not make financial sense.

I have been impressed with the way in which their Directors Office has dealt with my concerns.

title: Stay away from Audley Travel!!!
review: We recently booked a trip to Milan and Stresa on Lake Maggiore. We received a call from a driver who was dispatched to pick us up from the airport on the wrong night. Despite forwarding our flight information directly from United Airlines, (although we booked in April, Audley asked for it in August)  Audley had us arriving the wrong day. We were scheduled to visit the Duomo and the Last Supper on the day of arrival but that didn't happen because the tickets were sold out and we were still in the US. When we informed the agent, her response was that we "were lucky" because we could have an early morning check in rather than a normal late afternoon check in which was totally ridiculous. Jasmine then booked us on a 3 hour walking tour an hour after we arrived in Milan after having no sleep. We cancelled that excursion as well. Another excursion that was booked for later in the trip never happened. We were also told we would have global entry back into the US which wasn't true. We telephoned Jasmine upon our return to let her know about our trip. We requested a refund of one night hotel stay in Milan, tickets for the Duomo, the Last Supper, the walking tour and the driver who was sent on the wrong day. Her response was she had to speak her supervisor. After 10 days and another email from me, we finally heard back. Basically, her response was "sorry, you lose". She told us she would have to speak with a supervisor. Yesterday, 2 weeks after the trip, we spoke with a supervisor who told us she couldn't help us. Rather than spending 2 days in Milan, we were there for half a day. Although Stefani kept apologizing, I told her that I wanted to be reimbursed for the money that was paid ahead of time. Again we were told that there was nothing we could do. We've requested itemized copies of the bill so that we could provide to the insurance company and still haven't received this either. We spent in excess of $13,000 for this trip. I would absolutely NEVER EVER recommend them. They have no customer service policy. Stay Away!!

title: We were mislead
review: I was willing to pay what I thought was a very high price because I was celebrating my eightieth birthday and the ads promised trips tailored to our specific interests and planned by experts.  Our specialist assured us that all of our guides were Spanish civil war experts (my main interest in the trip), that we would have english speaking drivers on transfers and long drives between cities and that every detail would be taken care of so that the usual hassles of travel would be avoided. We were grossly mislead. Not only were the guides not experts none of them had been informed of our specific interests. They were all very professional and were embarrassed by not being prepared to meet our needs. Finally in Barcelona, our last stop, we found our own guide and had a wonderfully informative half day tour of civil war sites. For the  first week of the trip our drivers could speak no english. Our local  representative mixed up times and pickup spots and then blamed us although we followed our printed instruction exactly.To their credit Audley investigated, apologized and returned a small portion of our cost, about the best they could do to make up for a disappointing two weeks.

title: Very poor customer service
review: Booked to go to Japan many months ahead and very excited. Unfortunately our specialist rep left and her replacement was not very efficient. She promised things, calls that never materialised. I booked with them because I suffer from anxiety and wanted all the stress taken away. Her inefficiency left me stressed before we left. We missed our flight connection due to late departure and we were abandoned. No help during a weekend. Lost paid for trips and tickets as no rep. would rearrange to meet  us. Now trying to claim compensation and constant stalling. Yet again booked phone calls not received. Japan is wonderful by the way but not the experience I was expecting from Audley.Well this review certainly got their attention. To be fair it was very quick. Lots of apologies and a full refund on the trips we missed out on. We have now received the promised 'pack' and it's such a shame we didn't have it before we went. It is really lovely and lots of info which would have been really useful.Lots of phone calls to keep me updated on progress with compensation and a very nice little voucher for a weekend away. I think you can judge a company more by the way it handles complaints and they handled ours very well . Sad I had to complain though. On reflection I think I would book again with them

title: We planned our trip 2 years ago so…
review: We planned our trip 2 years ago so everything should have been perfect. 1- we received a copy of our itinerary 2 days before leaving. 2- We booked it 2 years in advance because we wanted to stay at Giraffe Manor and visit the elephant orphanage. When we got there, the agency never made the reservation for the elephants so it was impossible to attend, it was a great dis’s appointment. We spent one night at Giraffe Manor and the following night we had to move to a lousy hotel near by, even though there were rooms at the Giraffe Retreat that was right there and , not only it was amazing but, by the suggestion of Tom Wilkinson, the agent, we paid more than 200$ each to use the place so why did he made us book another hotel while we could have been there. Even worst, why didn’t he book us on a flight to Seychelles that same day as, as he didn’t book us the elephant orphanage we didn’t have much to do there. 3- This is the worst part, we specifically requested the Four Seasons in Seychelles, for us it was as important as staying at Giraffe Manor. When I realized we were in a completely different resort it was way too late. The one in Mahe was not bad but the one in Pralin was not what we wanted at all. It was extremely disappointing! And there was no way to contact the agent Tom Wilkinson because he was on vacation!!!!!

title: What is Audley's added value?
review: We have been on two significant holidays to South East Asia arranged by Audley with total spend of c£70,000.  In both cases there were material shortfalls in the quality of advice that Audley offered.  Specifically we were given incorrect advice about the Covid regime, one hotel recommendation showed that Audley really are not up to date with the current situation and generally communications were poor.  One pays a premium to book through Audley and for that I expect good advice and excellent communications.  They really added no value beyond what I could have achieved by booking direct.I would put this all down to experience but Audley have specifically asked us for feedback which we have given, but they really don't listen.  Not looking for anything tangible other than an acknowledgement that their service was sub standard.  We would never use them again (we have used other, cheaper and better agents) and would advise others to be certain of their true added value before committing to them.

title: Disatisfied/Satisfied
review: First of all, I used Audley to book a portion of our European trip.   I received an invoice for over $6000 for 2 hotel bookings, 2 tour excursions and a rental car for 4 days.  When I asked for a detailed invoice, I was told that they could not provide me with one due to agreement with overseas venders not wanting their rates posted.  If I am going to spend $6000 I would like to know what for.  If I had planned the trip myself and made all the reservations I could have done it for less than $4500.  I will never use Audley again for this reason.Our 1st tour in Iceland, we where not told that the location of the tour was over 3 hours away from where we were staying.  We called the Eskimo team for assistance and was told that they could not help and to call our agent.  After calling the tour vender directly, it was determined that we could not make the tour on time so we had to cancel in hopes of a refund.Our 2nd tour in Normandy France,  it was to be a private all day tour.  The tour guide was 1/2hr late.  He then expected me to do all of the driving with my car.  He finally got a car from his office.  The tour consistent of him driving us to different locations and dropping us off and he would wait in the parking lot until we returned.At the start of our booking process,  Kelsey White our travel agent was very helpful  and booked what we asked for.  She was very responsive to any questions we had.  If it was not for the refusal to give me an itemized statement I would have considered using Audley Travel again.6/29/24:  Audley Travel has been very reseptive to my complaints and did an excellent job resolving the issues.  I am quite statisfied with the end results.

title: Disappointed ☹️
review: Booked a trip to Japan and South Korea for October 2023. Booked it more than six months in advance. Went back and forth on the destinations, hotels and so forth. Finally got what we wanted. Thought we were all set. In  September I asked for the final itinerary. It was quite obvious that the person responsible for handling the itinerary never bothered to read or check what they sent out. We are world travelers. Have never seen anything like this. They still could not bother to read it themselves. It never occurred to me that this company would screw up like that and then just act like it was no big deal. Definitely would not recommend to anyone.

title: It’s was a mediocre Australian Trip
review: My husband and I are retired in Texas and we’re excited about planning and going on a month long vacation to Australia and New Zealand. About 8 months prior to the time I wanted to travel, I took much effort to speak with several travel agencies who specialized in these areas. I decided on Audley, had used them in the past. Our exciting vacation became a mediocre experience.I chose Audley because in speaking with the original Australian specialist he seamed to be in line with my expectations but little did I know he would leave very shortly after I had spoke with him and paid my deposit.The new agent assigned to us lacked in responsiveness and follow up.  I felt there was no enthusiasm in helping us plan our trip. She was just handed over another client.  At one point I was pretty frustrated and contacted a Audley supervisor. I received a call back from the supervisor a couple of days later. I was told I could copy him on any emails to her and he would be sure they was follow up.  That was not the response I wanted or expected. Second, I had done some research on my own and asked that three specific named 4+ star rated hotels be included in the trip. One of the three  was a wonderful experience (it had 15 tents/rooms with the exact same view and floor plan, lucky for us).  The other two hotels were amazing  properties with harbor or ocean views but Audley booked us with a room looking into parking garage or at the base of the hotel.  Most of the room choices at the hotels were average, definitely no WOW! factor . Third, regarding the general scheduling of our itinerary activities, most were a touristy type that you can find on a google search. I will give Audey credit for the Quoll Patrol Tour. Bushy our guide and chef took us to see some great sites and animals.  I believe if you are engaging a specialty travel agency to plan your trip they should be able to provide some WOW experiences and or hidden gems not just the activities that most can find on the internet. And you would think their relationships with the hotels they choose, booked so far out would have been better room choices.

review: The only reason I am not giving them one star, is because they actually have AMAZING customer service while planning a trip. title: Check everything carefully !
review: Returned from a 2 week trip to Vietnam with Audley a few weeks ago. Only now can I write about the trip with neutrality. Nothing to do with Vietnam which is an interesting country with friendly people. The problems were all to do with the very poor service we received from Audley. We were repeat customers and have traveled widely with a variety of operators. never before have we experienced the number or scale of issues we had on this trip. Things began to go downhill reading our 'final' itinerary and noticing that instead of a short flight from one place to another, we were due to fly to Ho Chi Mihn City at 6am then be driven for what turned out to be 4 hrs. On enquiry we were told the original flight was cancelled some weeks previously and this was the best alternative. We didn't see it that way - Audley state that they will keep people updated of any flight change as soon as they are aware, and that all arrangements are 'bespoke' ie arranged to best suit the customer. We consider that we should have been informed and consulted about how to deal with the cancelled flight immediately it happened. Eventually Audley agreed to change our flight to a later one (which meant they had to pay for an upgrade because it had virtually sold out by then - something they seemed to 'hold against' us as it was mentioned many times) Sadly no one in Vietnam knew of the change and we had to communicate with the UK many times before the new flight was confirmed - the day before it took place, 7 days into the trip. We further experienced being informed by the Audley app that we had landed from a different internal flight several hours before the flight took off - because the app was incorrect. We also were given incorrect information about booking in to the International flights by personal e-mail, and the information about booking in arrangements in the itinerary were not appropriate to the e-ticket arrangements that now exist for all flights. Most of the hotels that were booked for us were good, except one which was not suited to our needs ( I have mobility issues and the hotel supplies cycles-which I cant even get on- to get around) Furthermore it took 5 hours after arriving at this hotel (which we had been assured was one of the best Audley work with) to get a room with working air-con and the trouble we had during this time resembles a farce ! We went to this hotel to visit a floating market, which we anticipated would be a highlight of our trip (I am a keen photographer) In the Audley website the market is described as 'the throng of boats make it difficult to see the water' and 'boats are filed with teetering piles of fruit and vegetables' Many friends have seen such sights in the past but sadly it is not like that now - there are a few big black container boats from Cambodia with produce, but the trading is done elsewhere - surely Audley who claim to have very good, up to date local knowledge should know this ? The whole experience was beyond disappointing. We also found other descriptions to be inaccurate and misleading for example - Can Tho is not a small town, it is the 4 biggest City in Vietnam with well over 1 million inhabitants, Hoi An Old Town is lovely but it no longer has the Japanese bridge described and depicted on the website. The area is surrounded by unmentioned huge hotels and a 'party Island' on the opposite riverbank. The final major issue we had was with a guide who acted inappropriately. Having mentioned we were unhappy to Audley they started a process where the guide was informed he would not be continuing with us while we were on a long car journey with him - something we had expressly asked not to happen. The whole situation was very awkward, with the guide asking me twice if he had offended me and even trying to contact me when we got home. We understand why he would be upset but strongly feel it is for his employers to deal with updating him about expected attitudes. This is far from Audleys promise to offer 'the best guides' - we have to say the others were excellent. There were other 'niggles' along the way and we ended the holiday more stressed than we began, partly because as problems multiplied and escalated we worried about what might go wrong next rather than relax and feel looked after - surely the main reason that people pay a lot of money to a company like Audley.Why have I given a score of 2 ? On return it would have been zero ! We put together a full complaint -not that Audley give an indication that they have a complaint procedure or a customer services department on their website. We wanted to alert them to the flaws in their promotional material and help prevent future issues. We also wanted compensation. We believe this has been taken seriously, we have received apologies and we have agreed a sum. It wont give us the happy memories we hoped to bring back.

title: Endorses animal cruelty
review: Last year we visited Vietnam with Audely (my first experience travelling with them as an adult). We had said from day 1 we never wanted to do anything that exploited animals or children or local people. The day we landed we assumed we’d get an email or message from our driver/guide to let us know what time they’d pick us up. We heard ZERO. We called the out of offices number and heard nothing for hours. Finally after having to make multiple international calls we got confirmation of a time.We get picked up, and taken to our boat tour and get told we’re going to have lunch at a local woman’s house (something we’d also said we didn’t want to do). And that we’d be visiting an orphanage… to this day I can’t understand why visiting an orphanage is a tourist attraction - but Audely seem to think it is!We get to the local lady’s house and within minutes her and the guide drag a 4M long python snake out of a 2x5M cage. We were horrified. The local woman then proceeded to hit the snake about to get it to wake up and then tried to get us to put it over our shoulders to take pictures. We refused.  The whole experience was distressing and awful to witness. The orphanage was “better” than we had expected as we didn’t interact with anyone but it felt awkward and uncomfortable.I contacted Audely as soon as I could and to be fair to them they acted and made apologies. We did get somewhat of a refund - the total trip was around £6,000 - which for what we got on reflection was daylight robbery. As a company that prides itself on being leaders in ethical tourism I’m shocked that they directly contribute to animal cruelty. By booking tourists on these trips they continue to fuel a need for animals to be treated badly.

review: Phoned up mid September to plan our honeymoon to Namibia, Kruger and Mozambique. Got put through to the specialist team and had a fantastic first conversation with a specialist who had been to Namibia recently. It’s a huge shame as heard great things about audley and for such a special (and expensive) trip too, I felt really let down. My specialist apologised and aimed to get me a quote in the next few days but it was too little too late.

title: Disappointing experience
review: Disappointing experience. The initial discussion and holiday planning of our Kenyan safari was great, our specialist was very attentive and helpful. After the the deposit was paid, communications weren’t as timely, but once the full holiday was paid for (which was a substantial amount as you expect going through a travel agent) responsiveness and tone went right down. After chasing for an update on our travel forms for over a week, the being sent a response in a passive aggressive tone, we raised a complaint with a line manger at Audley. We were told it’s not the Audley way and that our complaint would be looked into promptly and we’d hear back within a few days.. we’re yet to hear a thing, over a week later. It does make me concerned about what our holiday will actually be like, considering the lack of follow through and the fact that customer service seems to be of very low importance. It’s so disappointing and has really dampened the excited of our upcoming holiday.

title: We were quoted an extortionate price…
review: We were quoted an extortionate price for a holiday to Ecuador and the Galapagos, which we ended up booking ourselves like for like (if not for better rooms etc.) spending about £10k less than quoted by Audley. When challenged about the initial quote, the agent came up with all the “added value” they claimed to provide, when it had come across clearly to us that the agent knew less about the country than us after having read the Lonely Planet the week end before. In fact it felt like we were giving the agent information about the country/ option rather than the agent advising us. i.e. we were shown a cruise advertised as being suitable for retirees, when in fact we said we were a young couple on their honeymoon. It might be different for other countries, as we have friends who have been happy with Audley’s service to the US, but we found it completely overpriced but more importantly unjustifiably so as we couldn’t see any added value.

title: Not there if you need them …

We were lucky enough to have trip insurance but i must say Audley was horrible . (unreceptive and ineffective.  ).  They refunded nothing , not even a dinner two weeks away at a private home ..hard to believe i’m sure if nothing goes wrong audley will be wonderful ( and overpriced ) but I also feel certain they would not be helpful in any crisis and therefore we are done with them.  (not even a note to say how do you feel ). Anyone can be wonderful when they are not needed at all .

That is 50% success rate and time spent emailing, calling and reasoning with them to have the correct item shipped out and delivered. title: Flood cleanup excellent but the flood should not have happened!
review: OK this is a mixed review good and bad. Last week our warehouse and yard was flooded, along with large parts of the area of Thamesmead, Abbey Wood and Plumstead. This flood should not have happened at all. It was caused by a brief period of heavy rain which backup up the main Southern Outfall Sewer all the way from the Crossness pumping station to Plumstead. According to what the man from Thames Water told me, there is a person in the Control Room at Crossness and he chose not to  release the backed up sewage water into the Thames with the result that the whole area flooded. Municipal water supply companies get castigated and fined when they release sewage into rivers, so instead of dumping sewage into the sea they decided to dump it into the streets of London.But I can say that the response of Thames Water to our flood has been pretty good. They sent a team of their own to clean up our yard which was covered in a layer of mud and waste the next day. That team did not have time to finish so they paid for a  private contractor came in to complete the job a few days later and our yard now looks better than it did before the flood.So in summary this should never have happened, but after it did I think Thames did quite a good job of helping us to clean up and also very good communications with us.

title: Updated review : This company has been ripping us off…
review: I would like to update everyone who has read my bad review about Thames Water. I got in contact with Thames Water today July 6, 2023  and finally the issues were fixed. New meter was installed, a manager named "Hayley"rang me and she has taken the current reading on the new meter, then she has done a manual adjustments and calculated the discrepancies and it took our account into credit and we are due a refund. So I am truly relieved that this problem is resolved now. It's been a pain and now it's resolved I'm happy---------------------------------This company has been ripping us off for years. We moved to this flat in 2016 we got our bill as normal. Then we decided to just wash our clothes to a laundrette to see if it can lower our water bill  because it increases every 6 months. we were most of the time not at home because we both work and we go on holidays every year and leaves the property for like 3 to 4 weeks.. But instead the bill went up each time. We contacted them to ask about the meter where is it and they gave us the meter location, but found nothing. We pay a ridiculous amount of £40, £50 a month in the past years and this year £99. Because they estimated our future water consumption. Load of lies  because they say we have a meter but if we do why do  they need to estimate. My friends and even other people say their bill a month for a household of 5 was just £23.Cut story short, we insisted on having a meter checked until they sent not 1 but 2 engineers to check. But both of them found nothing. Meaning our bill was obviously based on Assessed household charge. No meter or maybe imaginary one. Estimated bill every year. Now they fitted a meter on June 7, 2023 and  in 3 weeks that we wash clothes at home 3 times a week our consumption was just 5.920 cubic meters and it's just £13.48. The date of experience indicated in this review was when we followed up with Thames through whatsapp messaging to ask for an engineer to come over to show us the meter because they failed to send one in 2020 because of covid restrictions but we have been going in circles with them since 2019.

Others force you to cancel only after you've moved out, so you can't pre-plan and you always overpay. Some even require you to explicitly claim your refund afterwards (seriously TV Licencing - what is wrong with you?). Others charge bizarre cancellation fees out of nowhere.Therefore, it was a breath of fresh air to be able to just fill in an online form for a month in the future and have my final bill calculated in days. Fair. Simple. Easy. Thames Water were the only company to make my move simple.Nevertheless, I am detracting one star because they are a monopoly. Who knows if what I paid on my bill was fair. It was my only option.

The nice lady gave me the email address which does not appear on the company's website.  I included in the email a photograph of the meter showing the correct reading on 1 June.  I have not received a response nor even an acknowledgement.  I have followed up today, re-sending my email of 1 June.  Rather than one star, I have added a star to the review simply on the strength of that nice lady's cooperation.  Past and future usage are still based on the incorrect reading although the nice lady reduced the monthly direct debits which at least means that there is time to resolve the issue. Nobody I spoke to (and it was a lot) could explain this DEAL. As it was near Christmas and after a fraught move I just didn't have the energy to argue anymore. So I just let it go.No one on this estate was paying anything like this amount. As an 80 year old single occupant I think an explanation should have been offered. title: They have overcharged me £605! They falsify the bills!
review: They have overcharged me £605! From December 2023 to July 2024 I paid £26 monthly. Before that, I always paid less than £30 per month. Over the Summer of 2024 both I, then my husband, were sick & in hospital. By the end of November we were both well again and I checked my finances. I was shocked to see that in August, September, October and November, instead of taking £26 per month, TW took £147 monthly and despite reporting this to Davinder@TW on the 12th December, TW took a further £147 on 16th December. So instead of taking 5 payments of £26 totalling £130, TW have actually taken 5 payments of £147 totalling £735. They over-charged me by £605.  Davinda @TW said that the problem arose because on 7 Feb 2024 my old water meter was changed for a smart meter, and a final reading taken of 2467m³. They do not have any photos of what was on the old meter and they didn't warn me they were changing it, so neither do I. But they say that instead of the usual 6 monthly total of 35m³ the bill dated 24 February 2024 claimed I had used an insane 415m³. That's 10 baths a day! We weren't having ANY baths because we both had open wounds. Davinda@TW was unable to find a photograph of the old meter and said that the number was an estimate (aka made-up amount, aka lies).I checked my old bills using actual meter readings &  I see that I use about 145 litres daily. So from the last actual meter reading of 2011 on 17th May 2022 to the day the meter was removed on 7th February 2024 we would have really used 90m³ and the real final reading would have been 2011 + 90 = 2101 -  NOT 2467!We have been overcharged by over £600.I looked at my revised bill online from Gulshan Kashyap@TW  and see that Thames Water have ignored the over-charging and have simply looked at my most recent meter reading and said that now we are back down to our usual consumption of 35m³ per billing period they can charge us £31 per month, that’s the usual  £26 plus an extra £5 per month till we’ve finished paying for the imaginary 415m³ they are pretending we used last February! I find TW staff themselves kind, polite and understanding. However they are powerless to deal with the mad, bad and dangerous-to-know robot that calculates the bills. There are so many 1* reviews here on trustpilot, all with very similar complaints against TWs bad management. I feel so so sorry for the staff who work there. Davinda, Akshaya, Hfeez, Shaun: you are doing your best. We can't fault you. This is not a compliant against you. Thames Water is the villain.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: It has taken 2 years....
review: We have been dealing with Waterplus over an issue for almost 2 years. It has taken that long to fix, correct and reimburse our account. It started in January 2021 when Severn Trent (we presume) started doing works out-side our property - nothing in correspondence so we took it as a service project. We then received a letter telling us that a leak had been detected and we are responsible to fix this issue - this we undertook. Whilst fixing this issue it became apparent we now had a different meter in place. This is when the whole 'carry-on' started. No one could verify that we had indeed been installed a new meter - no dates, no information what so ever! In order to claim back money for the burst/lost water we had to clear up this issue (by this point we are £1600.00 out of pocket for fixing the leak). It took us lots of phone calls with no results to establish when/who etc did fit our meter (6 months approx of calling/chasing). Waterplus raised the 'issue' and decided in order to clarify that we had another meter (pictures are not evidence....) that an engineer had to attend to record and document that in fact we had a new meter. Engineer number 1 visited (Aug 22) - we followed this up to be told they could not find his report. Engineer number 2 visited (Nov 22) - we then received an Invoice for one of the visit's (yes - we were being charged!) - which I refuted and an apology was made to us and we were told to ignore it. It then took until Jan 23 when I raised an official complaint for things to actually start happening. It has taken until 15th September 2023 for our account to credited for all the incorrect meter charges and finally a Credit for the lost water - which may I add Severn Trent did not want to give us initially which I challenged. I was assigned a very helpful guy called Josh Dunkley In Jan 23 (when I raised a complaint and ststed I wanted 1 point of contact) at Waterplus who pushed and helped clear up our account. He was very good - he was doing the best with what he had at his disposal and he kept us updated on a regular basis on what/where we were up to. It was then a lady called Debbie Backhouse who helped us finally get our credit for the lost water - she actually contacted Severn Trent on our behalf to also support our case and it helped. I have a job to do at the company I work for and it has taken a lot of my time to get this done. Maybe I should send an Invoice in for my time??  I'm just glad we are now at a stage where the account is correct and I can settle our account. Waterplus you did your best - thank you for persisting and pushing this along.

title: Water Supply Upgrade
review: We wanted to upgrade our water supply: it has proved enormously frustrating.  It has taken 11 months to finally get everything right.  There have been a litany of issues, not all down to Water-Plus (some were Severn Trent): the billing issues were a sight to behold.  They get there in the end and the complaints process does work (eventually), but you have to be very determined and incredibly patient.  The staff are professional, courteous, and hard-working but are ham-strung by an inflexible script and system.  It must be very difficult to work there.  Customer service staff are not allowed to make decisions and certainly not pragmatic/logical ones that they would like to.  It means that any "exceptions" end up having to be resolved by the complaints team: that's the wrong place if you ask me.  Perhaps managers or senior staff need to be quickly taking more of these decisions, and given the discretion to do so if they are not currently able to.  It could save an enormous amount of time and resource.The good news was that we got there in the end (phew!).

title: I am very cautious writing this review…
review: I am very cautious writing this review that is why I have only given 2 stars.     I have just received my up to date paper bill in today's mail, Jaz has fulfilled what she promised ( If I could she would have 5 stars she was very helpful) but there is a significant BUT :I was of the understanding that what l owed was calculated up until the 15th March but from what I can see on page 5 of my bill the charge period is up to 01 March2023 , ok just 2 weeks different but as to be expected it is not to my advantage.The other BUT :   I was assured I would be able to understand the new revised bill BUT I don't. !!What I interpret is that only 20% or less of my bill refers to water used the remaining 80% refers to charges for non  return  sewage allowance? and metered sewage tariff ? these charges are split 50 - 50 between these 2 items - - could any of you Water Plus customers out there please explain what these items actually are -and how figures are calculated, it appears like a minefield and the computer churns out numbers to suit I don't believe any Water Plus customer actually knows what he/she is actually paying for.I don't know what to think now,  my thoughts seem to be returning to my heated discussions with Steve Ellisat the time neither he nor I could agree what I was being billed for,  we appear to be heading in that direction once again so hopefully again Jaz couldintervene and explain how this very complicated system of billing their customers is actually for the correct amount what is deemed to be owing and in many cases (thankfully not mine) payment is taken by direct debit without little or no explanation.I am a Water Plus customer with very low consumptionmy premises are only used for storage, a week can go by no-one enters the premises my issue with my billsis miniscule in comparison to many, I can see that there are customers out there recieving bills for thousands of pounds without any explanation this should not be, these customers are becoming ill with worry caused by what  I  can only describe as the wrongly doing of either certain accountancy departments with their  calculations or imperfectionsassociated with their ' IT ' machinery.Whichever checks should be authorised immediately.
