The fact is my business has been here for 16 years and has no water supply or toilet connected to it. We already pay our landlord a water service charge towards a communal kitchen/toilet supply outside of our premises.Long phone call and eventually told it was an error and the account would be closed.  After confirming that the call was being recorded I asked for a copy of the phone call (for proof I was told the account was closed) but they wouldn't take a subject access request over phone  (breach of GDPR)  Have submitted a SAR request for the call by email and will post a further review on whether they provide it. Feels a bit dodgy having a company set up an account  for you that you didn't ask for and don't need.  I hope the account HAS been closed as stated in the phone call. 4th Jan EDIT - Thank you for confirming receipt of my Subject Access Request on 3rd Jan.  I look forward to receiving the information requested.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Their meter reader added an extra 100…
review: Their meter reader added an extra 100 m3 to our bill last year and carried on estimating that figure creating over £1200 over our realistic costs. They say that it'll take a month to repay their error and they refuse to pay the interest on the money we could have earned if we had kept the money in the savings account.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Avoid at all cost
review: Avoid at all costCompany failed to issue invoices from some 6 years ago and without any warning issued debt recovery against a primary school during a period of substantial hardship for the public sector. Allowed 10 days to respond to a complaint that they ignored for over 1 year. Absolutely avoid at all costs, it's happened to a number of schools now.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Useless, incompetent and probably fraudulent. One star is too much credit. this firm should have a negative rating
review: Useless. no part of the service is credible in any way.the bills a work of fiction at best or more likely a scam which has probably crossed the line to commercial fraud. in short our brand new smart meter shows 91cubic meters and we have no  dirty water discharges. our first bill in September demanded £4300  our second bill in December £7600 Our actual bill should be £45-£50  over 7 hrs hours of time over that period has been wasted with customer services making false promises to credit and close the account none of which has happened

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
review: AVOID AT ALL COSTS. 1 star is too many, should be an option for negative stars. Falsely created us a business account, didn’t bill and then threatened us with the baliffs. Over 18 months of fighting to finally get away from these crooks. Whoever is leaving the 5 star reviews must be employees!

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Zero Customer Service
review: I have been locked in a dispute with Water Plus for 6 years.  They offer zero customer service, ignore every effort I make to communicate with them and simply continue to send bills with added penalties and instruct debt collectors to hassle me.  Every email I have sent them over the 6 year period has had a pro forma reply outlining that they need to respond in 10 days - they never have. I condsider myself a robust person but this is really taking a toll on me. I take comfort from the fact that my solicitor and my former MP were also unable to get any response from this disgraceful outfit.

title: Totally inept company
review: Totally inept company. They have been chasing us for a payment on a industrial unit we do not occupy. Absolutely uselessUpdate ; After posting this review their customer service has resolved the issue. Give them credit for doing so.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: nightmare to deal with
review: nightmare to deal with. They raised an invoice on 25th nov and then charged me a late payment fee despite the fact it was paid within 5 days. The so called customer portal doesn't work Customer service line hopeless.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Totally Incompetent
review: The simplest thing to change an old meter number for the new meter number and calculate the final bill and opening bill with pictures and reads supplied is completely beyond them. Taken 2 months so far, numerous emails and they have just given themselves another month to sort out. Incompetent, useless - I just don't have the words.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Waterplus sinking Administration
review: Became a Waterplus customer 3 months ago  A second bad experience of Waterplus in the space of a week. I called the Co this week to guage estimated monthly water cost based on meter readings I had taken photos of and was advised charge would be approx £45 pm so I asked for a statement containing information supporting a direct debit payment of £87.50 against my bank account . All I got was a statement showing billing period 30/9/24-1/11/24  payment     of “- £8,7.50 “ without any details of tariffs etc which resulted in charge of £87.50 . You read right “-£8,7.50” Even worse was the fact that the amount was quoted 5 times on the invoice as “- £8,7.50 “ rather than £87.50 During the 3 months so far I have been a customer I would say the customer contact and information has been shockingly poor. I have absolutely no confidence in the customer telephone support and administration of Waterplus Frank

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: horrible service
review: horrible service, no one has a clue at this company spent over 3 hours on the phone for something very simple today, they would not even tell me my water charges are saying its data protection even though its my account.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Joke of a company!!
review: Honestly I’ve never known a company like it! No help for small businesses at all. Every time you speak to somebody, you  get told different things with promises of a call back, which never happens. Today has just topped it off, after months of trying to resolve our bill, I wanted  to speak to someone to complain to be told this can only be done by email. Absolute joke of a company!!

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Can't stand this company
review: Can't stand this company. They just make up random amounts to charge you every month even though you send them meter readings. They try and con you and say why not set up a direct debit so we can take the money ourselves monthly. Are you mad? Why would I allow a untrustworthy company with access to my money? Also I don't know how many times I explain to the crappy customer service that I would like to corspond through emails the imbecile always ring while my business is open and I'm dealing with customers. Either the staff who work there can't read English or they assign a new member of staff to look at your complaints even if the email is a reply

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Absolutely appalling service
review: Absolutely appalling service! Myself and another lady are renting a land. We’ve recently had a water leak and can’t seem to get anywhere with customer service. The company tells us to do one thing and another, once done, not good enough. Such an unhelpful company and even worse customer service. I would appreciate it if someone could get in contact with myself from an UK branch.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Absolutely shocking
review: Absolutely shocking , Company first of all they try to bill  me for three different meters when I only have one in the shop and then I find out that I should not of been paying VAT on my water as I am running a barber shop So now I have to go through HMRC to get that money back .They never asked what business I was running when the account was set up and they never questioned why there was three bills been sent to  the same address how was this never flagged up , and why is it not being advertised that they are a retail company and you can move you water bill to a different company

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: If there were negative stars as a…
review: If there were negative stars as a review, this company would receive them.Everybody I speak to on the phone has no idea about the ongoing saga on the account . Everyone contradicts each other, My emails keep getting span back.I’d strongly advise to stay well away from this company

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: The person on the phone was really rude…
review: The person on the phone was really rude and abrupt, informed us that we had to pay our bill immediately as they have changed the systems to pay monthly instead of direct debit, we had not been informed of this.  They are now not letting us set a payment plan up and yet our account online suggests we can, nobody wants to help us pay this large outlay of money, on no notice.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: Fraudulent Demands and Utter Incompetence
review: Sent my business an ambiguous invoice, then a letter claiming I had set up a payment plan which I hadn't. It took a dozen emails to their shoddy support to find out what the bill was for. It was for something I don't use. They were trying to claim £1000s for drainage. They specifically claimed for rainwater falling into my unit and draining away. My unit is on the ground floor, and the only exposed wall shielded from the rain by an awning that's on the roof of the second floor. The rain doesn't hit my wall, and if it did it would evaporate or infiltrate before getting to a drain some 20 metres away. I have photographs showing that when it rains there is at least a clear foot of dry pavement by my wall. They refuse to attempt to prove to the contrary. They refuse to attempt to prove that the surrounding gullies actually drain into their system and not the nearby river. They ignore every request for evidence to back up their claim (there can be no evidence as what they're claiming is wrong), ignore evidence that proves they are wrong, and continually barrage me with demands for money that I do not owe and that they have never attempted to prove that I owe despite me asking them repeatedly (around 30 times thus far). They've attempted to trick numerous debt collection companies into obtaining the money, which has failed every time. This month they've been threatening me that they'll cut off my water. They can't: my unit has no water. When I initially complained they send my a huge form asking me questions that only someone in their industry would know, and  actually all the things they should be proving. They are utterly absurd and just continue to make baseless demands for money that I do not owe, while ignoring all attempts at communication.

description: We're the UK's largest business water retailer, providing organisations of all sizes with billing, account management, meter reading and water efficiency services. 💧
title: If I could give it zero
review: If I could give it zero, I would…This company is a complete joke, every time you call you speak to someone different, every time you have to explain the most basic of things over and over and over. It’s incredibly frustrating.They were horrific to one of our tenants and tried the same with us. Honestly I can’t see why anyone would want to deal with them, unless they literally had no other choice. But you do have a choice so shop elsewhere…!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Understanding and Efficient.Georgina Bassey was very helpful and…
review: Georgina Bassey was very helpful and efficient,  and equally importantly, understanding of my predicament.  I rang Calor Gas first thing at 8am on 2 January as my gas tank was empty.  Due to my circumstances she arranged a priority delivery for me later the same day.  No fuss, no bother, just calm efficiency.  I am both impressed and grateful.  The delivery driver was also very helpful and friendly and helped me start my boiler once he had filled up the tank.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Excellent Customer Service
review: What a pleasant change to have a friendly and efficient delivery person.  We had a delivery of LPG on Wednesday, 2nd January 2024 from Calor and Kevin Shute was the delivery driver. We got a telephone call from him 5 mins before he was due - which was extremely helpful as it gave us chance to call our dog in from the garden and have the gate open ready.  Kevin was such a pleasant person chatting and very efficient making his visit extremely pleasant.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: a good customer services experience
review: It was easy to contact Calor with no protracted waiting times or a telephone system that tried to make you do all online rather than speaking to somebody.  The person I spoke to was extremely polite and friendly and was easily able to check and answer my query.  So much better to speak to real people thanks so much

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Excellent service from Calor today
review: Excellent service from Calor today. A swift resolution to our problem. The thought of no heating and snow on the way, was a worry!Bob Edment was here quickly and resolved the issue. We cannot thank him enough.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Great engineer
review: We had what we thought was a boiler issue so we got our heating engineer out who did checks and advised that it was an issue with the regulator on the tank and said we needed to ring calor.The call centre operator i spoke to i felt was sticking to a pre written script, didn't appreciate me trying to get to what the issue was but I was given my reference and assured I would get a visit from an engineer. I wasn't confident that this would happen.But a few hours later I got a call from Daniel C to confirm what the issues were we having and giving an ETA.Daniel was cheerful and friendly despite the long drive and after checking where everything was he needed, got on with job, once completed Daniel checked everything was working and we were happy, taking the time to explain the changes and what we needed to know before leaving for the rest of his shift.Written from a toasty warm home.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor, a shambles! Craig however, a Godsend.
review: Calor in general have been inconsistent with information and overly eager with irrelevant information and phone calls that we have felt harassed by. On the other hand Craig the customer services person we spoke to today went out of his way to help us. He was understanding, listened to us without interrupting and completely understood our situation. He was polite, professional and courteous. We were left with an end result we were very happy with, entirely due to his help. Calor you are a shambles, Craig you were a Godsend.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Emergency call out that was dealt with…
review: Emergency call out that was dealt with very quickly.Gas regulator had failed so was without heating and hot water.Mark Simms from Calor arrived and provided a temporary fix with the regulator he had with him. We now await the correct part.Very pleased with the service Mark provided in very cold conditions.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Very quick delivery
review: Very quick delivery, advised that it would be delivered within 7 days but arrived the next day. Good communication. Cheaper than buying from local stockists. I will be using again when I need to refill.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Really knowledgeable chap.
review: Dan Saunders was really knowledgeable, explained things well. Was curtious and polite and has hopefully left us in a better state. The only niggle I have is the problem can happen again and of the tanks were serviced today they would ‘fail’ and have to be replaced but I have to wait until 2026 to fail them … bizarre policy but not the engineers fault.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: A Thank You note Calor Gas
review: I recently experienced an issue with our gas supply, and I’d like to extend my heartfelt thanks to your team for their assistance. Initially, I was sent a YouTube guide to troubleshoot the problem myself, but unfortunately, it wasn’t applicable as our tank is outdated. Not wanting to take any risks, my husband and I decided to call back, and your team promptly arranged for an engineer to come out.The engineer arrived within an hour and worked tirelessly to identify and fix the issue. Thanks to his expertise, we were able to relight the pilot and restore our gas supply. While my menopausal brain couldn’t quite remember his name (Super Dunmore?), I hope this reaches him as a sincere thank-you.Additionally, I’d like to thank the wonderful ladies who coordinated the engineer’s visit. Your quick and professional support made all the difference. Truly grateful for your excellent service!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Your Engineer Mark Whiland did a very…
review: Your Engineer Mark Whiland did a very good job this morning at an address near Perth. He was persistent in looking for the problem, and got to it successfully.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Joe March fixed our heating
review: Joe March turned up and sorted out the issue with the gas. It was a very cold day and he worked outside to make sure we had central heating. Fast, friendly and professional service.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Great Customer Care
review: Sean and Adam were the maintenance team sent out to replace a meter that had been found to be leaking. They were friendly, efficient and completed the job quickly, going on to ensure the boiler re-ignited and the hot water and central heating systems were working, whilst answering any queries that I had. I’ve only been with Calor for a year, but so far would recommend them as a company with a good staff and great customer care.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Excellent responsive service and…
review: Excellent responsive service and communications.  Dan went through extra mile to double check the installation, found a small leak and had to replace the valves for a second time.  I really appreciated this diligence.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: I had a delivery from Calor yesterday…
review: I had a delivery from Calor yesterday and i'm very grateful. After spending the last two winters with another provider and getting down to 2% in my tank, phone calls every day to plead for a delivery it is such a refreshing change that i had the delivery yesterday with 28% in my tank. If Calor can keep up this sort of service i won't be going anywhere else. Many thanks to those that arranged the delivery and to Kevin Thomas from the Neath depot to get the delivery out to me on New Years Day. We now have enough gas to see us through the winter so no need to bite my fingernails. Thank you.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Great customer service
review: When the AI bot couldn't help me I was transferred within 30 seconds to a really helpful customer adviser that helped me out and provided the information I needed without delay. Even followed it up by email, what a helpful, resourceful individual......Thankyou Deon Moses

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor gas meter service & repair
review: Calor engineers Gary & Dean carried out a routine service check on my Calor meter. Professional & friendly, carried out a repair promptly and explained the process clearly. Good representatives for the company!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Brilliant customer service, very poor website.
review: I talked to Kayleigh, Customer Service Advisor; she answered very promptly and was patient, friendly, painstaking and efficient. She solved my problem. As I said on the phone, I think Calor has the best Customer Service of any company I deal with. Calor has also, unfortunately, the worst website. It is not fit for the purpose of making the relationship of the company and its customers clear to each other. It is impossible to find a statement; this is the very least a customer account should provide.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: D Harvey was such a pleasure to deal…
review: D Harvey was such a pleasure to deal with, explained about how much gas was needed.  Very patient as when he arrived we didn’t have our gate open so he had to wait for us to go open up for him.  Nothing was a problem, thank you

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: LPG tank replacement
review: The work carried out by Nathan and Chris, ably assisted by Mike, in the replacement of my LPG tank was of the highest standard and carried out extremely efficiently.I appreciate your reply, but the initial comments were for the installation team and not for Calor customer services.The initial risk assessment of the tank took place on the 14th Sept. 2020 and has been followed by a further 6 engineers visiting the site. A contract was signed by yourselves on the 8th Nov 2021to replace the tank and the pipework, but this never happened until the 9th December 2024. The system was classified as "at risk" in 2021, but nothing done for a further 3 years. There are many emails, from myself, on your system most of them stating that the hold up was because the tank base had to be measured before work could commence. The base fitted on the 9th December is an adjustable one and suitable for most, if not all, 1200 litre tanks.I have incurred considerable expense (in excess of £2000) to replace the pipework, and have all the groundwork completed, for the tank replacement and I have emailed the relevant department for some form of compensation, for the delays in the tank replacement and the breech of the initial contract, but as is normal I have heard nothing.I therefore give a rating of 1* for my experiences with customer services. You can also see on my Trustpilot comments of the 8th Nov 2021 regarding the second inspection.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor recently replaced our Bulk LPG…
review: Calor recently replaced our Bulk LPG tank, and the whole thing was carried out in the most efficient and friendly manner..So to Graham McPeake, Mark, Kev and Doc many thanks...I've knocked off a star since the reason for the tank change was that we're shifting to FloGas as they offered us a price per litre that was almost half that we were paying Calor....But that doesn't diminish the professionalism of Graham and his team..... Thanks fellas......!!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Overall the service was excellent
review: Overall the service was excellent.  Would have given 5 stars but the day it was due to be delivered they did not turn up with no phone call or email to let us know.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Brilliant service
review: Brilliant service, was delivered a day early which was great but I could have been out so a little notice would have  been perfect 👌🏻

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Warren and James C were great
review: Not terribly impressed with the salesforce, but once the installation team got involved everything went very smoothly.  Particularly impressed with Warren and James C.  Worked hard, and did a great tidy job.  A credit to the Company.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Happy Customer
review: Easy too use online...retailer emailed same day for when delivery would be...phoned when was arriving came few days earlier which was good..definitely recommend it.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: IT issues
review: Website not easy to navigate. Difficulties downloading the CRA after delivery of the gas bottle but download eventually resolved. Pleased with delivery of the gas bottle by local Calor gas supplier.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: The delivery driver was absolutely the…
review: The delivery driver was absolutely the best. Really helpful and went above and beyond. Delivery was a day early (not his fault).  As we weren't expecting him we didn't hear the door. The driver called the number on account and made sure we got our delivery. I would give 5 stars if delivery was on the day notified

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Spoke to Jess Souter twice today
review: Spoke to Jess Souter twice today. It was a bit complicated but she was very patient and professional.A credit to your Company. By the end of the day, she managed to resolve the problem for me.I felt that she showed that in Calor, customers still areimportant and demonstrated the fine balance of following the company"s requirements yet still listening to the customer.    Kevin Cawkwell.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Excellent Service
review: We are a major account holder that has seen excellent service provided by Ian Murphy, Account Manager for our site. Apart from providing on-going solutions for our large site that has 16 tanks, he has also been instrumental in raising the Calor Gas gas delivery performance which dipped drastically by ensuring gas deliveries are on-time during the critical busy periods, when gas consumption is very high. Well done Ian!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor deliveries
review: Difficult to schedule a delivery as Calor believe their telemetry system is accurate and only schedule as such. However I've previously run out of gas twice due to its inaccuracy.Jackie Freestone pf Calor Customer Service is however excellent and most helpful.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: I applied for full auto ordering and…
review: I applied for full auto ordering and text message advice and got positive reply by return. Well done Calor

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Mostly a great experience
review: I have a bulk LPG tank, so I signed up for auto-top-up. Sadly someone in the office didn't process my signed contract, and I ran out of gas Friday afternoon. Spoke to Calor on the phone, agent was very helpful and flagged me up for an emergency delivery. They were able to get to me on the Sunday, so I wasn't without heating for too long. The delivery men, Adrian Davies and Kevin Thomas, were very friendly and efficient. Top marks to everyone at Calor except the person in the office who received my contract and didn't process it.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Gas cylinder delivery.
review: I wasn't hoping that the delivery driver would have taken the gas cylinder into the house and connected it for me  as I found it difficult to lift heavy items. But apart from that the delivery was OK.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Quick and good work
review: The work we had done was carried out amazing well. Professional, courteous and quick. Bob Edment, the engineer that came out to us, was lovely and told us everything we needed to know in the best way possible, he worked quickly and treated our property with care and respect.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Easy to order online but had to ask…
review: Easy to order online but had to ask customer services for email confirmation and delivery date. Delivery took a bit over a week from a great local company. They said go direct to them when we need a new one rather than through the Calor website and they’ll deliver next day. Overall pleased but feels like the Calor website order process added some extra time

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Reasonably priced and good delivery service
review: Reasonably priced. Advices note said 5-10 working days before delivered and would get e mail to confirm. The delivery actually came next day after ordering but as no e mail received I wasn't at home to accept. However, the delivery man phoned and arranged to return later in the day so actually got a 24 hour delivery at second attempt. Fix the (lack of) e mail advices and it would be a 5* review!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Friendly efficient service at the…
review: Friendly efficient service at the Guildford depot. Payment method (giving card details over the phone while actually standing at the customer counter) is a bit weird, but not really a problem. I will buy refills of Patio Gas from here in future.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Communications poor - driver excellent!
review: I was informed my empty calor gas bottles would be collected on the 8th, but they arrived to collect them on the 4th, which meant moving the heavy gas bottles unexpectedly.However, the driver - Harry Walker - was friendly, professional and helpful.  Calor - he is an excellent ambassador for your company and I hope this is recognised in some way...

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Tom Hopkins is the most efficient…
review: Tom Hopkins is the most efficient person I’ve come across in any email communications between myself and companies. I have been most impressed by his helpfulness and quick responses in transfer of LPG from JGas. Tom has relieved me from a lot of pressure in meeting the criteria for transfer of my bulk tank when JGas wanted to replace it with 2x 19kg bottles - completely inadequate to run centralHeating. Thanks to Tom my switch is going ahead  I’d give him a gold star for customer services. Christine Milne Ross-shire / by Inverness

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Change of bulk gas tank in poor weather.
review: I tried to delay the fitting of a replacement bulk gas tank as the weather was poor( snow and ice).Having contacted Calor to express my concerns I was surprised to see the tank change team arrive, Despite the freezing weather they made a very good job of changing over the tank with no complaints or moans, indeed they were a pair of friendly , helpful guys who did a great job. Well done them.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: I was without gas for a few days
review: I was without gas for a few days, but finally, the technician arrived on Wednesday morning. He confirmed the tank was actually empty, even though it showed it wasn’t. He said hed report it for repairs, but that’s something I’ll have to follow up on. Before leaving, he made sure the boiler was up and running again, which was a relief. He was really helpful and friendly, so I’m glad my multiple calls to customer service worked..........

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor themselves were brilliant
review: Calor themselves were brilliant, from the minute I contacted them about issues I was having with delivery from the dealer they were extremely helpful and resolved the issue.My problems were with the dealer, who was over a week late with delivery and was not contacting me with updates.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: 10 year safety check
review: Took a while from requesting to receiving the 10 year safety check which is why rating is lower. Holly, at Grangemouth, was terrific...friendly, human and diligent...continued to request despite getting no result. And Graham McPeake, engineer, was friendly, courteous and did a good job cleaning the tank (and hopefully with the checks).

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Ordering (online) or Phone Call
review: Ordering Online, no conformation email,text or call.Gas arrived over a week later and wasn't sure if the order had been processed. With this in mind I spoke to my local Calor Depot (Osney Trading Estate) and they  did not know anything about the online ordering process so re-ordered a bottle via them. 1st bottle (online order) turned up a day later & 2nd bottle arrived today.  I've now had to pay for a second bottle !!  Delivery  Drivers excellent dropped bottles at front door ( I have a long steep driveway) both very professional .

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Delivered a week earlier than scheduled
review: The gas bottle was delivered, but arrived a week earlier than the date confirmed by email. Fortunately there was someone in to accept the delivery and handover the empty gas bottle

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Changing to Calor Gas as a bulk supplier
review: The customer contact (via phone) was good.However I had to do all the work - to take multiple pictures of the gas tank from different angles - they asked me to call my previous supplier to establish various facts (which I declined to do) they (the engineers) then relied on my statement that the tank was on a concrete plinth rather than send out an engineer - which I strongly urged them to do. My first contact towards the end of June suggested that I would just sit back and relax..Not quite...

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: It was a cold Christmas
review: We have waited since the 23rd December for someone to confirm when our tank would be replenished. After a further 3 - 4 phone calls, today a very nice gentleman arrived and we now have gas and heating. We would like to Thank the Driver Mr J Payne as he was very friendly and efficient and is a credit to the company. If it hadn’t been for his professional attitude the rating would have been lower.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Tank replacement fiasco                                                       Installers Dave & Ben did an excellent…
review: Installers Dave & Ben did an excellent job no complaints at all. However the service from Calor at the office end is total rubbish. The tank had to be replaced because it had not been pressure tested in accordance with the 10 yearly Pressure System Safety Regulations. They have now installed a second hand tank which on inspection will be out of date on its pressure test within a year and presumibly will need replacing again. Pathetic!!!!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Petty problem spoils 50 year relationship - now resolved
review: Problem now resolved. Thank you. Calor sent someone to collect the empty cylinder.Having been satisfied customers of Calor for more than 50 years we now have a problem. They are trying to charge us £69.99 for a cylinder which was not collected due to a collection of circumstances, none of them of our making. A very sensible woman in the accounts department suggested I wrote an email outlining the circumstances, which I did. Result - two copies of the same bill - by the same post - demanding payment. I have now written again explaining our personal situation and why we cannot physically move the cylinder ourselves to return it to a depot. I await a response. All they have to do is collect it. How hard is that?

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor are a bit hit and miss as far as…
review: Calor are a bit hit and miss as far as service is concerned. Took ages to set up a new account when we moved in until we were almost out of gas during winter. Had a tank renewed and engineer was brilliant. Mostly unhappy about contacting them as more often than not if you use their online message service it’s ignored. Their website is awful and statements are months old. Calor seems to work like the 1980s rather than 2024

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Tank now full
review: After 4 days without  gas, Simon came to fill the tank first thing on Wednesday.  He confirmed that the tank was empty rather than the third full reading Calor had on its telemetry system.  He said it would report back to get it repaired (which I suppose I will need to follow-up on) and before he left made sure the boiler restarted.  Very nice and helpful fellow. It looks like my repeated calls to customer service paid off.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: I had problem with calor gas when i…
review: I had problem with calor gas when i bought my mobile home, only when i wrote a bad revew, i got quick and good respond. Now i signed a contract with them, but i can't get enough informacion, like, delevery's...though that i would get automatic delevery when my tank is undir 20% but, nothing. Can't find it anywhere on my online account? How to go about that? In last 4 day's, i orded gas, maked requeres on line and phoned! It's freezing Now and not heard anything..Just saying, high demand..but i got about 3% left and probably will run out, im hoping not!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Delivery chap was lovely…BUT!
review: Delivery chap was lovely, and we were very pleased to see him! The reason was that we were on fumes as the auto top up system brought us right to the edge of running out before triggering a delivery. Customer services take over an hour to answer and then can’t give you any useful information about delivery.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Good and Bad
review: Excellent response from Graham McPeake who attended rural location very quickly to reconnect gas supply.  Tank supply had been closed by gas delivery driver for an unknown reason when we were out.  Both he and the Calor Emergency Operator were knowledgeable and very helpful.  But the initial advice of the supply closure (via printed slip that looked like standard marketing) was totally inadequate   We had no notion of supply turned off until Aga and boiler failed that evening.  Result is no overnight heat and no Aga for several days which is a direct and outrageous consequence.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Discontinuing 3.9 is NOT Customer Service
review: Jenny at Norwich Calor Gas Depot was most friendly and helpful. Full marks to her. BUT the Calor Head Office decision to discontinue 3.9 Propane Cylinders is a disaster for me as nothing else will fit for me (and many other people). This decision was a Customer Service Disaster. Please reverse the decision.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Gas bottle underside check!
review: happy enough with the delivery of gas, yet to try on our pizza oven, not so happy with it making a mark on my carpet in the house when my daughter took delivery of the bottle. must have been oily on the underside and I am left with a mark I cannot get off.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Driver not customer orientated
review: Driver broke one gate and apparently wasnt going to tell me about it until I questioned him. I’m not annoyed the gates broken as it was in need of repair anyway- what’s annoying is he wasn’t going to bother telling me. Also didn’t bother closing another gate upon leaving, annoying as my dogs could have left my property without me knowing.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Drivers great, customer service not great
review: Drivers always courteous and polite.Customer services still needs improvement, drivers don’t have access to tank if we’re not in and promised advanced calls never happen which is a nuisance. Credit refunds are also a continuing issue, sometimes taking 3 months.Communication on prices are also lacking, you have to waste 5 minutes on hold when you call them up to find out. Prices are not advised when you order either, it just doesn’t feel like the organisation is very joined up and therefore not a very satisfactory customer experience.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor gas - No notification of maintenance
review: Calor gas visited my property to change out my original gas tank. The staff that completed the work were efficient and carried out the work in a timely manner.The only reason I marked Calor down, was that I had no prior notification that this service was going to be carried out.I work away from home, so if I was working away then there would have no access to house to reset the boiler after maintenance.  In winter time this could have had dire consequences.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: As a new customer coming on board i was…
review: As a new customer coming on board i was disappointed the gas bottle was filthy and filled with cobwebs and dirt, the deliver driver made zero attempt to knock on my door to deliver the bottle and just left it in my front garden (i have doorbell video footage).Paying £100+ i expected better service

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: A problem getting a delivery or even a date
review: Well again it's the Calor system I think. We were placed on delivery by telemetry and I'd rather phone to order. I have been logging on to Calor almost daily for the past 2 weeks and our tank is reading less than 20%! I was told in November in my account login we were down for a delivery on the 2/12 and it keeps moving, yesterday was 13th and today it says the 23rd of December. To add insult to injury it is asking those who need a delivery to book it before the 10th and to order it at 30%,and not to leave it to where we are now. What does it take to stop all this stress given that the weather has to be bad just before Christmas and the truck might not be able to get here. Calor seems to come on here and just deliver to 1 or 2 customers on here instead of more and there are more than myself stressing...the system is not efficient!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: stressful and awful customer servies
review: A lot of this process has been very stressful and time consuming. We were given a start date for installation of a tank. Which then got moved forward. But then no one showed up and then the same the next day when we were promised someone would be here. During the wait No delivery instructions were passed onto various companies for delivering equipment so a lorry was stuck on our driveway for 2 hours and tore up our grass. Then the tank arrived but no base for it to be put on as no one had told him a change of dates. So we have wasted a lot of time being home and change our schedules to accommodate a 1 day tank install which felt like a whole week. Once Charlie and Matthew arrived 3 days later than scheduled things went smoothly. Other than the tank being installed the wrong way than mentioned on arrival. They did a good job of leaving things tidy

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Striking us off the Calor account system is a nightmare!
review: This is the 3rd time I have to write to Calor to strike us off of their account system as both previous times I've send a letter and an email to request this and no answer whatsoever and no result either.Every year around this time the Calor Account Statement comes in stating that we have to pay £ 0.00 right now.I wish to be striked off of their system as I do not wish to be a customer of this company nor do I wish to be accociated with them anymore since the last time we had issues with closing our account and getting the balance back (see our previous complaint here).Since we both are wasting time and paper on this ongoing Account Statement with no reply to my communication, I am using this channel again to get something done unfortunately.Let's see: "Hi, this is Zoe: can I help you?" Yes, strike us off your accounts please!Customer number: 40708898Can you send us confirmation of striking us off your accounts please?Update: 11-11-24:Email from Calor that the above has been rectified in their system.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Hopeless customer service
review: Hopeless customer service. It is extremely difficult to get through on the phone. They don’t reply to emails. When you call, there is this annoying recording saying “due to exceptionally high call volumes…..”. They have used the same recording for at least two years. It is therefore not a case of exceptionally high call volumes but them being understaffed and badly organised.If you don’t have to deal with them, use another company.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Every month I get a letter threatening…
review: Every month I get a letter threatening me with a debt agency if I don’t pay my account arrears . Last week I received a phone call chasing payment , I told the guy I pay every month at least £80 towards my account . “ oh , I’ll just have a look “ why did he not look before the call !? I’ve phoned the offices in Scotland and they said it’s marked in my account that I pay every month , they could not be more helpful . But I am 68 years old and this amounts to harassment and just gives me a fright every time I get one of the letters or a telephone call .

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: NO gas in our tank = illegal to do!
review: Calor once again is putting me and my family into a stressed situation without gas being delivered.Order made on the 11th Dec to be delivered 21st Dec which didn't arrive. I called today 2xtimes to find out when they are coming stating we now have below zero gas in our tank in an emergency situation (yes, winter, we need gas to cook and heat the house, hello?). Calor still not able to help even though the position they put me in is illegal and state of emergency!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Having had a reply via Trust pilot l…
review: Having had a reply via Trust pilot l was told my refund should show on my next statement. That arrived yesterday...no refund shown ! Am l surprised? NO.  I'm a pensioner owed over £250 since beginning of  November . I would appreciate another  informative response from Calor.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Shockingly bad customer service
review: Shockingly bad customer service, on average I’m emailing them 3 times over a 10 day period in the hope of a reply. Got the app but you can’t submit meter readings on it you would think with the money they make on their expensive Lpg product they would invest in better customer services and a better user friendly website. Even when you do manage to speak to so Ei Ei it’s sounds like their operating out of a porta loo

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: absolute shambles
review: I am leaving a review in the vain hope I might actually get a reply. I have been trying since May to register as the new home owner. It's virtually impossible to do. having spoken to several advisors the account still hasn't been changed to my name and I still haven't received a welcome pack. I now have very little gas left and cannot place an order..as I need to be registered! Probably the most frustrating company I have ever tried to deal with.... given I'm trying to become a new customer?Update: a few days after leaving the poor review I was contacted by Calor and my outstanding issue was finally resolved.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Not Delivering
review: Seems like we are being hit by the delivery problems stated in other reviews. Already phoned them twice this week to say tank is registering empty but despite platitudes to say we are marked for emergency delivery we have not had any. Each time takes half an hour to get through and wife is going into meltdown.If it doesn't get sorted I guess we'll be looking for alternative suppliers.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor, you need to change!
review: My experience mirrors that of many reviews on here. Waited for a delivery despite telemetry installed, unable to make contact via phone or email. Finally resorted to Facebook Messenger as my tank level was at 9 %! So pleased I did as Zoe, a customer care executive responded to my plight. Courteous and exceedingly helpful, a delivery arrived the next day! Steve Farrell, the delivery driver was like Zoe a delight to deal with. Thank you to both… but, I cannot wait to change to another provider at the end of my contracted period. Dealing with Calor is nerve wrecking!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Okay gas bottle, nightmare to get it replaced!
review: Originally Brought my gas bottle from B&Q, They now no longer do replacements! I have searched 10+ different stores in my local area and they either do not have any in stock or no longer do the replacements.It is honestly easier to get a doctors appointment than to find somewhere that holds these and at this point I just want a refund so I can get a different brand which shops actually have in stock.I would avoid Calor and find one which is sold near to you. Giving 1 extra star due to the gas bottle itself lasting a whole summer and doing its job.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Accounts/Customer Service or Lack Of
review: I have been trying to resurrect my budget direct debit since 1 August. No payments have been taken for 3 months. No statements either. I have called Customer / Service 4 times but they seem to be incapable of sorting it out. Last week I requested a call back from the manager to date no response!. Guess I will wait until they  start chasing me to pay Perhaps then there will be more action!!!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Everything is hard work
review: We have a metered supply from Calor which every month we give a meter reading and pay for our usage. Seems simple but its really not; I phone up to pay over the phone and half the time the advisor cannot take a payment for what reason I don't know, I try on the automated phone line but that is also sometimes just doesn't work and the website which has been down for months is hardly functional at all. I made a payment on the website over 12 hours ago and it is still showing me I owe the amount I paid for? Why is it such hard work to just pay for what I use?

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Is anyone there….
review: Is anyone there….I have tried to pay my outstanding account twice with the automated telephone system. Two days on the trot the system is down, but that’s not all, after going through their options list and entering your account number you get a message back asking if your account number is 0 and if your postcode is NN? What is going on Calor?

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Always a struggle to get the tank…
review: Always a struggle to get the tank filled Numerous messages with the updated reading (even though I have telemetry)On site the estimated delivery date in the pastA bit of a joke always have to wait until the very last minute (most annoying during the winter)I am sorry I switched to Calor

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Really Should Improve Customer Service
review: Non existent responses to three enquiries over 6 weeks regarding our account and increased monthly DD despite those enquiries. Very poor customer service on  line with flawed approach to calculating balances and a flaky computer system

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: No confidence in customer service …
review: Calor gas is fine unless you want to get in touch. I have sent a number of emails which are never answered and tried customer service telephone call backs which also never happen. It's a shame that the company is let down by poor customer service

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: What is going on Calor? Talk to us.
review: As others have said, it is impossible to get hold of them currently, they don't pick up the phone, don't call back, don't reply to emails, they didn't deliver our last delivery when they said they would.We have been customers of theirs for just over 2 years now, for the first year and a half they were great, now it feels like something isn't right. We are looking for alternatives. Whatever is going on, it would help everyone if they communicated in some way, so people know what is going on. In this digital age of an abundance of communication modalities, silence is not acceptable.Edit: Despite the generic reply below from Calor, and my response to them, we have heard nothing from them with regards to our complaints.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: it took weeks to communicate with…
review: it took weeks to communicate with calor. Phone lines constantly busy. I sent an email which was only answered after a number of weeks. We found a number for Fiona Smithson from a friend who has Calor and she was excellent. However the fitting of the tank was not registered which consequently made it difficult to order gas.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Calor Gas Rip off
review: For ten years paying the 2014 price 97 pence a litre. Current price 66 pence. Calor gas have ripped off £15 k during that time never saying there was a better rate. Should be illegal taking Calor Gas to court. Outrageous business practice

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Still being harassed and bullied
review: Still being harassed and bullied by the team. I have had two emails from customer care and customer services stating I won't be harassed any further yet here we are. Harassing me again for an amount I don't owe and have transcripts proving I don't owe it but because I don't want to go through the legal system I'm having to pay money and be harassed for something I shouldn't have to. I'm astounded as to how poorly I've been treated by this organisation.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Please avoid absolutely shocking…
review: Please avoid absolutely shocking company with a terrible accounts system. 20yeara on gas bottles paying by dd and dec 2023 when i owed £50 they took over £200 with no reason just a oh don’t know why that happened. 6 months later they charge me £70 for a non returned cylinder but it had been returned. 12 months of emails and people communicating then going silent including managers as they couldn’t answer nor fix the error. They admitted they had a new account system in 2023 and it’s all a mess complaints should be sorted in 3 weeks are backed up to a year as so many people have had issues. So shop round and if you can find a different supplier for even a bit more it will be cheaper then chasing refunds from a shambles of a company

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Again I’ve completely run out of gas
review: Again I’ve completely run out of gas. I’m on their auto system so they would have known about a month ago I was down to my last two bottles, but run out of gas on Boxing Day.  If you can avoid this company I would strongly advise to get an electric combi boiler and stay away from this woeful company.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Rubbish communication
review: Rubbish communication. 4th year of waiting for ground works to be actioned to ensure we are receiving correct bills. No meter readings for 4 years due to being unable to read meter. Neighbours same.  Calor useless 😒

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: If I could give them 0 I would
review: If I could give them 0 I would!  We are on an automatic refill system and they still let you run out of gas on numerous occasions. If you ring the numbers on their website all you get is “this is the wrong number, ring a different one” and guess what that’s the wrong one aswell. No one takes job ownership of anything, it’s just kick the can down the road to the next person. The people you speak to just do not have the slightest interest in trying to help you. We are a business which is bad enough, god help a vulnerable person who relies on them!!!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: My parents are being charged for uplift…
review: My parents are being charged for uplift when they waited 6 months for collection of tank, when they terminated they were never informed of the costs of uplift. And have received a demand letter with no previous contact. They are both pensioners and don’t have the means to respond and this has really upset them. Poor customer service again. As they waited months for collection.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: I ABSOLUTELY DETEST THIS COMPANY
review: I ABSOLUTELY DETEST THIS COMPANY. They have left us without gas on 6 separate occasions including on one occasion for more than 2 WEEKS!! LAST NIGHT - 23 DECEMBER- the gas ran out again!!! I ordered it 3 weeks ago and was actually rung by someone to ask for directions a few weeks back who said it was on its way. It seems they must’ve given up. I’ve got a son with mental disability and CALOR really could not seem to care less. Our distribution hub is CORYTON, I believe. We live near TUNBRIDGE WELLS. I note some people have rated CALOR high, but Spot the number of 1star reviews - also high. I’m waiting for a call back and have been told by 4 different people now that it is a priority. I’ve heard it all before from this despicable rip off merchants. I’ll be talking to my local MP and the MP for each of their hubs on basis that a UTILITY COMPANY should not be able to get way with this time and time again. And it’s not just me. Its been happening for years to many people all of whom have complained on X and/or trust pilot or similar- seemingly with no change

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Tank swtiching seems to be beyond them ....
review: On the 10th October we started the process of switching from Calor gas to FloGas as CG's admin seemed to be in disarray. Our contract ended late October so we thought we'd get sorted beforehand. Since then it's been a nightmare with CG.  FloGas have twice applied for the certificate for a drain test for the below ground tank test and twice nothing has happened.  I have spoken to a CG tank switch employee who has not been particularly helpful and during my last conversation to him he was quite abrupt.  I have complained to the CG complaints department and thirteen days on have heard nothing.  We are pensioners in our 70's and I have bronchiectasis and cannot afford to run out of gas - we are now less than 30%.  CG tell us we cannot ask FloGas to supply as we are still their customers even though the contract has ended.  FloGas are doing their best and we feel CG are being deliberately difficult.

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.
title: Tank Uplifting
review: We arranged for an uplift for our bulk tank which was emptied and disconnected and then left for months while waiting to be uplifted. The delay was because Calors’s uplifting Lorry’s were off the road. They apologised for the delay and told me that I wouldn’t be charged for the uplift. This was inconvenient but I said ok. When the tank was finally uplifted I received a bill not only for the uplift but also for the additional rent while the tank stood empty and disconnected. Many months ago and despite Calor saying repeatedly that the bill would be annulled I am now getting Legal threats.The problem is that the people who answer the phone are perfectly polite and try to be helpful but are unable to do anything apart from pass it on to someone else who I have got no chance to speak to and then don’t seem to give a monkeys about sorting out my situation.Also if it helps anyone when we were out of contract with Calor we told them that we were thinking about leaving and moving to another supplier. After a few calls agreed to halve the price we were paying for their gas and guarantee that figure for 2 years. It’s definitely worth looking into.We now have a heat pump which is so much cheaper than a gas boiler but alas the saga over the uplift charges continues! I wonder if anyone from Calor will bother to contact me after leaving this review!!!!

description: We supply everything from a single gas bottle for your LPG heater, to regular bulk gas deliveries for our commercial, urban and rural customers.

Please don’t tell me it was my responsibility to check. In the past I have rung to request deliveries and told I was on top up and it would just happen. I expect this resolving this morning. Apparently you had scheduled us for delivery in early December but cancelled the delivery on two separate occasions. I would like your explanation for this and your assurance that you 100% will deliver tomorrow as you have promised via FramTrade. UpdateThis has now been resolved. Last year we had no gas / no heating for 5 days! House was so freezing, we had to go into a hotel for 4 nights. I have taken us off the automatic top up as I wanted to have more control over when I order gas, which I thought would help. But it makes no difference at all. I ordered weeks ago when we had 45/50% yet we are now running extremely low with no guarantee when the gas will be delivered.  The system is giving us anxiety, as we can’t afford to have no heating with 3 very vulnerable people in the house. Whilst the customer service are understanding, it also feels like they are completely helpless in actually making it happen, always saying “it’s up to the distribution centre”Feels like we are completely helpless in this situation.

This morning I got another text saying they wouldn't be delivering - no new date was provided.  The text gave a number to call but when I called it they refused to discuss my delivery because it was ordered through Boiler Juice. I called Boiler Juice who said their system shows delivery WOULD be today!Clearly CERTAS know where their drivers are delivering but wouldn't confirm either way simply because the order wasn't direct with them. I have called numerous times, I have sent evidence of when I moved into the property, I have opened complaints with the company, I have emails confirming it was co-ops mistake and they would not contact me again. All that seems to have happened over this time is my email address has now been linked to the account of the unpaid bill (the only name they have on the account is occupier so not even my name!) and I've had to call so many debt collector agencies to inform them this is not my debt and subsequently called co-op to inform them of this and its the same cycle. I receive an apology, get told my email address will be removed from the account, that I have no outstanding balance with them and they will not contact me again.6 years later I am still receiving correspondence from debt collection agencies about this bill! I am not being listened to, there is only so many times I can call up and be told its resolved and then the same cycle starts again.

The original delivery date was emailed and double checked.There shouldn't be any excuses or explanation over your sales/bulk ordering, simply get the delivery dates and dispatch dates correct on your website. title: Very upset client!
review: I am writing this on behalf of my client who was very upset about her transfer from the airport Flight AC864 landed on 14 Aug 2024 at 10:00am to her port hotel which were arranged by Jayride and assigned to Xpress Airport Transfer.  The issue was that she was at the pick up location and he wanted her to come outside instead of waiting there with a sign. Here are her remarks:When I passed the doors to the arrival section, I saw many transfer companies….clean and fine looking gentlemen and women, dressed professionally in suits, holding up signs with their customers name on it, waiting for their customer as soon as they passed through the doors. I of course walked around in circles, exhausted, dragging around my two luggage's and carry-on bag, looking for my name on any of the placards, with no luck! I then finally found the Travellex money exchange counter on the other end of the arrival area, that was indicated as a meeting point, on the invoice from Jayride (I guess they prefer their customer runs after them, rather than they meet their customer), again nobody was there! They were not on time (40 mins late), no one was waiting for me in the airport with a sign with my name on it, the driver was terrible and spoke very loudly on the phone the majority of the 1.5-hour ride, and then he violated my privacy to hound me (over 7 unsolicited phone calls after the ride was over) when the agency should’ve just contacted me again. Apparently, I was supposed to have received an email with the driver's details prior to arriving and that had never been sent to me. The driver then spent the majority of the ride very loud on the phone and made several snide comments about the traffic being so bad because my flight was delayed and how he would miss the next pick up. It was made to be my fault for the flight being delayed apparently despite the fact that I was at the airport exactly when I said I would be. After the ride, I slept for the following day due to jet lag, and got about 7 missed calls from the driver as well as 6 text messages for not having paid the ten-pound surcharge for driving the extra 2 mins to grab the keys to the apartment from a nearby store as I couldn’t walk there with all my luggage. For the driver to call me like that is a serious violation of my privacy. I should never have to go through him, but rather the actual agency which is the entire point of having used an agency. Overall, it was an absolutely horrible experience and I would not recommend this place to anybody.Edit: the reply is absolutely ridiculous. The only place I needed was the shop two mins from the apartment that had the keys and then to the apartment to sleep. The owner called me 3 times only after seeing the reviews. The third time when I picked up, he was apologetic and told me the £10 was not company policy, and the driver essentially had forced a bribe. The owner wanted to know if there was anything he could do at all to make me take down the reviews, which I didn’t want to do so that no one in the future would be taken advantage.It makes absolutely no sense to say you actively monitor the flights for delays, but not for an early flight aka the time I actually requested you be there on the form as this would leave a huge chunk of your customers stranded.  Very disappointed in the reply!

title: Enjoyable...but time consuming!
review: First time Ferry user!  Crossing from Dunkirk to Dover:  Arrived over one hour early and Ferry left over one hour late and ten minutes late from departure time.  Crossing was uneventful, plenty of facilities that were clean and enough food and sights to keep children busy.  Crossing from Dover to Dunkirk:  departed ten mintues late arrived on time...no issues.When taking the Ferry, don't be in a rush...the loading/unloading and crossing takes most of your day, so dont plan on sightseeing!  In all a very good experience, if you have the time and want to save some money versus the Euro Chunnel.

We provide the very latest deals comparing prices from all the leading ferry operators including P&O Ferries, DFDS Seaways, MyFerryLink, Eurotunnel, Stena Line, Brittany Ferries, Condor and many more.
title: Nightmare
review: I made a mistake which I didn't realise until I looked at confirmation! I tried immediately to amend this but was unable to do online and had to telephone during office hours. I phoned next night at 16:20 and was held in a queue for 75mins without speaking to anyone! While waiting on hold I tried phoning via mobile at 17:35 to be told office was now closed yet I was still being told I was in a queue! Will try again tomorrow but not optimistic.

The base problem is that manufacturers don't provide this information to the retailers.
