description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Not What They Advertise + Bad Service
review: TL;DR: Shipping is awful, customer service is a frustrating & unhelpful loop, shirts are too obscure non-professional clubs. Their advertising, while technically not untruthful, is not representative of what you’ll receive.I ordered two shirts from these guys. Their advertising is rife with Bundesliga, La Liga, Liga Portugal, etc but I received shirts from semi-professional clubs with obscure suppliers (no Nike, Adidas, Puma, etc). The first was a Welsh 5th or 6th division club didn’t even have a Wikipedia page or proper website. I also find it very suspicious they “randomly” sent me a shirt they happen to be the primary sponsor for. That said, the shipping & timeline on that one was fine. I made my displeasure about the first one known but decided to keep it because it fits well. The second order was a wholly different story. I placed the order in late July and didn’t receive it until mid September. I was more than patient with them but became irritated when I had to chase down every update on this shirt. Their customer service is so disjointed you get a different person responding every time and essentially start completely over every time. After the data from the tracking number showed no movement for a month I gave them a deadline of one week to show progress or cancel + refund my order. A week passed and absolutely nothing happened, so I initiated a chargeback on my credit card for undelivered goods. And PRESTO! Now I had their attention. They assured me the shirt was on the way, I said to don’t want it anymore, they said they couldn’t cancel the transaction since it was “in progress.” And wouldn’t you know it, all of a sudden the tracking number showed movement! Shirt arrived a week or so later, some obscure semi-pro team from Ghana with a kit supplier usually reserved for beer leagues.

Absolute joke as needed them for Xmas party on 13th December. Their website states standard 48 hours shipping with 3 - 5 days shipping. Disgraceful.

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Just a bunch of cheaters...I ordered 2…
review: Just a bunch of cheaters...I ordered 2 shirts, neither of the matched the request that I put in and both were from the same place (india) 1 of the shirts I actually looked up and it was 12 pounds of hummels official site and the second wasn't even available to buy. extremly disapointed and cheated

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Not of value
review: I ordered a shirt via this website. First, the shirt took much longer than normal to ship. I mailed them several times, I did received a quick response from customer service, but each time I was told that they were having problems shipping to Europe. After some emails back and forth, I finally received a message that the shirt was being shipped. Well received and fortunately in time for St. Nicolas. But when I opened it I received a nice shirt... just not worth it. Thin fabric and if you look it up it is a shirt for €14.5 or 1299 Indian rupees... While I paid €80 for it. Overall a bad experience... and I wouldn't order it again.Update: the only soloution return it and pay again for the cost to sent it back?! That is even more then the value of the shirt. This is such a joke, this company

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: I get subscription
review: I get subscription, and received the first shirt very well, but then the second one is already one month delayed and they keep saying the same problem with the courier,So I will cancel my subscription and advise everyone that reads do not subscribe to it because they are nice for the first time and then they start the scam without delivering

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Overpriced scam, dont even bother
review: The site asked for leagues you wouldn’t want (you can only pick 3 so good luck) and that an optional note could be left to supposedly guide persons picking the shirt for you. I asked for a team that plays in Europe as my intention was to then go and watch the team I recieved play a game. Whilst not expecting any of the big teams as you’d be foolish to do so I still thought that the £45 price tag might translate into a lesser know team somewhere in europe. Oh boy was I wrong. I got an away shirt from Malappuram FC. Heard of them? No me neither. They’re a team that plays in India. I looked up the shirt I recieved on the official Hummels site (they make they shirts) and it was £13 brand new. 1,299 rupees to be exact. So what’s the £32 difference going towards? Remove £3 shipping given thats how much i’ve been given to return the shirt from them after having to pay £6 extra originally myself. £29 difference between product recieved and actual consumer price, essentially is greed and misleading people to achieve it. Do not use this service, it is gambling but the seller always wins because they control what you get.

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Negligent
review: I literally put down on my order to exclude Manchester United. I was looking forward to this jersey all weekend and today when I finally got to open my package I pulled out a Man United jersey. I’m especially disappointed because I came across this company on tiktok and they seemed to have  a good following a good rep and were legit. I would give it 0 stars if I could but it can get 1 because at the very least my package came within 2 working days.

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Tracking number given did not work…
review: Tracking number given did not work approached customer services to be told another shirt would be sent.. Fair enough... Further three days attempted to make contact and find out progress of shirt... To be met with same automated message.. I'm still waiting on shirt... Went to PayPal who refunded money straight away.

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: I'm waiting 3 weeks on my order
review: I'm waiting 3 weeks on my order, been told that they are below on jerseys but see posts on their Instagram page of people receiving order each day. Pretty brutal there's no option to track your order. If I have not received my jersey in a week I'm unsubscribing.

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Disappointment
review: I ordered mid June and didn't receive until August 1st.  Additionally I had to reach out to customer service because despite choosing the subscription option of every 3 months I was charged again at the 1 month mark. They refunded it. I reached out several times and was promised an order was coming in. When I finally received the "premium" I was extremely disappointed to find a kit from an obscure Indian league that I didn't have the option of avoiding.  When I researched the kit I found I could've bought it for less than 1/4 what I paid, seems like a scam to me. I know you have to make money but I would feel better if the kit was worth 3/4 of what I paid at least.

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: I'd give zero stars if I could!
review: I'd give zero stars if I could! Delayed dispatch as apparently no shirts available in size Medium..which I find incredibly hard to believe gven the amouny of teams available to chose from!! Parcel had now been marked as dispatched but courier company are saying the package has not been received...order marked as dispatched 5 days ago! Don't bother using this site just choose a shirt from a club yourself and get it delivered - way easier than getting a middle man like this company involved!!

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!
review: AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!Complete scam, sent a 3 season old Barca shirt for my son which you could pick up for £10.  I was expecting a current season kit as there website claims 100% customer satisfaction.  Absolute con and customer service afterward was a joke.  Said £5 processing fee for returns but they deducted £10 and I paid for return shipping cost.  Do not waste your time or money!!

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Had 3 shirts all been dogsh*t
review: Had 3 shirts all been dogsh*t, first one was a Sunday league side from Northern Ireland, 2nd a retro England shirt that doesn’t even exist that they probably bought off a market for fiver & third a Colombian shirt which doesn’t exist either. There margins must be good because the shirt values are probably only a fiver and they resell at 45 won’t be using again. Crap

description: Mystery Football Shirt Specialists.
title: Terrible service DONT USE
review: Terrible service! They don’t respond to emails, someone called Racheal replies saying that they are checking with fulfilment. I’m convinced Racheal doesn’t exist given it’s spelt wrong but anyway! These are a bunch of bedroom bandits, taking money, knocking out 2 year old shirts from the bargain bins of club shops, they are all over instagram showcasing this amazing concept but they don’t respond to your emails or reply to your complaints! Order still missing! Trading standards have been advised! DO NOT USE

They will look to delay at any possible opportunity, most likely because they have taken on so many cases that they don’t have the resources needed to get things done in a timely manner. I had to chase at every single stage of the process, usually several times, just to get an update. They were rarely forthcoming and they usually claimed it was the sellers solicitors that were the issue, which was more often than not, false. I had a strong relationship with the seller who shared emails showing that it was HS who were causing the issues. My searches were due back at the end of October, but when that time came it suddenly changed to the end of November, there was no reason for this given, despite asking multiple times. They often would only act when I would tell them that something needed doing. They made the whole process, which should really have been very straightforward, extremely stressful. However, they did get everything through in order on the date agreed (although I had to push extremely hard for the date I wanted as they wanted an extra 2 weeks for no obvious reason). They are a cheaper alternative to others out there, but be prepared to put the work in yourself or expect delays. Don’t expect to speak to anyone on the phone either, I was only ever able to speak to Jawad (my solicitor) twice on the phone over the course of 6 months and I have no idea who i was speaking with via email, which was equally frustrating. Having now seen the response from HS to this, it further reiterates my points around the lack of communication and responsibility, points there about some of the reasons for search delay, I had never heard. There’s no accountability for any of their errors and lack of communication at all. If I hadn’t have put all the work in I did, I would still be waiting to complete. I note they mention that it completed dec 6th “as planned” - I was given assurances initially we would complete in October and definitely before the end of November, and they would have like to have done it in mid December if they could have! They will consistently try and shift blame rather than recognise that mistakes can happen and it’s about how they deal with them rather than ignore them. They lost my business of lease renewal, which I would have used them for if I felt they were trustworthy.

I have heard of so many horror stories of energy companies just not listening to customers who complain when they have been sent bills of £1000's as a result of an error in their tech systems.Communication is at heart of these problems. So many companies have automated these systems so highly they lose the personal touch. The result is aggravation not only for customers but for their long suffering staff who have to deal with irate customers.You can opt out of smart meters on line now that I have the App working

title: Ecotricity does not offer a choice of tariffs
review: Ecotricity puts a large part of their monthly tariff onto the standing charge - and recently the electricity standing charge went from 48p/day to 59p/day - a 23% increase. Having said this, I applaud Ecotricity's efforts to generate more green energy. But funding for this project should not come from customers. We are already struggling.

We’re not like most other suppliers

title: I had a business electric account with Smartestenergy
review: I had a business electric account with Smartest energy for one year ending on Christmas day 2023. While I was using them the service was good. Bills were generally on time and the people at customer service were always pleasant and helpful. At the end of my 1 year contract I did not receive a renewal quote until too late and therefore went to another company which offered me a better deal any way. That is when the problems started. I sent photographs of my final readings (on Christmas day) as requested so they could send me a final bill. September 2024, I finally received an estimated bill which was more than double what it should have been. I contacted them and to get the correct bill. Over 2 months later, over 25 hours of my time and nearly 80 emails later, I finally was put on to Grant, My saviour. He looked in to my case and reassured me he would get things sorted, which he did. It took nearly a month but  today I have just paid my correct bill. Thank you so much Grant. With out your help who knows how long it would have taken to resolve this matter. I have given a 3 only because of the billing problems I had at the end of contract. Other wise it would have been a 4.

title: Unreasonable Service Charge and Management Fees by POD Management Agent
review: I have been residing in a property managed by POD Management Agent for several years, and it's with great disappointment that I find myself compelled to write this review. The issue at hand is their systematic and unjustifiable increases in the service charge, compounded by the exorbitant management fees they impose.Each year, without fail, POD Management Agent has escalated the service charge, often without clear explanation or justification. The management fees, in particular, are alarmingly high, and when combined with the service charge increases, create a significant financial burden for all residents.Communication from POD Management Agent is as scarce as it is ineffective. Notifications about fee adjustments are communicated poorly, if at all, leaving many of us bewildered and unprepared. Efforts to engage with the management for clarity, dialogue, or any form of dispute resolution are met with a stark indifference.I recall a recent meeting where residents gathered, hopeful for change or at least an acknowledgment of our grievances. Yet, the outcome was as predictable as it was disappointing: no action taken, no explanations given. This apathetic stance towards the concerns of residents is not only frustrating but deeply concerning.To those considering a move to a property under the care of POD Management Agent, please think twice. The financial unpredictability, paired with the company's blatant disregard for resident welfare, transparency, and accountability, contributes to a highly stressful and unsettling living environment. It's about more than just the financial aspect; it's about respect, transparency, and fairness - all of which are severely lacking in POD Management Agent's approach.In closing, my experience with POD Management Agent, especially regarding their handling of service charge increases and the disproportionate management fees, has been profoundly disappointing.*I have updated the review after I had a open conversation with POD I would like to see if anything changes since our last meeting and then happy to update my review based on the progress and changes.

title: Unimpressed
review: I'm so far unimpressed with POD. In their defence they have taken over from a horrible company but they use that as an excuse for everything. Currently our building has a massive leak which was reported weeks ago and no action had been taken until the other day. Their "action" has resulted in a major health and safety breech. Everything seems to take ages to fix but they put the blame on suppliers.  They have also "negotiated"an absolute ripoff deal with an energy management company. When you raise any complaint, I have found the estate office staff very polite but as you move higher up the chain of command the support given is lacking and communication has been borderline rude. Those working in head office support seem to think their role is to deflect any accountability/responsibility away from POD instead of actually supporting residents. I'm sorry that you don't think this is fair but this is factually correct. After reading some of the reviews I would also like to address PODs comment about saving residents money--with regards to heating/hot water that is an utter lie. My bills are now twice as expensive --most of the cost is the high admin fee POD negotiated which the billing company. In addition POD charges for management documents (and makes you pay extra if they have omitted information from them!) and precious building management companies have provided these for free. POD please stop responding to these poor reviews and actually improve your service so that you don't get them!! I am more than happy to change my review when I see a better service but for now I rate POD as very low value for money.

title: You get what you pay for!
review: This is the second time we have used PB, the first time was a better experience all round. This time we were told by the valuer he did not need to come round to assess it and just did an internet valuation. He was very pushy for us to just accept and press the go button without confirming many of our questions. Once we went live there were a lot of mistakes in the listing which took a while to sort. During the whole process we must have had around 5 different agents to speak with so consistency was not there. Frustrating but we got there in the end. The most professional agent we dealt with was the very last one, Connie Mayling.

title: Not great on local knowledge
review: Like the transparency and fee structure that Purple Bricks offers. However, the agent was very unsure regarding the value of our house and it took over 10 minutes of repeatedly and directly asking "so how much would you value it at?" between his ums and ahs before he reluctantly gave a figure. Don't feel like he knew the area at all and couldn't give a fair market price. We also didn't feel confident that if we opted for guided viewings that the person showing viewers round would know anything about the area and wouldn't be able to"sell" our property very well to prospective buyers. That's why we decided to go for a local estate agent, even though the fees were considerably higher, because we felt they could convert prospective buyers into offers much more easily.

title: Didn’t feel the service was up to it
review: I have recently completed a house sale through Purplebricks I personally would not use them again should I look to sell another property.The people I dealt with were all polite and helpful but I felt a number of things detracted from the process and ultimately may have meant that I received less for the property than I may be could have. My main concerns were- constant swapping of viewing agents meaning that some viewings got cancelled and potential buyers were asked to rebook rather than purple bricks trying to rebook them- lack of understanding around the property and the sale situation leading to people pulling out due to time it was taking- bad intial advice about the best way to deal with the sale (this only became apparent after my first sale fell through)- using them post offer is pointless they are too slow and do not pick up offers quickly enough- lack of proactive advice along the way other than the generic the market is slow

title: Unable to book a viewing
review: Tried to book a viewing online for a property and got a page with an error message so decided to call. I was placed on hold for 10 minutes and decided to end the call. As soon as I disconnected, agent called back and suddenly she had all the information. Even though I would be on holiday on the following week, they were unable to book me in for a viewing and she decided to book it for the following day instead. I didn’t get any confirmation with the full property address. I called again and they said that if I didn’t get the confirmation means that I didn’t have an appointment scheduled even though that was discussed 2 hours prior.Fast forward to when I received an email days after the phone call cancelling my viewing and they suggested a new time at 2pm on a Wednesday for another week. Tried to reschedule according to the availability on the website and they suggested the same time again through an automated email. The property is on the market since November and had the price reduced. I wonder if price was reduced because of lack of interest on the house or because it is impossible for us to book a simple viewing.
